about: Founded in 1988, ENHOU has cultivated expertise in the chemical materials field for over three decades. We specialize in the research and manufacturing of high-purity chemicals and functional materials, serving industries including semiconductors, electronic communications, textiles, coatings, healthcare, and precision manufacturing. Starting with water-based acrylic resins, we gradually expanded into precursor fiber processing oils, surfactants, and esterification products, establishing a comprehensive system for chemical development and mass production. In process and quality management, ENHOU has obtained ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 certifications, along with Kosher and Halal qualifications, ensuring product stability and process safety. In recent years, we have advanced production automation and implemented DCS control systems, significantly enhancing process precision and batch consistency to meet the stringent quality demands of high-end industries. Our fully equipped analytical platform includes GC/MS, LC/MS, NMR, Maldi MS, SEM, and other advanced instruments, enabling precise monitoring and analysis of trace impurities and unknown substances. This ensures our products meet high-purity and low-contamination standards required for semiconductor and electronic material applications. At the same time, ENHOU actively promotes green chemistry and sustainable development, with product designs aligned to international standards such as ZDHC, supporting customers in addressing global ESG and regulatory trends. Leveraging diverse product technologies and cross-industry application experience, Wenhao Chemical’s products are widely used in electronic communications, PU/TPU synthesis, cleaning agents, coatings, textiles, pharmaceuticals, food additives, industrial lubricants, construction materials, and agriculture—demonstrating strong material integration capabilities and market adaptability. Looking ahead, ENHOU will continue to deepen its presence in electronic chemicals, semiconductors, and advanced materials, strengthening high-purity product offerings and customized technical services. We are committed to becoming a trusted chemical materials partner in the global advanced manufacturing industry.

about: 環創源科技成立於2018年，專業從事「資源再利用設備的研發製造」，主要產品包括氨氮電解系統、超重力系統及氨氮廢回收處理系統等。 地球資源漸漸枯竭，人類不僅要重視環境保護，更須加快「創造能源」的腳步。因此，公司成立後，以氨氮廢水處理為起步，即依據環保法規限與客戶需求，提供更有效率的資源回收處理，除有效回收製程中產生的廢容液，並將回收的能源再運用於製程上，達到資源零浪費、經濟永續循環的目的。 環創源科技，是以環境、創造(新)、能源而命名由來，以環境保護、創新技術、能源創造為我們宗旨， 我們團隊有具豐富實務經驗的工程人員，以及具有厚實學術基礎的專業學者有不斷結合產學各界的專業，專研技術技術開發，未來我們會逐步往空汙回收處理、氫能源創造方向發展，在有限資源裡，為社會及環境創造新有價能源，讓經濟永續發展。 Enviro-Innovate Tech  was established in 2018 ，Our company is mainly engaging Research and development of the machines that create  energy from industrial waste. Inculding Electrochemical treatment of ammonia wastewater system 、High gravity deamination system 、Recovery of ammonia from wastewater  System . As the earth's resources are gradually depleted, not only pay attention to environmental protection, but also people need to speed footstep to create new energy in waste.Therefore, after the establishment of the company,starting with ammonia nitrogen wastewater treatment, our provides more efficient wastewater treatment   to  meet  environmental protection regulations and customer demand. In addition to effectively reducing wastewater discharge, the  energy recovered can be reused in the process to  achieve zero waste of resources and sustainable economic cycle. Enviro-Innovate Tech is named after the environment, creation (new) and energy.  Our tenet is environmental protection, innovative technology and energy creation. Our team has  engineers with rich practical experience, and  professional scholars with a solid academic foundation, we have been combining the professions of industry and academia and Specializing in the development of technology  of all time.In the future, we will gradually develop in the direction of air pollution recovery treatment  and hydrogen energy creation, and create new and valuable energy for the society and the environment in a limited resource, so that the economy can continue to develop.

about: Fabreeka, provides max vibration reduction for 104 years. Fabreeka® systems take the industry standard to the next level in vibration isolation for precision instruments. Our goal is to lead the world market in designing and manufacturing innovative high-technology vibration isolation systems and solutions for vibration sensitive instruments, equipment, and processes. We use a fully decoupled patented architecture for isolating vibrations from the floor, environment, machines or equipment such as moving stages, fans, and internal motors. Settling times for high-acceleration stages in semiconductor machines typically lie between 200 and 300 ms. Chip manufacturers designing new fabs to meet vibration specs can achieve significant savings by using Fabreeka® devices for sensitive equipment. Semiconductor chip manufacturing is a very complicated process involving tens of different machines on the production floor. Most of these processes require dedicated precision equipment, chiefly high-resolution units subject to aggressive moving-stage motion. Semiconductor-manufacturing machines are affected by vibrations from the floor or environment, or their own moving parts. Vibrations from various sources reduce throughput and cause excessive wear. Vibration levels are usually measured before the fab is equipped, but degrade by around 10 – 15 dB over the first two years with increasing amounts of production and maintenance equipment. Production technology developing from 10 to 7 to 5 nm node pose their own challenges by increasing demands on measuring and inspection equipment. Fabs that are already struggling to meet floor vibration criteria for the current technology node will have even more difficulty in the next node. Vibration isolation platforms are needed for the equipment to function up to spec. Fabreeka® offers a wide range of active vibration isolation systems. about: HELMUT FISCHER Holding AG 塗鍍層測厚、材料分析、微硬度測試和材料測試領域可以為您提供最先進的解決方案。公司由Helmut Fischer 博士於1953 年成立，自2008 年起由德國辛德芬根和瑞士休倫堡的 Helmut Fischer 基金會共同擁有。 FISCHER所有的產品都在德國總部研發，在那裡超過20%的員工從事研究和開發工作。我們擁有一大批科學家、工程師以及從事物理、化學、電子、工程和資訊學的學者，長期不懈地致力於新產品和新技術的開發。與此同時，FISCHER還非常熱衷於與各大院校和研究機構合作. 為了實現產品的高品質要求，在我們的企業內部擁有極為高效的縱向生產機制。在我們的生產車間內，高素質的員工使用最現代化的機器認真、敬業地完成每一道生產步驟。. 通過設立我們自己的分公司以及專業代理商的支援，FISCHER的足跡已經遍佈了世界每個工業地區。我們的銷售人員和售後服務工程師會定期參加新產品和新應用的相關培訓，以便可以為客戶提供最佳的諮詢服務和最好的解決方案. 我們非常希望客戶能從我們的產品中獲得最大的收益，因此我們樂於將我們知道的應用技巧和專業知識進行推廣宣傳。我們會按客戶的使用程度舉辦“測量基礎技術培訓班”、“設備最佳使用研討會”和“針對特別應用的座談會”。 高要求的測量應用始終需要更加專業的技術指導。FISCHER通過在全球不同地點（例如：德國、瑞士、中國、美國、印度和日本）設立應用實驗室來承擔這個重任。 為客戶提供優質的售後服務和高效的技術支援，對我們來說就像創新的高科技產品一樣，都是極為重要的。 因此FISCHER在全球範圍內建立了密集、發達的售後服務網路，通過高素質的員工為客戶服務。 憑藉全面的服務，如調試運行、維護、培訓、校準服務等，我們將為您的測量設備及其應用進行全方位的支持幫助。全球範圍內為您提供可靠、準確的FISCHER產品是我們一貫的目標。.

Join us to meet visionary leaders and explore transformative technologies. Welcome to where French innovation meets global ambition. French Chamber Taiwan Unveils France Pavilion Lineup for SEMICON Taiwan 2026 TAIPEI - French Chamber Taiwan (FCT) today announced the lineup of the France Pavilion at SEMICON Taiwan 2026, taking place September 2-4 at TaiNEX 1 & 2 in Taipei. Located at Booth R7324, the pavilion brings together nine leading French organisations spanning the semiconductor value chain, from fundamental research and advanced materials to processor design, equipment and environmental services. The 2026 France Pavilion features CEA-Leti, SiPearl, Veolia, STMicroelectronics, Quobly, ECM Group, Inventec Performance Chemicals, Technic, and IBS. CEA-Leti, a premier applied research institute in microelectronics and nanotechnology based in Grenoble, bridges fundamental research and industry and has incubated 76 startups, including Quobly and Soitec. SiPearl designs high-performance European processors for HPC and AI; its Rhea1 chip powers JUPITER, Europe's first exascale supercomputer. Veolia brings over 40 years of experience providing ultra-pure water treatment and effluent management for semiconductor fabs worldwide. STMicroelectronics, a Franco-Italian group and one of the world's top 10 semiconductor manufacturers, supplies microcontrollers, power chips, sensors and automotive solutions globally. Quobly, a CEA/CNRS spin-off, is building silicon-based quantum processors on 300mm wafers using existing semiconductor fabrication methods. ECM Group, founded in 1928, supplies thermal treatment equipment for semiconductors, including CVD and crystal growth systems. Inventec Performance Chemicals, part of the Dehon group, provides performance chemistry for electronics manufacturing. Technic is a global specialist in specialty chemistry, equipment and analytical tools for semiconductor and PCB surface finishing. IBS is a leading provider of ion implanters, implantation services and equipment. "The France Pavilion showcases the depth and diversity of French innovation in semiconductors, from fundamental research to industrial-scale equipment and services," said Stephane Peden, General Manager of French Chamber Taiwan. "It reflects the growing strategic partnership between France and Taiwan in one of the world's most critical technology sectors." Visitors can meet all nine companies at Booth R7324 throughout the show, from September 2 to 4, 2026. French Chamber Taiwan (FCT) supports and promotes French business interests in Taiwan, fostering trade, investment and collaboration between French and Taiwanese companies across all sectors, including the semiconductor industry. Media contact: Stephane Peden, General Manager, French Chamber Taiwan -

Recognizing the unique process requirements across different industries, we specialize in tailor-made cleaning equipment alongside our standard models. Adhering to our philosophy of "Professionalism, Integrity, Innovation, Service, and Dedication," we are your strongest backing in the precision cleaning process. Through patented innovations, advanced engineering, and customized ultrasonic solutions, we help industries achieve cleaner components, higher product quality, and more reliable manufacturing processes. From semiconductor and aerospace to medical and electronics, Crest continues to set the global standard in ultrasonic cleaning excellence. 六十多年來，Crest Ultrasonics 一直是精密清洗技術的先驅，深受全球頂尖製造商的信賴。透過專利創新、先進的工程技術以及客製化的超音波解決方案，我們協助各行各業實現更潔淨的元件、更高的產品品質以及更可靠的製造流程。從半導體、航太到醫療與電子產業，Crest 持續為全球超音波清洗的卓越表現樹立標竿。 「先試洗、再導入」！鋒鑫科技以數據說話，助半導體廠升級無痛接軌 在半導體與高科技製造業中，設備升級與產線擴充往往伴隨著龐大的資本支出與技術風險。若清洗設備的效能不如預期，不僅會造成產線瓶頸，更可能導致良率大幅衰退。為徹底解決設備採購與品保單位的痛點， 許多設備商僅能提供標準規格書，但鋒鑫科技深知，每家工廠的污染物特性、製程條件與清洗標準皆獨一無二。透過「貼心試洗測試服務」，客戶可提供實際的待洗工件或晶圓，鋒鑫科技將運用實驗室中的高頻、多頻超音波設備進行實測。從洗劑選擇、溫度控制到超音波頻率配置，我們將以科學數據與最終的洗淨良率來證明設備實力，讓客戶在簽約前就能看見 100% 的真實成效。 試洗不僅是為了驗證，更是為了「量身打造」。憑藉「一條龍客製化」生產能力，鋒鑫科技的研發團隊會根據試洗取得的數據，進行機構與軟體的深度客製化調整。加上引進國際洗淨權威 的頂尖專利技術，確保最終交機的設備能完美契合客戶的自動化產線與無塵室規範。 好的設備不該是一場賭注。我們誠摯邀請各界設備採購、廠務經理與品保專家蒞臨 SEMICON Taiwan 。讓我們以實戰經驗與科學數據，為您的產線建構最安心、最高效的洗淨解決方案！ Try Before You Buy: Front Xin's "Trial Cleaning Service" De-risks Equipment Upgrades for Fabs In the semiconductor and high-tech manufacturing industries, equipment upgrades and production line expansions often entail massive capital expenditures and technical risks. If cleaning equipment fails to meet expectations, it can create production bottlenecks and severely impact yield rates.  Championing a "Try Before You Buy" approach, Front Xin provides clients with a zero-risk equipment implementation experience. Speaking with Data and Real Results: No More Guesswork While many equipment suppliers only provide standard specification sheets, Front Xin deeply understands that every fab has unique contaminant characteristics, process conditions, and cleaning standards. Through the "Trial Cleaning Service," clients can provide actual workpieces or wafers. Front Xin will then conduct physical tests using high-frequency and multi-frequency ultrasonic equipment in our laboratory. S neox is a 3D optical profilometer that features multiple technologies for surface metrology in the same sensor head to provide areal measurements for surface texture, form, geometry, and general dimensional characterization. The profiler includes a 5Mpx camera to acquire high-resolution images and a patented optical design and technology that allows the use of a digital illuminator to illuminate the sample in different modes, including confocal, brightfield, HDR, and other focusing modes upon user choice. These illumination capabilities, in combination with the brightfield and interferometric lenses, transform it into a multi-technology system, integrating Confocal, Ai Focus Variation, and different Interferometry techniques (CSI, PSI, and ePSI). Additionally, the optional piezo scanner of the system allows for a 4th technology (Spectroscopic Reflectometry). All technology selections are controlled by the user through the acquisition software. Implementing such different measurement techniques in the same head and through the same optical path allows the maximum versatility required to measure any sample with no limitations regarding reflectivity, surface roughness, and geometry (undulation and shape). The generation of images and measurements through digital illumination takes place without any moving part inside the head, with great advantages in terms of robustness, reliability, and optical efficiency (there are no rotating pinhole disks and no galvanometric scanners). The profilometer is designed to provide traceable measurements. The graphical user interface contains a calibration environment, which offers calibration according to ISO 25178 for all operating modes, including Ai Focus Variation. In addition to topographic measurements down to the micro/nanoscale, the instrument allows the measurement of the thickness of transparent and semi-transparent layers, with thickness >1.5 μm in full field and, with the appropriate option, from 50 nm to 1.5 μm on a single point, in the center of the imaged field of view. The system can be purchased in different configurations to account for different user requirements in terms of sample size, weight, or measurement accuracy. These configurations include different possible XY stages, a piezoelectric Z stage, an isolation table, a ring light accessory, and a Differential Interference Contrast (DIC) module. The system is prepared for upgrades, like the possibility of integrating a rotational module and obtaining the 5-axis system for expanded measurement possibilities. The equipment comes with proprietary acquisition software and data analysis software. Optional software for quality control purposes, advanced analysis features, remote control, or software customization are also available.

about: Galatek stands at the forefront of semiconductor innovation, shaping the future of intelligent manufacturing through AI-powered technologies and precision engineering. As global demand for high-performance computing and artificial intelligence continues to accelerate, we are committed to empowering semiconductor manufacturers with intelligent solutions that improve yield, increase efficiency, and drive manufacturing excellence. By combining advanced automation, AI, and precision manufacturing technologies, Galatek enables smarter semiconductor production—from wafer fabrication and advanced packaging to metrology, inspection, and process optimization. Together with our customers and partners, we are building the next generation of semiconductor manufacturing capabilities that will power tomorrow's digital world. Galatek Establishes Strategic Penang Manufacturing Hub for Advanced Semiconductor and Life Science Technologies New facility strengthens Malaysia's position in advanced equipment manufacturing as demand grows across semiconductor, life science and AI-driven industries – Galatek Technologies (Galatek), a global provider of AI-enabled automation, semiconductor equipment and life science technologies, today marked the opening of its manufacturing, assembly and delivery facility in Penang, reinforcing Malaysia’s position as a strategic hub for advanced manufacturing and semiconductor industry development. The opening ceremony was attended by YAB Mr. Chow Kon Yeow, Chief Minister of Penang, Dato' Loo Lee Lian, Chief Executive Officer of InvestPenang, Mr. Muhammad Ghaddaffi Sardar Mohamed, Director of the Malaysian Investment Development Authority Penang (MIDA Penang), and, together with Jenny Lee, senior managing parter of Granite Asia, senior leaders from Galatek, industry partners and stakeholders, reflecting the significance of the investment in strengthening Malaysia's high-technology manufacturing ecosystem. The facility represents Galatek’s first manufacturing footprint in Malaysia and will serve as a key production and delivery centre supporting customers across Southeast Asia and international markets. The investment forms part of the company’s broader regional expansion strategy and long-term commitment to developing local manufacturing capabilities, talent, and supply chain partnerships. Backed by investors including Granite Asia, Galatek has invested approximately USD2 million (MYR9.4 million) in its initial Malaysian operations and plans to increase its total investment in Penang to USD100 million within the next five years as it expands production capacity and operational capabilities. The facility will focus on advanced equipment manufacturing, system integration, assembly, testing and delivery activities, supporting industries including semiconductors, advanced electronics, and life sciences. Through its Penang operations, Galatek aims to strengthen local supplier participation while increasing the localisation of manufacturing and procurement activities. YAB Mr. Chow Kon Yeow, the Chief Minister of Penang stated, “Galatek’s commitment to further investment and workforce expansion in Penang reflects Galatek's strong confidence in the state's future and further reinforces Penang's reputation as the Silicon Valley of the East — a preferred destination for technology companies seeking to innovate, expand and thrive.” “Galatek's decision to establish its first manufacturing footprint in Malaysia here in Penang is a testament to the state's competitiveness and attractiveness. It demonstrates global confidence in Penang's capabilities not only as a manufacturing base, but also as a centre for innovation, technology development and high-value production.” The establishment of the facility comes amid continued growth in global demand for semiconductor manufacturing equipment and advanced production technologies. As countries seek to build more resilient and diversified technology supply chains, Malaysia continues to strengthen its position as a preferred destination for high-technology investments, supported by its mature industrial ecosystem, skilled workforce and established semiconductor value chain. Founded as an AI automation solutions provider serving the semiconductor, and life sciences sectors, Galatek develops technologies that integrate advanced optics, precision motion control, artificial intelligence and automation to improve manufacturing efficiency and process accuracy. The company maintains operations across Asia, Europe and the United States, with Malaysia serving as a key location for its regional production and delivery activities. Mr. David Tian, Chief Executive Officer, Galatek, said, "Malaysia offers a strong foundation for advanced manufacturing, supported by a highly capable workforce, established semiconductor supply chains and a conducive business environment. Penang was selected as a strategic location for our regional manufacturing and delivery operations because of its deep industry expertise and connectivity to global markets. The opening of this facility marks an important step in Galatek's long-term development strategy in Southeast Asia. Beyond manufacturing, we aim to build local engineering capabilities, expand collaboration with Malaysian suppliers and contribute to the continued growth of the country's high-technology industries. We believe the next generation of industrial and scientific innovation will increasingly rely on the convergence of AI, automation and advanced equipment systems. Penang provides an exceptional environment for us to build those capabilities and serve global customers from Malaysia." "The global demand for AI-enabled semiconductor and advanced manufacturing equipment is at an inflection point — and the companies that have built the right capabilities ahead of that curve will define the next decade. Galatek is one of them. Penang's industrial heritage, engineering talent and policy environment make it the right home for this next chapter, and this facility is a strong signal of Galatek's growing stature as a global-calibre company. We are proud to have been part of that journey,” said Ms. Jenny Lee, Senior Managing Partner, Granite Asia. The Penang facility is expected to create between 20 and 30 jobs in 2026 across engineering, operations, procurement, sales and technical support functions. Over the next five years, the company plans to expand its Malaysian workforce to approximately 100 employees as production activities scale. As part of its long-term roadmap, Galatek will continue investing in local production capabilities, workforce development and supplier partnerships to support regional and international customers. The company intends for its Penang facility to become a strategic manufacturing and delivery centre supporting the growing demand for advanced semiconductor equipment and automation technologies across global markets.

about: 積極實踐ISO-14001永續發展與ISO 9001道德規範，致力於解決傳統銅材料的應用瓶頸 抗氧化納米銅技術：獨家保護配方與機制化學，有效抑制氧化納米銅粒子成長 關鍵指標：在高溫高濕環境(65℃ / RH 90%)下，維持超過3,000小時穩定性 高導電率與高鋁合金：低電阻率（≤10-5Ω*cm）與優異熱力，顯然預示著傳統耗材 半導體架構封裝：晶圓晶片封裝、導線(QFN/SOP)貼合、IC載板、陶瓷基板 獨家專訪（上）》從奈米銅粉到CPO光波導　凱鍶甩開物理宿命布局AI材料新藍海 生成式AI推動高效能運算（HPC）需求快速成長，半導體產業正從製程競賽逐步走向材料競爭，凱鍶 科技董事長沈宗桓認為，當晶片製程邁向2奈米甚至更先進節點後，AI算力提升不再只是晶片設計的問 面對共同封裝光學（CPO）興起，凱鍶同步布局高功率燒結銅、高導熱介面材料（TIM）、高折射率光 學膠及光波導材料等，並將公司定位為「AI Optical Thermal Solution Provider」，預計2027年第3季 答：凱鍶成立於2014年，目前落腳於中部科學園區，2017年於竹北台元科技園區成立先行開發實驗 室，針對奈米抗氧化銅粉以及奈米材料的研究，進行產業化分析與發展，因應市場技術發展，同一時 2024年底，凱鍶在中部科學園區建立首座奈米銅粉量產工廠與奈米先進實驗室，目前主要產品為奈米 抗氧化銅粉以及所衍生出來的散熱銅膠、半導體封裝用銅膠、先進封裝用銅膠以及光波導材料等。 其中，高導電、抗氧化奈米銅粉月產能為500~800公斤，奈米銅膠與光波導材料月產能可達1,000公 問：生成式AI帶動HPC大爆發，硬體端對「高頻寬、低功耗、高散熱」的要求幾乎達到極限。從第一 線材料商的角度來看，目前半導體產業在傳輸與散熱上面臨最大的材料瓶頸是什麼？ 答：AI算力的天花板，本質上是由材料熱力學與電磁學物理極限所決定的。當晶片製程微縮走到2奈米 甚至更前端，矽晶圓本身的進步已經無法獨自支撐算力續航，材料正式成為決定異質整合良率與效能 從第一線材料研發的角度來看，目前HPC產業正迎面撞上傳輸與散熱的兩大材料物理壁壘。 隨著AI運算所需的數據吞吐量呈幾何級數爆發，通訊頻率已由112 Gbps向 224Gbps甚至更高頻段演進。 此時，傳統封裝基板與PCB所採用的銅導線，在高頻電磁波下會產生嚴重的趨膚效應（Skin Effect），也就是說，電訊號不再走導線內部，而是集中在極薄的表面層傳輸，這導致電阻急遽上升。 高分子基材在極高頻率下，分子的偶極矩（Dipole）會隨著電場高速擺動，將電信號能量轉化為廢熱，這就是介電損耗（Dissipation Factor；Df）。 傳統高分子材料的Df值已經很難再往下降，這會導致訊號在高頻傳輸時發生嚴重的衰減與RC延遲。簡單來說，傳統電子材料在物理特性上，快要無法支撐高頻訊號在微米級線路裡的奔跑。 此外，單顆晶片或小晶片（Chiplet）模組的熱設計功耗（TDP）拉升至1,000W以上，熱密度已經超越了傳統風冷甚至水冷的臨界點。 此時，主要的散熱瓶頸不在於外部散熱片有多大，而是卡在晶片表面（Die）與中央散熱殼（IHS）之間的接觸縫隙，是否可以將內部熱能第一時間傳導出來，也就是第一層導熱介面材料（TIM1）。 傳統填料型導熱膏，受限於高分子基材本身的熱傳導率物理上限，且在高溫下容易發生乾裂（Dry-out）。如果試圖增加無機導熱填料的比例，又會破壞材料的界面潤濕性，導致微觀下的界面熱阻（Rth）不降反升，無法即時導出晶片核心的局部過熱點。 傳統導熱膏（高分子基材）就像普通花生醬，晶片一加熱（吐司變燙），花生醬就會化開、從邊緣溢漏出來，或者時間久了直接乾硬結塊（Dry-out）失去效果。 材料商為了解決這個問題，試圖在裡面瘋狂加入大量具有高導熱能力的「顆粒」（無機填料），這就像把花生醬裡面的「花生碎粒」比例拉高到 95%。結果，整罐花生醬變成了一坨乾巴巴、硬梆梆的碎渣。 當你想把它抹在吐司上時，因為太乾了，它根本無法平滑地填滿吐司表面的微小孔洞（失去界面潤濕性）。 結果花生碎粒下方全是一層層的「空氣內鬼」，而空氣是極佳的隔熱體，最後反而把熱量死死卡住，讓晶片特定局部熱到快要燒焦，這就是局部過熱點（Hot Spot）。 凱鍶的「高功率燒結銅」就是徹底跳脫花生醬的思維，直接給晶片鋪上一整塊「高導熱的金屬銅板」，徹底終結傳統導熱膏的物理宿命。 問：業界目前高度關注CPO等次世代先進封裝技術，凱鍶科技如何看待這波光電整合的趨勢？這對先進材料供應商帶來了什麼樣的新機會與挑戰？ 答：CPO將光通訊元件（Optical Engine）與交換晶片（Switch ASIC）或運算晶片，直接封裝在同一個基板上，這本質上是一場空間革命。 過去光纖通訊只用在資料中心與資料中心之間的長途傳輸，現在，我們直接把「光纖高鐵的月台」蓋到晶片的家門口。用「光子」取代「電子」進行內部傳輸，瞬間將功耗降低數倍，並將頻寬提升數十倍。這是一場不可逆的光電融合海嘯。 這場革命將光通訊產業的需求，直接平移到了半導體的核心製程中。過去半導體材料商只需要懂電與熱，現在，材料必須具備「光學性能」。 這創造了全新的藍海市場——包括高折射率（High-RI）材料、高透明度低損耗的光學膠、以及微型光學導波元件材料。這是一個完全不受傳統價格戰波及、技術壁壘極高的高毛利市場。 然而，隨之而來的嚴苛挑戰就是光學材料要「跨界」進入半導體先進封裝「嚴苛的信賴性測試」。 傳統的光學樹脂很脆弱，一碰到半導體後段製程動輒 260°C 的迴焊爐（Reflow）高溫，就會發生變色（黃化）、脆裂或折射率飄移。 材料必須在維持完美的「光學穿透率」與「折射率精準度」的同時，還能通過半導體嚴格的溫度循環測試（TCT）與溫濕度測試（THT）。這要求材料研發必須在有機與無機材料的配方上，達到很好的平衡，才可滿足這些看似彼此衝突的材料特性要求。 獨家專訪（下）》憑獨家材料兼管封裝空間光與熱　凱鍶拚「AI晶片效能雙重守護者」 生成式AI推動高效能運算（HPC）需求快速成長，半導體產業正從製程競賽逐步走向材料競爭，凱鍶科技董事長沈宗桓認為，當晶片製程邁向2奈米甚至更先進節點後，AI算力提升不再只是晶片設計的問題，而是受制於材料的熱傳導與高頻訊號傳輸能力。 面對共同封裝光學（CPO）興起，凱鍶同步布局高功率燒結銅、高導熱介面材料（TIM）、高折射率光學膠及光波導材料等，並將公司定位為「AI Optical Thermal Solution Provider」，預計2027年第3季登錄興櫃，展開IPO計畫。以下是沈宗桓的專訪紀要： 答：在CPO標準尚未完全定案、各家封裝堆疊百家爭鳴的「戰國時代」，凱鍶科技的戰略不是去賭哪一種單一設計會贏，而是憑藉獨家的「有機材料設計-無機奈米改質技術」，提供具備高度定制彈性的「材料底層配方科技」。 凱鍶的競爭優勢在於掌握「奈米粒子單分散技術」，能把奈米粒子控制在極致微小狀態（形同隱形），即使配方裡塞了70%的奈米粒子，材料依然可保持高穿透度及低霧度，完全不會產生散射損耗。 這讓我們將折射率推向1.80以上極限的藍海，無論客戶最後的封裝結構怎麼變，都可以在完全不改變折射率與光學透明度的前提下，任意調整膠水的黏度，好塗佈、不溢膠，還能自由控制固化後的軟硬度（模數），配合客戶需求進行細微的調整。 問：凱鍶產品主要對應的產業與應用？各產品線的營收佔比？未來2~3年成長力道最強勁的產品線？目前的營運與財務狀況？有沒有IPO計畫？ 答：凱鍶主要的專業能力是可以用低ESG的成本、加上突破性的抗氧化關鍵製程生產製造抗氧化奈米銅粉，打破傳統半導體材料主要使用的貴重金屬（金、銀）的價格限制，並針對不同的粒子進行特殊的表面改質，並將其奈米化及表面改質技術應用在相關的光學材料上，如ZrO2、TiO2等，提升分散效果。 對應到不同的應用類別，包含有散熱需求的半導體封裝、Die attach paste、TGV銅膏填孔（開發中的重要產品），導電需求的線路印刷產品、薄膜開關印刷、血糖測試片等，可應用在光學材料的高折射膠水，光波導、AR/VR等領域。 目前已進入量產的高階電子膠材與傳統散熱材料，是營收的中流砥柱之一，佔比約20%；線路印刷類產品的客戶黏著度高，出貨量穩定，營收佔比約為25%；至於抗氧化奈米銅粉及特殊表面改質的高導電銅粉，佔比最高，營收比重約為40%，並提供極為健康的現金流，能完全支撐凱鍶在新材料領域的研發與驗證投資；其他的15%主要為高折射等相關光學材料，該業務甫於2025年投入，目前穩定成長中。 凱鍶未來2~3年的布局，將採取雙箭頭方向，目前已提前展開。主要布局方向有二： 一是AI先進散熱材料：核心產品是「高功率燒結銅（Sintering Cu Paste）」與高階TIM，主要將應用在AI伺服器的GPU/ASIC晶片、車用高壓功率模組等。 二是次世代光電整合材料：核心產品是「高折射率光學膠」與「CPO光波導材料」。主要將應用在次世代的AI高速網路交換器與CPO模組。 凱鍶的目標客戶與合作夥伴，涵蓋了一線半導體封測廠（OSAT）、AI晶片設計大廠、光電大廠以及目前投入CPO的相關廠商等。 相信結合這些合作經驗，再整合光、電、熱等不同需求，對於後續不同客戶的跨世代產品，將可提供更有效、更快速的滿足。 得益於半導體國產化與AI浪潮的雙重驅動，與一線客戶的深度驗證都在既定進度上，財務結構非常健康，營收與獲利逐漸步入上升軌道。 關於IPO計畫，這是我們吸引全球人才、擴大產能的戰略一步，目前正依照既定計畫穩健推進，預計2027年第3季興櫃掛牌並同步啟動IPO進程。 問：凱鍶正往「AI Optical Thermal Solution Provider」方向前進，可否談談這個新定位的業務藍圖與進度？與傳統材料供應商有何不同？ 答：在次世代的AI架構中，「光傳輸」與「極致散熱」已經不是分開的兩個課題。光模組運作會發熱，而熱度超標又會直接干擾光的折射率與傳輸品質，兩者形影不離。 凱鍶將自己定調為「AI光熱一體化解決方案提供者」，我們的業務藍圖是：在晶片的第一層（TIM1），用「高功率燒結銅」或「大於10W的TIM材料」取代傳統導熱膏，並將導熱係數拉升數倍，解決晶片的熱源核心。 同時，在同一個封裝空間內，將用「高折射率光學膠」布建光波導，確保光訊號高速通過。 「我們一手管熱、一手管光，期許自己成為AI晶片效能的雙重守護者」。目前的研發進度非常順利，多項產品已進入客戶的深度共同驗證階段。 事實上，傳統材料商很容易陷入「單點思維」與「被動供應」的盲點，因為傳統大廠通常是客戶給規格，然後再去翻庫存或調配方，賣導熱膏就只管散熱，賣黏著劑就只管黏性，很容易陷入規格與價格的紅海內耗。 而凱鍶著重的是「系統級共同設計（Co-design）」，在客戶開發晶片與先進封裝架構的最初期階段就主動介入。 因為我們理解電訊號、光訊號與熱應力在微觀空間中的交互影響，可以提供客戶一整套「兼顧光學穿透、極低界面熱阻、且兼顧材料平衡」的跨領域材料解決方案。 因此，凱鍶期許自己不是零件販賣商，而是AI客戶在封裝架構的創新路上，不可或缺的戰略技術合作夥伴。

about: is the economic development agency of the Federal Republic of Germany. Established in 2009, GTAI supports German companies entering international markets, promotes Germany as a business and technology location, and assists foreign companies with investment and market entry in Germany. With around 60 offices worldwide, GTAI provides market intelligence, investment consulting and access to regional business ecosystems and partners. Semiconductors are one of GTAI’s strategic industry priorities. GTAI promotes Germany’s semiconductor ecosystem internationally and supports potential investors with information on locations, industry clusters, market opportunities, incentives and the overall investment environment. Germany currently produces more than one-third of Europe’s chips, with major semiconductor clusters in Dresden/Silicon Saxony, Bavaria and Baden-Württemberg. GTAI also provides information on major policy and funding initiatives, including the EU Chips Act, IPCEI Microelectronics, IPCEI Advanced Semiconductor Technologies (AST), Chips for Europe, and the German Chips Competence Centre (G3C) . Rather than administering these funding programs directly, GTAI serves as an important investment promotion and market-entry interface , helping international companies navigate Germany’s semiconductor ecosystem, R&D infrastructure and investment opportunities. For Taiwanese companies, GTAI has become particularly relevant as TSMC/ESMC’s investment in Dresden strengthens Taiwan–Germany semiconductor cooperation and creates new opportunities for Taiwanese equipment, materials and technology suppliers considering expansion into Germany.

GfG – Gas Detection Solutions for the Semiconductor Industry Gas detection for the semiconductor industry Semiconductor manufacturing relies on numerous toxic, corrosive and combustible gases – making reliable gas detection an essential part of protecting people, processes and facilities. GfG develops and manufactures gas detection solutions for applications throughout semiconductor production. Our portfolio ranges from highly sensitive D-ReX gas detection systems for monitoring process tools, gas cabinets and scrubbers to fixed gas detection systems, portable gas detectors and replacement sensors. With 65 years of experience in gas detection, GfG combines application expertise with flexible solutions tailored to individual monitoring requirements. Our gas detection technology is developed and manufactured at our headquarters in Dortmund, Germany, and supported by GfG subsidiaries and partners worldwide. GfG Expands Semiconductor Gas Detection Portfolio with New D-ReX PoS² New addition to the D-ReX family combines highly sensitive gas detection with simplified service, compact installation and a design focused on lower total cost of ownership. Dortmund, Germany – August 2026. GfG has expanded its D-ReX family for semiconductor gas monitoring with the new D-ReX PoS². The new model builds on the capabilities of the established D-ReX PoS while introducing a new design focused on simplified service, space-saving installation and a lower total cost of ownership. Semiconductor manufacturing relies on a wide range of toxic, corrosive, flammable and highly reactive gases. At the same time, monitoring requirements can differ considerably depending on where a measurement is taken. Gas detection close to a process tool presents different challenges from monitoring exhaust lines or gases associated with scrubbers and other abatement systems. This is why GfG approaches semiconductor gas detection as an application-specific task rather than relying on a single monitoring concept. The D-ReX family provides different configurations for monitoring hazardous gases at critical points throughout semiconductor manufacturing – from process-related applications to exhaust and abatement monitoring. Designed for easier service and lower total cost of ownership The D-ReX PoS² adds a new service concept to the established capabilities of the D-ReX PoS. Its design enables fast, tool-free removal and replacement of the device, helping to reduce service time and associated downtime. During device replacement, the connection terminal, electrical wiring and tubing remain installed on the wall. This significantly simplifies replacement procedures and reduces the work required during servicing. Combined with its compact, space-saving design, these features are intended to reduce maintenance effort and contribute to a lower total cost of ownership over the lifetime of the gas detection system. Different processes require different detection concepts The PoS² is the latest addition to a broader range of D-ReX solutions developed for the different monitoring requirements found within semiconductor facilities. Depending on the application, the appropriate measurement concept is determined by factors including the target gas, expected concentration, process conditions and location of the measurement point. Some semiconductor gases also require an additional step before they can be reliably detected. For these applications, GfG uses pyrolysis technology. The target gas is heated to a defined temperature and decomposed into measurable reaction products. These products are detected by the sensor, allowing the D-ReX to determine the concentration of the original target gas. For example, NF₃ can be thermally decomposed and detected via the resulting HF concentration. Together, these different approaches enable gas monitoring concepts to be tailored to specific areas and processes within a fab rather than applying the same detection method to every measurement point. From specialized detection to complete gas warning systems Gas detection within a semiconductor facility extends beyond specialized process gases. A comprehensive safety concept can include monitoring for additional toxic and combustible gases as well as the evaluation and processing of signals from numerous measurement points. GfG therefore combines its specialized D-ReX solutions with a broader portfolio of fixed gas detection technology, including gas detection controllers such as the GMA400 and transmitters for combustible gases such as the CC28. Replacement sensors for existing gas detection systems further complement the portfolio. With 65 years of experience in gas detection, GfG develops and manufactures gas detection technology at its headquarters in Dortmund, Germany. The company's semiconductor solutions combine sensor technology, application-specific measurement concepts and system integration to address gas monitoring requirements across different areas of semiconductor manufacturing. Advanced point-of-sampling gas detector for semiconductor applications, combining highly sensitive gas monitoring with tool-free maintenance, a compact design and features that help reduce downtime and total cost of ownership.... The D-ReX PoS² is designed for demanding point-of-sampling applications in semiconductor manufacturing. An integrated pump extracts the sample gas over distances of up to 30 meters, while smart sensors enable the detection of more than 60 gases. Optional Line Integrity Monitoring continuously monitors the sampling line for leaks or blockages. A key focus is efficient servicing: the sensor cartridge and pump are easily accessible and can be replaced without tools. During device replacement, the connection terminal, wiring and tubing remain installed. Combined with its compact design, this helps reduce maintenance effort, service-related downtime and total cost of ownership. Integration options include 4–20 mA, RS-485/Modbus RTU and Ethernet/Modbus TCP, plus Power over Ethernet and an integrated web server. Flexible gas detection platform for semiconductor manufacturing with PoU, PoS and PoI configurations for diffusion, extractive and remote gas monitoring at different measurement points throughout the fab.... The D-ReX family provides application-specific gas detection for demanding semiconductor environments. Three configurations allow the measurement concept to be adapted to the monitoring point: diffusion monitoring directly at the installation location. extractive monitoring using an integrated pump, with sampling distances of up to 30 meters and optional Line Integrity Monitoring. remote diffusion monitoring using an external sensor cartridge, which can be installed up to 1,200 meters from the D-ReX. All variants combine smart sensor technology with flexible system integration. Interfaces include 4–20 mA, Modbus TCP/RTU and LonWorks, complemented by five freely programmable relays. Filament pyrolyzer extending D-ReX gas detection to selected gases that cannot be measured directly. Target gases are thermally decomposed into reaction products that can be detected by an electrochemical sensor.... The Py-ReX extends D-ReX monitoring capabilities to selected process gases such as NF₃, CH₃F or DCE. The target gas passes through a quartz glass tube containing a filament heated to a gas-specific temperature. It decomposes into measurable reaction products, which are subsequently detected by an electrochemical smart sensor. The concentration of the original target gas is calculated from the measured decomposition product. The Py-ReX is installed as a separate unit ahead of the D-ReX PoS or PoS². Separating the high-temperature pyrolysis process from the electrochemical sensor protects the sensor from thermal stress while providing a flexible solution for demanding semiconductor applications. GMA400 Gas Detection Controller Powerful controller for large gas detection systems, providing centralized monitoring of up to 128 D-ReX units or other transmitters and flexible integration into complex semiconductor facilities.... The GMA400 provides centralized control and evaluation for complex fixed gas detection systems. A single controller can monitor up to 128 digital transmitters or measurement channels, making it particularly suitable for semiconductor facilities with numerous monitoring points. The system can combine D-ReX units with other GfG transmitters and provides a central overview of measured values, alarms and system status. Modular expansion options support the integration of additional transmitters, relays and alarm devices. For enhanced visualization, the GMA400 can be combined with TFT touch panel PCs running GMA Visual, providing a structured overview of measurement points and supporting targeted responses to alarms and system faults. Fixed gas detector for fast and reliable monitoring of combustible gases and vapors, including applications around exhaust and abatement systems in semiconductor manufacturing.... The CC28 is designed for continuous monitoring of combustible gases and vapors and complements specialized process gas detection within semiconductor fabs. Typical applications include areas around exhaust and abatement systems where combustible gases may present an additional hazard. Its catalytic combustion sensor technology provides reliable detection of potentially explosive gas concentrations. An integrated exhaust design allows heated air generated by the measuring principle to escape upwards, creating a chimney effect that helps the measuring gas reach the sensor quickly. The CC28 can be integrated with GfG gas detection controllers such as the GMA400, allowing combustible gas monitoring to become part of a comprehensive gas detection concept throughout the fab. Satellix – Replacement Sensors for Satellite XT Plug-and-play replacement sensors for Satellite XT transmitters, providing precise detection of over 30 toxic, corrosive and combustible gases used in semiconductor processes.... Satellix by Sensorix is a range of plug-and-play replacement sensors developed for existing Satellite XT transmitters. The portfolio provides precise detection of over 30 gases used in semiconductor processes , including hydrides such as AsH₃, PH₃ and SiH₄ as well as HF, HCl, HBr, Cl₂, NH₃, H₂ and many other target gases. Satellix sensors are available as electrochemical sensors and pellistors for LEL monitoring. Dedicated sockets and programmed EPROMs provide compatibility with Satellite XT transmitters, allowing operators to continue using their installed infrastructure with a plug-and-play sensor solution. For facilities considering a complete system modernization, GfG can additionally provide migration concepts based on D-ReX and Py-ReX technology.

Expertise in wet etching & cleaning equipment ZEUS, established in 1970, has been growing alongside the semiconductor industry for more than 35 years. It provides wet etching and cleaning equipment and technologies. Since the 1980’s, ZEUS has been involved in providing chemicals, parts, and equipment used in the semiconductor process. In 2009, ZEUS acquired JET (formerly known as SES), a company which encompasses the technology and extensive experience required in the designing and manufacturing of wet etching, cleaning, and stripping equipment. Representing an investment of approximately €5 billion, the new facility is one of Germany’s largest industrial projects and a significant expansion within Silicon Saxony, Europe’s leading semiconductor cluster. The project doubles manufacturing capacity at the customer’s Dresden site and is expected to create approximately 1,000 highly skilled jobs. The project is supported by approximately €1 billion in public funding through programs including the European Chips Act and the Important Project of Common European Interest, or IPCEI. Built for production on 300-millimeter wafers, the facility will manufacture power semiconductors and analog and mixed-signal technologies. These components are essential to AI data centers, electric vehicles, renewable energy systems, power grids, and industrial applications. Gradiant supplied mission-critical ultrapure water and water recovery systems for the facility. The solutions are engineered to meet the stringent purity, reliability, and process consistency requirements of advanced semiconductor fabrication. Gradiant’s systems help provide the stable and dependable water supply required for these highly sensitive production processes. The facility uses industrial water rather than drinking water for its operations, helping conserve valuable drinking water resources. Discover us at Gradiant, Global Head of Marketing Gradiant’s ForeverGone Sets New Standard for PFAS Destruction with Breakthrough Cost and Performance BOSTON, Massachusetts – September 29, 2025 , a global leader in advanced water and wastewater solutions, today announced advancements in its PFAS destruction platform, establishing it as one of the most cost-effective and sustainable solutions for eliminating “forever chemicals” in industrial wastewater. ForeverGone is the first fully integrated platform that destroys PFAS compounds on site. The system pairs micro-foam fractionation with advanced electrooxidation to achieve 99–99.9% removal, including short-chain PFAS that older technologies often miss. Unlike granular activated carbon (GAC), ion exchange resin (IX or IER) and other “capture and dispose” approaches, ForeverGone eliminates PFAS completely and removes the need for costly disposal and environmental handling risks. Operating at just $0.10–$0.20 per cubic meter, ForeverGone delivers a breakthrough in affordability that is far below the $0.50–$2.00 per cubic meter total cost of conventional GAC or IX treatment. With energy use of only ~0.5 kWh/m³ as the primary operating expense, the system minimizes costs while on-site treatment eliminates the added costs and risks of hauling and disposal. “ForeverGone is the new model for how industries tackle PFAS,” said Anurag Bajpayee, Co-Founder and CEO of Gradiant. “By destroying PFAS at the source, we remove the burden of disposal and deliver compliance that is both cost-effective and sustainable. Regulations in Europe and Asia are accelerating adoption, while U.S. industries are preparing for the inevitable. ForeverGone gives customers confidence to meet today’s standards and tomorrow’s. And as attention turns to compounds like trifluoroacetic acid (TFA), this platform establishes a foundation for long-term leadership in emerging contaminants.” New Deployment at Munich International Airport Gradiant has commissioned a ForeverGone system at Munich International Airport to tackle contamination from fire suppressant aqueous film-forming foam (AFFF). This deployment highlights the platform’s versatility in solving complex, legacy PFAS challenges. The latest ForeverGone units are now operating on-site, proving their effectiveness in high-profile, high-demand environments. After a four-year development program, Gradiant has reduced the footprint of its Destruction Engine electrooxidation unit by more than 100X, shrinking it to just 2% of the original system volume. Paired with Micro-Foam Fractionation, the result is a technology that is highly compact, mobile, and adaptable for both permanent installations and temporary remediation applications. Demand is accelerating worldwide as regulations tighten: Semiconductor discharge limits of 1.2 ppb, with compliance tied to double sampling protocols Industrial PFAS discharges under increased scrutiny Stricter limits on PFAS in drinking water In Europe, aggressive PFAS restrictions are already in place, while in the United States, adoption is advancing as standards evolve. Clearer rules around leachate sites are already driving projects forward, and upcoming EPA guidance is expected to accelerate nationwide implementation, creating one of the largest future markets for PFAS remediation. Pharmaceutical customers are also engaging Gradiant on trifluoroacetic acid (TFA), a compound linked to drug manufacturing byproducts. The EU is expected to decide on TFA regulation in 2026, which could open a significant new market for ForeverGone and related technologies. Gradiant’s Counterflow Reverse Osmosis (CFRO) is a membrane-based brine concentration technology that helps industrial facilities recover more water, minimize liquid waste, and cut the cost of MLD and ZLD, without relying on energy-intensive thermal systems. Conventional RO stalls at high salinity. Thermal evaporators and crystallizers can handle concentrated brines but are costly, energy-hungry, and complex to run. CFRO closes the gap. A multi-stage counterflow design with controlled salt passage lowers the osmotic pressure barrier, concentrating brine at lower pressure and lower energy than thermal alternatives. SmartOps AI and CURE chemistries manage scaling and fouling to keep systems running reliably as conditions change. Residual layer Inspection System HySID-D-F0500 is a non-contact, non-destructive optical inspection system designed to detect and visualize residual organic films and subtle material differences.... The system enables visualization and analysis of residual film leakage, non-uniformity, residue, and other micro-scale defects, providing detailed information on their location, distribution, and morphology. Conventional analysis methods such as FT-IR, GD-OES, TEM/SEM, LIBS, contact-angle, and AFM can be time-consuming or may require destructive sample preparation. HySID-D-F0500 enables fast, non-contact, non-destructive optical inspection, helping reduce the need for additional analysis processes. The system supports both reflectance and transmittance inspection and can measure a wide range of organic and inorganic films, including oxides, nitrides, carbides, and polymers. about: 漢泰先進材料，成立於2004年，為信紘科技全資持股的子公司，專注於工程材料代理銷售與特用化學專利配方行銷。此外，漢泰攜手信紘科研發團隊，積極投入奈米材料之應用領域，秉持信紘集團「可靠、先進、永續」的核心理念，漢泰持續深化「服務、專業、創新」的企業精神，致力成為客戶可信賴的夥伴。 在工程材料的領域，漢泰嚴格把關產品品質，提供專業製程所需的高品質管路系統配件。針對PVDF與PP材質，漢泰代理瑞士商+GF+的產品，涵蓋一般級與潔淨級的管材、閥件與接頭，廣泛應用於半導體、光電、化工與生技產業之流體系統中。為提供客戶多樣化選擇，漢泰亦代理經銷多項業界知名品牌產品。美國專業高潔淨管配件設計與製造商 Cardinal，提供符合高純度與高耐蝕要求的解決方案，協助客戶提升設備可靠性與製程穩定性；德國高性能塑膠材料品牌 SIMONA 之FM PP與FM PVC工程板材，其板材具備優異阻燃性能，滿足客戶對安全性的高標準需求。 浪潮，以環保減廢為目標推廣綠色製程理念，為此，漢泰提供客戶專利配方產品，可有效去除有機溶劑中的雙氧水，使廢液資源化。以半導體產業為例，製程廢液常含高濃度雙氧水，運輸處理過程具有潛在爆炸風險，透過專利配方的應用，漢泰協助客戶自源頭進行廢液前處理，降低高額清運成本與安全風險。處理後的廢液則具再利用價值，符合工業級標準，可供相關產業使用，進一步落實循環經濟與永續發展的願景。 奈米材料部門聚焦於於半導體∕封測產業的ESD靜電消散表面處理解決方案。取代傳統硬陽處理及鐵氟龍鍍膜，漢泰膜層採用PVD(物理氣相沉積)的離子鍍膜技術，其應用範圍涵蓋半導體中IC封測、傳送之設備組件，可避免靜電累積與放電在高精密製造環境中，對檢測儀器、封裝模具等關鍵設備造成損害。 膜層本身具有優異的附著力，且耐磨耗、抗酸鹼特性，使設備鍍膜後可大幅延長使用壽命。同時透過特殊的膜層結構，依據不同產品需求，可精準調控表面電性以達到客製化靜電防護效果，協助半導體產業客戶克服靜電防護困境，提升先進封裝製程良率。 PVDF 系統（SYGEF）— 專為超純水（UPW）、化學品輸送與氣體處理設計 PP 系統（PROGEF）— Natural PP 系列則適用於製程冷卻水、排水與一般化學品運送... 超高純度：符合 SEMI 規範，適用於 Class 1 無塵室環境。 優異耐化性與熱穩定性：承受多種腐蝕性化學品與高溫環境（最高可達 140°C）。 雙焊接選擇：支援 IR 焊接與 BCF 鏡面焊接，提升接頭強度與密封性。 專為半導體、製藥、生技及化學製程等高潔淨氣體系統設計，提供高純度且高可靠性的管路連接解決方案... 封測產業E-Chuck/Handler Change Kit/In-Shuttle，及各式ESD載板、載盤中的ESD(靜電消散)表面處理。

about: Hantop Intelligence Tech. (HIT), founded in 2018, possesses strong capabilities and a team dedicated to innovative technological research and development. The company specializes in providing advanced-material processing technology products and smart automation modules. Its goal is to offer its global customers the highest quality and flexibility in new material processing technology modules and the best customer experience services. HIT's non-contact power transmission ultrasonic-assisted machining module is compatible with traditional CNC machine tool spindles and their automatic tool change systems.  It upgrades traditional metal processing CNC machine tools into high-precision processing equipment for advanced materials.  This includes processing hard, brittle, and difficult-to-cut materials such as ceramics (alumina, zirconia, Macor), quartz, fused silica, sapphire, Si/SiC/AlSiC, tungsten carbide, stainless steel, hardened steel, and super alloys.  It effectively enhances tool life, processing efficiency, and workpiece quality in CNC machining.  Industrial applications include semiconductors (especially in the making of showerhead, quartz ring, wafer susceptor, heat sink), optoelectronics (optical moulds), aerospace and automotive (especially for EV components, brake disc), and precision moulds. Over the past years, HIT's ultrasonic-assisted machining modules have been successfully integrated into over 30 international machine tool brands for end customers worldwide.  They have been introduced to end customers in industries such as semiconductors, aerospace & automotive, optoelectronics, and precision mould in the United States, China, South Korea, Japan, India, Turkey, Singapore, Malaysia, Switzerland, and other regions.  The modules have demonstrated significant benefits in improving tool life, enhancing processing efficiency, and reducing workpiece edge chipping.  They have also provided stable production capacity benefits for semiconductor key supply chains, receiving excellent evaluations from end users.

Hartley Ultrafast is a Bristol, UK deep-tech hardware company building the fastest AI decision-making silicon on Earth, using light. Most AI inference hardware is built for scale and throughput. For a growing class of latency-critical applications, that isn't enough: a decision has to beat a competitor, or beat a physical process, to matter. Hartley's optoelectronic architecture computes small, dense neural networks directly in the analogue, photonic domain, delivering inference in nanoseconds rather than microseconds, while presenting a standard UCIe chiplet interface that integrates into existing CPU, FPGA, and SoC designs without redesigning the host system. Our in-house proof-of-concept, Babbage, has demonstrated end-to-end inference in 176 nanoseconds. Clockwork, our first production timing chip, tapes out on an advanced RF process in Q2 2026. We hold four patents filed on the core architecture. We are targeting the $162B market (2025, growing to $450B by 2030) for ultrafast decision-making across high-frequency trading, electronic warfare, communications and forward error correction, industrial process control, and AI acceleration: markets where every nanosecond of latency has measurable value. Hartley was founded by Josh Silverstone, whose earlier work laid foundational IP for PsiQuantum and built one of the first photonic quantum computing labs. The founding team includes five PhDs in photonics, physics, and computer science, advised by semiconductor and computing veterans including Prof Bhavin Shastri and Prof David May FRS. We are building the manufacturing, packaging, integration, and field-trial partnerships needed to bring nanosecond-class AI into production silicon.

The first session, hosted by Wang Wentang, was titled Effective Communication Empowers Business. The 'Cadre Grand Classroom' is a series of capability-building platforms for the company's core management talent. about: Heronic Technologies is automating the design of bespoke AI-semiconductor hardware. Drawing on many years of research into hardware acceleration of AI algorithms at Imperial College London, the team are redesigning the next generation of AI processors by addressing the compute occupancy limitations of current AI chips at an architectural level. Heronic offers a portfolio of specialised Semiconductor IP for specific applications and optimised for deployment on FPGA and ASIC designs, with customisable objectives ranging from low-latency to resource-minimal strategies. Using their custom design-automation toolflow, MOSAIC, Heronic discovers the optimal accelerator design for a target AI application and technology pair, ensuring peak efficiency and a faster time to market. The team has produced numerous publications in top-tier conferences and journals, achieving state-of-the-art performance in object detection, human action recognition and image classification on FPGA devices, alongside award-winning results from AMD and a state-of-the-art result on MLCommons' MLPerf Tiny benchmark. As an Altera Solutions Acceleration Partner, Heronic has co-published a whitepaper demonstrating 1.9× greater performance over Nvidia devices 34 x lower latency, and 28x compute efficiency. Taiwan's position at the heart of the global semiconductor supply chain makes it a natural ecosystem for Heronic who is seeking partners in Taiwan to bring efficient, automated AI acceleration into next-generation FPGA and ASIC-based systems. Fabless SoC and ASIC companies building chips for real-time video and audio processing, OEMs developing systems that incorporate FPGA devices, ODM partners for developing FPGA-based processing systems, and Sales reps and distributors for semiconductor IP

about: Hydrogen-Fueled Abatement for High-Volume EPI and MOCVD GaN Established in 1993 and headquartered in Colorado, USA, HIGHVAC engineers, develops, and manufactures point-of-use abatement systems for semiconductor processes. The company creates process-driven technology based on the specific chemistries and environmental requirements of each application. Through its hydrogen-fueled abatement systems, HIGHVAC’s EcoGuard has established a specialized position in Epitaxial and MOCVD GaN applications. At SEMICON Taiwan 2026, HIGHVAC is highlighting the EcoGuard Series E and Series G—compact, single-enclosure Wet/Burn/Wet systems that use hydrogen as the combustion fuel. This industry-first platform delivers a highly stable flame profile that eliminates the flameout issues common in methane-fueled competitive systems. Together, the hydrogen-fueled burner and patented wet inlet enable the EcoGuard to handle high flows of silicon precursors including trichlorosilane without clogging, while managing hydrogen, ammonia, metal-organic compounds, corrosive byproducts, dopant gases, particulates, and reactive exhaust chemistry. The result is reduced maintenance requirements, maximized uptime, and higher throughput by minimizing unexpected downtime in high-volume manufacturing environments.

testers deliver high throughput and fault coverage without fixtures. Automated CAD-based programming enables fast setup, while 30 µm probes contact tiny points safely. Models support production, NPI, prototypes and diverse electronics.... Flying probe testing has evolved from a specialized failure analysis tool into a mission-critical solution for modern high-reliability electronics manufacturing. As PCBAs become smaller, denser, and more complex, traditional fixture-based testing faces growing technical and economic limitations. A conventional bed-of-nails fixture may require weeks of design, significant mechanical construction costs, and expensive modifications whenever a circuit layout changes. Flying probe testing eliminates these constraints by using software-guided robotic test heads to directly access test points, removing physical tooling lead times and enabling engineers to begin electrical testing directly from standard CAD design data. At its core, flying probe technology functions as a highly accurate in-circuit test (ICT) system. It verifies components such as resistors, capacitors, inductors, diodes, and integrated circuits against their electrical parameters, identifying placement errors, incorrect values, and polarity issues. Advanced signature-comparison algorithms can also detect short circuits across active circuit paths before power is applied, helping prevent damage to sensitive assemblies. Modern flying probe systems extend beyond electrical testing by integrating structural and optical inspection capabilities. High-definition vision systems perform automated optical inspection (AOI) to verify component presence, orientation, markings, and barcodes. Integrated 3D laser technology measures component height and detects defects such as tombstoning or component tilt. For complex devices including BGAs, where connections are hidden beneath the package, flying probe systems can integrate with digital boundary scan technology to validate internal connections without requiring dedicated external test pads. As electronics continue to advance, manufacturers increasingly face another challenge: the growing physical size of high-performance circuit assemblies. Server backplanes, telecommunications systems, and industrial electronics may use boards too large for conventional flying probe systems. To address this requirement, SPEA developed the 4080L, featuring the largest active flying probe test area available in the electronics manufacturing industry. Its expanded testing capacity enables manufacturers to test extra-large PCBAs that cannot be accommodated by standard flying probe platforms, reducing the need for custom bed-of-nails fixtures even for large industrial assemblies. Despite its extended test area, the SPEA 4080L maintains high speed and accuracy. A rigid natural granite chassis provides excellent vibration damping and thermal stability, minimizing alignment drift during high-speed movements. Linear motors combined with sub-micron optical encoders drive multiple independent flying heads with high acceleration and precise positioning. The system can reliably contact targets as small as 50 μm while minimizing visible witness marks through specialized soft-touch vertical velocity control. Precise force management helps protect delicate circuit traces from scratching or damage, allowing the 4080L to safely test flexible circuits, thin multilayer backplanes, and sensitive high-power modules. By integrating in-circuit measurements, power-on testing, optical inspection, thermal profiling, and a market-leading test footprint, the SPEA 4080L provides advanced electronics manufacturers with a comprehensive and versatile solution for testing increasingly large and complex circuit assemblies while maintaining high product quality. SPEA DOT800T Power Semiconductor Test System DOT800T combines ISO, AC and DC power testing in one system, supporting Silicon, GaN and SiC devices from wafer to final test. It delivers accurate dynamic, static and isolation tests in a modular, high-throughput platform for mass production.... The SPEA DOT800T Power Semiconductor Tester is designed for high-performance testing of next-generation power devices, including traditional Silicon, Silicon Carbide (SiC), and Gallium Nitride (GaN) technologies. It integrates high-voltage isolation, static DC characterization, and high-speed dynamic AC testing within a single production-ready platform, addressing the demanding voltage, current, frequency, and reliability requirements of applications such as electric vehicles, renewable energy, industrial drives, and power conversion systems. DOT800T is based on a multi-core architecture and can be configured with one to six independent test cores. Each core has its own controller and can be assigned to ISO, AC, or DC testing according to specific test requirements and production flows. Tests can run in true parallel and asynchronous mode, with each core independently managing instruments, connections, and program execution. The system is scalable and field-upgradeable, allowing manufacturers to adapt its configuration as device requirements evolve. The platform integrates specialized instrumentation for wide-bandgap semiconductor testing, supporting high voltages, high currents, high power, and high switching frequencies. High voltage and current can be supplied simultaneously, while sensitive current measurement and high-frequency digitizers provide accurate leakage and breakdown measurements. Local setup memory, embedded ramps and trigger macros, and system-wide hardware synchronization help reduce test time while maintaining reliable mixed-mode operation. Built-in alarms monitor conditions such as over-temperature, over-current, floating connections, and Kelvin contact issues. For dynamic AC testing, DOT800T supports voltages from 2 kV to 4 kV, pulse currents up to 3 kA, and short-circuit testing up to 10 kA. Up to eight independently programmable gate-drive circuits and 2-to-8 multi-pulse sequences enable detailed evaluation of switching behavior, thermal decay, and gate characteristics. Precision Grinding Tools for Difficult-to-Machine Materials IBARAKI GRINDING WHEEL is a specialized manufacturer of precision grinding tools. We develop and manufacture resinoid ultrathin cut-off wheels, diamond and CBN electroplated tools, and patented wire-mesh grinding wheels. From silicon and fine ceramics to composite materials, we help customers improve machining quality, efficiency, and material utilization. Ultrathin cut-off wheels and electroplated tools are manufactured at our factory in Joso City, Japan. Key processes—from forming and electroplating to finishing and inspection—are managed in-house under an ISO 9001:2015-certified quality management system. We support custom products, small-lot prototypes, and volume production. We combine three distinct grinding-tool technologies—ultrathin cut-off wheels, electroplated tools, and wire-mesh grinding wheels—to address a wide range of machining challenges. Our strength lies in designing tools around the workpiece material, required shape, machine specifications, and target quality. Diamond & CBN Electroplated Tools Custom-designed electroplated tools for difficult-to-machine materials and complex shapes.... Diamond or CBN abrasive grains are fixed in a single layer onto a metal body by nickel electroplating. The high grain concentration and large grain exposure provide sharp cutting action and efficient chip removal. We design custom tools based on drawings, workpiece materials, machine conditions, and required accuracy. Complex shapes, prototypes, small lots, and volume production are available. Silicon, SiC, GaN, and electronic component materials Components for semiconductor manufacturing equipment and FPD manufacturing equipment Custom tools for equipment integration Patented wheel design with superior chip evacuation — efficient, high-quality machining of difficult-to-cut materials.... CFRP (carbon-fiber-reinforced plastic), alumina, and optical glass have long been regarded as difficult to grind: poor chip evacuation causes the wheel to clog, making high-efficiency, high-quality machining hard to achieve. The wire-mesh grinding wheel employs a patented design in which diamond is electroplated onto a wire mesh or an ultra-thin base metal. The resulting high chip-evacuation performance enables machining of these difficult-to-cut materials with high efficiency, high quality, and low cost. In CFRP, the diamond grains shear the carbon fibers finely—as if shaving through them—while in brittle materials such as alumina and optical glass they remove stock in fine increments. This suppresses burrs, delamination, and chipping, delivering a high-quality finish.

about: Infiniflux is a deep tech startup developing advanced 2-phase Direct-to-Die Liquid Cooling technologies for the most powerful 2.5D and 3D chips used in AI and HPC data centres. Infiniflux’s technology provides advanced heat removal, targeting hotspots on processor dies to eliminate heat spikes, enhance compute capacity, and extend device lifespan. This breakthrough supports next-generation chips with higher densities and duty cycles. The superior cooling performance is based on a patent-pending cold plate design with 75% lower thermal resistance and a unique system architecture that requires much less pump energy. The system removes significantly more heat than single-phase liquid cooling, uses less energy and requires virtually no maintenance. The technology is suitable for both new build data centres and retrofits. Infiniflux has secured equity investment from Zinc VC and grant funding from Innovate UK, the Royce and the Grantham Institutes, ensuring strong foundations for growth. The company recently won the IC Taiwan Grand Challenge award, showcased at Innovex/Computex, and is experiencing significant interest from leading semiconductor and compute ecosystem players in Taiwan and the wider Asian region. about: The Global Leader in Test Contactor Solutions. JOHNSTECH INTERNATIONAL is a global R&D leader in the field of semiconductor testing, providing reliable, cost-effective testing solutions for automotive, commercial, and industrial applications. Founded in 1991 by David Johnson, Johnstech works hand-in-hand with the world’s most respected OSATs, foundries, and IDMs to develop the most precise and dependable test contactors on the marketplace today. Johnstech International to Showcase Advanced Test Contactor Solutions at SEMICON Taiwan Minneapolis, Minnesota, USA – Johnstech International, a global leader in precision semiconductor test contactors and solutions, will present its latest high-performance test technologies at SEMICON Taiwan 2026, held September 2–4 at the Taipei Nangang Exhibition Center. Building on more than three decades of innovation in semiconductor test, Johnstech will highlight new advancements that help customers maximize yield, reduce cost of test, and accelerate time-to-market across automotive, industrial, AI, RF, and high-speed digital applications. Since 1991, Johnstech has set the standard for test contactors that deliver low, stable contact resistance, robust tri-temperature performance, and exceptional long-term reliability. The company partners closely with leading OSATs, foundries, and IDMs worldwide to solve complex test challenges for devices in packages such as BGA, LGA, QFN, DFN, QFP, and WLCSP. At SEMICON Taiwan 2026, Johnstech will emphasize how its patented contact technologies and engineering expertise enable higher first-pass yields, longer maintenance intervals, and improved test repeatability in demanding production environments. At the show, Johnstech will feature its HERØHC® and HERØHF® spring probe solutions for system-level test, high-speed digital, and high-frequency applications, which are designed to improve compliance to warped devices, reduce dependence on elastomer-based sockets, and minimize insertion loss for accurate high-speed measurements. The company will also highlight HERØCOAX™ for stable signal integrity in demanding high-speed channels, along with its VROL® solid contact families, which provide self-cleaning wiping action, low and reliable contact resistance over life, and longer intervals between cleaning to boost uptime and reduce overall cost of test. In addition, Johnstech’s J-Tuned® performance-optimization services help customers improve signal integrity, accelerate characterization, and de-risk test hardware designs for RF, precision analog, and AI-related devices. Johnstech’s solutions are engineered to support tri-temperature, high-current, and high-frequency test conditions common in AI accelerators, safety-critical automotive systems, industrial controls, and advanced communications devices. The HERØ product family addresses challenges such as DUT warpage, tight pitches, and aggressive data rates, helping customers maintain signal integrity while achieving strong mechanical robustness and test stability. For RF, precision analog, and power applications, Johnstech’s ROL® and VROL® solid contact technologies deliver superior current-carrying capability and lower insertion loss than comparable spring probe solutions of similar pitch. With a global engineering team and expanded manufacturing capabilities, Johnstech delivers consistent quality and resilient supply to OSATs, foundries, and device makers around the world. The company has strengthened its local support in Asia, including Taiwan, to provide faster response times, collaborative design engagement, and on-site assistance throughout the test development and production lifecycle. This combination of local presence and global R&D leadership positions Johnstech as a trusted partner for customers seeking to upgrade legacy sockets, qualify new packages, or migrate to higher frequencies and more complex system-level test strategies. SEMICON Taiwan remains one of the most influential semiconductor events in the region, connecting the global supply chain and spotlighting advanced manufacturing, heterogeneous integration, compound semiconductors, auto chips, smart manufacturing, sustainability, and workforce development. Johnstech invites show attendees to visit us in booth J2755 at the Taipei Nangang Exhibition Center to explore its HERØ®, VROL®, and J-Tuned® portfolios, discuss specific high-speed digital, RF, power, AI, and automotive test challenges with Johnstech engineers, and learn how optimized test contactor specifications and solid-contact technologies can improve yield, extend maintenance intervals, and reduce the total cost of test. To schedule a meeting at SEMICON Taiwan 2026, visitors are encouraged to contact their regional Johnstech sales representative or reach out to the Johnstech marketing team via the contact information on johnstech.com. Founded in 1991 and headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota, Johnstech International provides innovative, high-performance precision test contactors and related solutions to semiconductor manufacturers worldwide. The company’s mission is to deliver reliable, cost-effective, and customizable test solutions that ensure customer success across a broad range of applications, from AI and high-speed digital to automotive, industrial, and consumer electronics. Kelvin Quantum brings semiconductor technology into the cold. Kelvin Quantum develops the electronics layer that quantum technology has been missing: readout and control systems engineered to operate at the same ultra-low temperatures as the quantum processors and sensors they serve. Our Cryo-CMOS hardware runs continuously from room temperature down to deep cryogenic conditions, eliminating one of the most stubborn bottlenecks on the path to scalable quantum systems. We design from the chip up. Our expertise spans mixed-signal and analogue RF ASICs — including cryogenic-capable DACs, ADCs, mixers, and amplifiers — through to in-fridge FPGA platforms, electronic sub-systems, and complete packaged solutions. Based in Glasgow, Scotland, we specialise in electronic verification with in-house cooling systems operating down to millikelvin temperatures — allowing us to characterise and validate every design in the exact conditions it will face in the field. By integrating electronics directly inside cryogenic refrigeration systems, we improve connectivity, reduce power consumption and noise, and enable faster, more precise measurements — simplifying system architecture so quantum manufacturers can scale toward commercially viable, large-scale machines.

about: Accelerate Innovation with Keysight Technologies Keysight Technologies is a global leader in electronic design and test solutions, empowering engineers and enterprises to accelerate innovation and bring next-generation technologies to market with confidence. With origins dating back to the founding of Hewlett-Packard in 1939 and spun off from Agilent Technologies since 2014, Keysight combines decades of measurement expertise with cutting-edge innovation. Headquartered in Santa Rosa, California, Keysight serves over 30,000 customers in more than 100 countries. The company offers a comprehensive portfolio of hardware and software tools, including oscilloscopes, BERT, spectrum analyzers, signal generators, network analyzers, RF/microwave solutions, and advanced simulation platforms, covering the entire product development cycle from early design and validation to manufacturing and deployment. In the semiconductor industry, Keysight provides critical solutions for wafer-level and package-level testing, high-speed digital validation, and signal integrity analysis. Keysight’s technologies help engineers evaluate power integrity, thermal performance, and electromagnetic compliance for advanced ICs, SoCs, chiplets, and high-bandwidth memory. Its electrical structural test (EST) tools enable precise evaluation of interconnect reliability in wirebonded and advanced packaging architectures. Keysight is also at the forefront of high-speed digital and optical testing for next-generation data centers and AI infrastructure. Its platforms support development and validation of 112G, 224G, and emerging 448G interconnects, along with cutting-edge interfaces such as PCIe 6.0/7.0, USB4, CXL, and PAM4 SerDes. These solutions are vital for enabling the performance, scalability, and reliability required in hyperscale computing and AI workloads. Through close collaboration with industry leaders and ongoing investment in R&D, Keysight continues to drive breakthroughs in measurement science, delivering trusted solutions that shape the future of connectivity, computation, and intelligent systems.

Welcome to Latentek—exploring SiC innovation together. was founded in 2004 and headquartered in Taoyuan, Taiwan, Latent Technologies Inc. has over two decades of experience in the wide bandgap (WBG) compound semiconductor industry. The company specializes in silicon carbide (SiC) technologies and is dedicated to delivering one-stop solutions spanning materials, equipment, and process integration. With additional operations in Hsinchu and Shanghai, Latent serves a global customer base in semiconductors and high-power electronics. Leveraging its expertise in high-temperature materials and crystal growth processes, Latent’s business scope extends across the semiconductor value chain from upstream materials to equipment solutions. Its portfolio includes crystal growth furnaces, graphite materials, crucibles, wafer inspection systems, automation equipment, and critical components such as sensors and valves. The company also provides graphite purification and gas recycling systems, building strong capabilities in advanced process integration. In 2018, Latent introduced Taiwan’s first PVA graphite purification systems, further strengthening its material processing expertise. In 2020, the company established its wholly owned subsidiary, , to expand into SiC materials. LEAP focuses on SiC wafers, epitaxial (epi) wafers, and related process services. Through this strategic expansion, the group has built a solid foundation covering materials, crystal growth, wafer processing, and epitaxy within the SiC supply chain. about: Light Trace Photonics is a Bristol-based deep-tech start-up developing the Universal Photonic Interconnect (UPIc): ultra-high-performance fibre-chip interconnect built from the ground up for co-packaged optics (CPO) and pluggable transceiver volumes. UPIc attaches processed single-mode fibre directly to photonic chips; no micro-optics, For AI data-centre customers this is what makes CPO manufacturable. It removes the fibre-attach bottleneck that drives cost, yield loss and assembly complexity, and because the connection is detachable, modules can be reworked and serviced rather than scrapped. This is critical as optics move inside the package at hyperscale. Light Trace Photonics has demonstrated repeatable, detachable connections below 800 mdB loss with passive alignment in under three seconds, and are targeting sub-400 mdB with a clear route to millions of units. moving to reliability qualification with early customer design-in planned over the next 18 months. Light Trace was founded in 2021 by Dr Jake Biele (CEO) and Dr Dominic Sulway (CTO) and is backed by leading deep-tech investors. Advisers include Dr Anthony Yu, former VP of Silicon Photonics at GlobalFoundries. Pluggable transceiver and CPO module developers, hyperscalers and AI hardware teams for UPIc integration feasibility and product design-in Silicon photonics foundries and OSAT partners to integrate and scale toward volume manufacture, Strategic investors and industry partners to accelerate the route to high-volume production

Oxford-based clean energy company, Lux Industries (LUX), is pioneering Hydrogen-as-a-Service (HaaS). Using its modular, containerised hydrogen liquefaction technology, LUX delivers ultra-high purity, low-cost, on-site, on-demand green hydrogen to the semiconductor manufacturing industry. LUX’s patent-pending proprietary heat exchangers are 100× smaller in volume than conventional systems. This compact design enables a fully integrated containerised system capable of producing, liquefying, storing, and supplying green liquid hydrogen directly at the point of use, eliminating the need for transport and dramatically reducing costs and emissions. At TRL 6, LUX has successfully demonstrated a working cryogenic heat-exchanger prototype capable of producing 100 kg of liquid hydrogen per day, with the capacity to scale to 1000 kg/ day for large-scale semiconductor facilities. about: Manz Asia delivers semiconductor equipment and solutions built on core technologies in wet chemistry, plating, inkjet printing, automation, and software integration. Our expertise covers advanced packaging (High-Density PLP FOPLP) and IC substrate processing (glass and organic core), supporting customers from R&D to high-volume manufacturing. Through system solutions, contract manufacturing, and sales representation, we help customers accelerate time-to-market, boost yield, and stay competitive in the fast-evolving semiconductor industry. Manz Asia Pioneers Production-Proven 310/510/700 mm ECD and Wet Process Solutions for Panel-Level Packaging Enabling scalable RDL manufacturing for CoPoS, FOPLP and Glass Core TGV applications Taoyuan, Taiwan – August 18, 2026 – Manz Asia, a leading provider of semiconductor advanced packaging equipment and process solutions, has pioneered production-proven ECD (electrochemical deposition) platforms supporting 310 mm, 510 mm, and 700 mm panel formats. Building on ECD as a core technology, Manz Asia integrates key wet process tools—including cleaning, developing, etching, and stripping—into the Omni 310, Omni 510, and Omni 700 platforms to enable scalable panel-level RDL manufacturing. Extending RDL Process Value from Established Applications to Next-Generation Advanced Packaging As AI and advanced computing drive increasingly complex chiplet-based architectures, larger interposers and substrates are becoming essential to integrate more heterogeneous components within a single package. This evolution is accelerating the shift from 300 mm wafer-based manufacturing toward larger panel formats, while increasing the importance of RDL in enabling high-density interconnects across increasingly complex package architectures. With expertise spanning equipment and process integration, Manz Asia addresses evolving RDL manufacturing requirements by integrating ECD and key wet processes within a unified equipment portfolio. This approach helps manufacturers simplify process integration, reduce the complexity of managing multiple equipment suppliers, and gain greater flexibility across panel sizes and advanced packaging architectures. The Omni Series supports advanced packaging applications including FOPLP, CoPoS, and Glass Core TGV, with proven applications for PMIC and RF devices for communication and automotive markets. The platform also provides a foundation for continued technology development toward emerging AI and HPC packaging requirements. Glass Core TGV Process Enabling High-Performance Interconnects As Glass Core gains momentum in next-generation advanced packaging, TGV (Through-Glass Via) manufacturing requires precise glass micromachining, microvia formation, metallization, and high-aspect-ratio filling. Manz Asia is extending its etching and ECD technologies to address these requirements. Its glass etching equipment supports substrates up to 0.4 mm thick and microvias down to 20 μm, with TGV structures featuring aspect ratios of up to 1:20, enabling precise and controlled via formation.
