about: Precision Dispensing Systems for Electronics Manufacturing marco System Analysis and Development (Germany) provides complete, precision dispensing systems for electronics manufacturing. We develop and build our own piezo-actuated valves, custom valve seats, and bubble-free material supply systems – optimized for stable, high-speed dispensing of adhesives, solder paste, underfill, and coatings. Our systems support both contact and non-contact dispensing, combined with inline optical inspection for closed-loop process control. Integration into gantry platforms or custom automation lines is handled in-house – including hardware, control software, and vision systems. This ensures maximum reliability, process stability, and throughput efficiency – even in demanding, high-volume electronics production environments. From prototyping to series production: high repeatability, reliable fluid handling, and full process integration – all from a single source. Bubble-Free. Worry-Free. Complete Dispensing Solutions from marco. Presented by marco System Analysis and Development – Booth # Precision dispensing isn’t just about valves and gantry systems – it’s about solving real production challenges. Whether you need to eliminate air bubbles, apply exact micro-dots, or scale from prototyping to high volume production, marco delivers fully integrated solutions tailored to your production process. At the SEMICON Taiwan 2026 Show, marco presents its latest complete dispensing solutions – a modular system that includes dispensing valves and dispensing heads, material preparation, control technology, and robotic integration into the production line, all built to work seamlessly together. Solving the biggest challenges in precision dispensing Challenge 1: Air bubbles compromise quality. Air-free dispensing starts with the right material preparation. Using vacuum , media is conditioned before it ever reaches the valve. This ensures bubble-free applications for even the most sensitive adhesives and sealants. Challenge 2: Pulsation affects micro-dispensing accuracy. The PushMembrane system delivers continuous, pulsation-free media flow – ideal for high-viscosity or shear-sensitive materials. Combined with the SJet Power valve, it guarantees stable volumes and repeatable dispensing. Challenge 3: Complex dispensing paths cause timing errors. With synchronized motion and dispensing, marco’s DCU (Dispensing Control Unit) ensures perfect timing between robot movement and valve activation – critical for clean starts, sharp stops, and accurate line paths. Challenge 4: Too many vendors, too much complexity. As a single-source partner, marco provides complete dispensing systems – including gantry robots (like marc0 and marc3), valve technology, software, and monitoring. One system. One contact. Full responsibility. Contact or Non-Contact Dispensing – Matched to Your Process Speed, control, and precision: marco supports both contact and non-contact dispensing, depending on your production needs. Both methods use piezo-operated micro-dispensing valves with marco’s proprietary TorqueBlock technology. uses high-speed jetting to apply adhesives, greases, liquid metals, or selective conformal coatings precisely without touching the substrate. It is ideal for electronics, optics, and automotive assemblies. applies the material through a dispensing needle directly onto the substrate. It is well-suited for applications such as grease dispensing on mechanical parts, structural bonding, and the application of sealing beads – wherever controlled material placement is required. With interchangeable valve seats and modular control, switching between dispensing methods is seamless — without reengineering the system. A complete system – built for you Each application is unique. That’s why marco tailors its solutions to your exact production parameters – from part geometry to takt time and material behavior. Our engineers test, validate, and configure the ideal combination of: Dispensing valve and valve seats (degassing tanks, temperature control) (DCU, cameras, software integration) Whether you're dispensing on a single station or integrating into a fully automated line, marco system delivers the same promise: bubble-free results, reliable performance, and scalable system architecture. Visit marco System Analysis and Development at booth no. R7112/8 to experience live how a dispensing system becomes a solution – from air-free preparation to perfect, traceable results. If you’re unable to visit us at our booth, you can find more information on our website https://www.marco-systems.com/en/ Let’s solve your dispensing challenge, together. High-precision gantry system with integrated calibration and maintenance station. Designed for flexible use in standalone and benchtop environments, to change from manual to semi-automatic manufacturing. Increasing quality and decreasing production time.... is a compact, high-precision dispensing platform for standalone and benchtop production. The robust gantry frame enables dynamic movement with up to 2g acceleration and ±5 μm reproducibility. The worktable includes mounting points for conveyor belts or custom fixtures, making it suitable for automated loading and unloading. An integrated station in front of the work area supports calibration and maintenance tasks. It can be equipped with a variety of combination of components, such as vacuum suction tool for purging, nozzle cleaning station, a touch sensor for position detection, and a Lookup Camera for visual inspection. Whether as a benchtop unit or a stand-alone machine , marc0 Gantry System delivers stable, repeatable dispensing performance for advanced applications. Compact 3-liter tank with integrated Venturi vacuum generator for handling low-viscosity materials. Milled from a single steel block for optimal cleaning and performance in precision dispensing applications.... is designed for low-viscosity media in precision dispensing systems. Its body consists of a milled steel block, allowing for easy cleaning. An integrated Venturi nozzle generates vacuum levels down to 300 mbar, supporting efficient material handling and degassing. For deeper vacuum requirements, an external vacuum pump can be connected directly to the lid. The tank is compact and modular, making it easy to integrate into various production environments. Combined with marco systems’ in-house developed pressure booster pump, the tank ensures a constant and controlled supply of media to the dispensing system. Its clean design and reliable vacuum generation make it ideal for semiconductor or electronics assembly applications where material purity and process control are essential. Compact system for dispensing polyurethane-based hot melt adhesives. With zoned heating, ,  and a modular valve design, it ensures clean, consistent and high-speed dispensing even for reactive materials.... is designed for high-precision dispensing of reactive polyurethane-based hot melt adhesives. I t features a modular dispensing valve and a 30 cc heated tank, divided into three heating zones to progressively melt the material to the ideal dispensing temperature. The dispensing valve operates at up to 4000 Hz for fast, repeatable application of lines or dots as small as 0.3 mm. The entire system is modular - each component in contact with the medium can be easily removed, cleaned or replaced. This design ensures stable processing, minimal downtime and consistent results. Ideal for semiconductor and electronics applications where precise, clean adhesive dispensing is essential. Precise two-component mixing head and dispensing unit in one. With static or dynamic mixers, marco systems’ 2C mixing head ensures homogeneity, optimizes processes, and reduces waste. Dispensing is possible directly or via a separate dispensing head.... marco systems’ two-component mixing head combines precise mixing and dispensing in a single compact unit. Unlike conventional systems that require separate mixing and dispensing steps, the 2C mixing head blends the components directly before application. Stepper motors control the feed rates with volumetric tolerances of less than 0.5%, ensuring precise ratios even with challenging materials. This design prevents curing inside the machine or lines – only the disposable mixing helix contacts the mixed medium. Dynamic mixing options with a separate motor are available for applications with extreme mixing ratios or high demands on homogeneity. Specially developed modular mixing spirals enable consistent and reproducible results. An optional automatic changeover system supports increased automation. The compact design streamlines dosing processes and helps reduce material waste, downtime, and maintenance effort. marco systems‘ PushMembrane – A Pressure Stabilize The PushMembrane stabilizes pressure in the fluid supply between tank and valve. It ensures consistent dispensing performance even with fluctuating upstream pressure or longer distances between tank and dispensing head.... In precision dispensing, even small pressure fluctuations can cause dosing errors, especially with sensitive materials or long fluid lines. Common issues like pressure spikes, flow surges or unstable tank pressure often lead to inconsistent results. solves this by stabilizing the pressure between material supply and dispensing head. A controlled pneumatic-oil reservoir applies consistent force to the fluid via a flexible membrane. When the internal volume decreases, an inlet valve refills the membrane—without interrupting flow. This ensures the dispensing valve always operates under stable pressure, regardless of tank distance or upstream pressure behavior. The PushMembrane is installed inline between the tank and valve, making it an effective upgrade for improving accuracy and repeatability in any advanced microdispensing setup. Dispensing Valves SJet and SJet Power SJet and SJet Power are high-speed piezo dispensing valves for contact and non-contact applications. Their modular design supports low- to high-viscosity materials, ensuring precise, reliable dispensing in PCB and semiconductor assembly.... are marco’s high-speed piezo dispensing valves for contact and non-contact dispensing. The SJet Power valve is more powerful, has a more rigid design and was developed for highly viscous materials. Interchangeable valve seats meet fluid and process requirements. A precision actuator enables ultra-fast, reliable dispensing with a volume tolerance of less than 1%. The modular design supports a wide range of fluids and makes the valves ideal for semiconductor processes requiring speed and accuracy. Whether jetting or needle dispensing, both ensure consistent results. They can be supplied from a cartridge or combined with a pressure tank system. The proprietary marco piezo drive guarantees a service life of 1,000,000,000 cycles. High frequency and durability reduce downtime, improve throughput and lower costs. The valves handle low- to high-viscosity materials and are ideal for underfill, dam & fill and conformal coating in PCB and semiconductor assembly.

The system also helps manufacturers reduce operational costs and energy consumption, making it well-suited for modern semiconductor manufacturing environments. Complementing this solution is Eco-Mask, an advanced coating mask technology engineered for a wide range of semiconductor applications. Eco-Mask offers excellent plasma and thermal resistance, with thickness capabilities ranging from micron to millimeter levels. The solution can be fully customized to accommodate different viscosity requirements and provides excellent adhesion across various material surfaces. In addition, Eco-Mask is water-soluble and can be easily removed using a DI water rinse, supporting both spray and spin coating processes. Mindox Techno also offers ShieldOx, a copper passivation coating solution developed to protect against copper corrosion while enhancing durability in harsh operating environments. The inhibitor coating improves copper reliability, structural integrity, and bonding performance in advanced semiconductor devices. Through automated coating capabilities and precise passivation control, ShieldOx helps extend the lifespan of wire-bonded devices and supports long-term device reliability. Another key solution in the company’s portfolio is Luminox, a vertical vacuum reflow oven featuring a fully automated and integrated module capable of achieving vibration-free and void-free solder reflow processing within a single chamber. The system supports low-temperature reflow processing under both vacuum and atmospheric conditions while maintaining a compact, space-saving design. Its flexible architecture also allows seamless integration into a variety of production modules and manufacturing lines. Mindox Techno’s platform solutions are designed to enhance manufacturing efficiency while reducing energy consumption, enabling semiconductor manufacturers to scale operations sustainably without compromising performance. The company’s wafer, frame, and panel load port systems support substrates ranging from 100 mm to 300 mm wafers and provide a single adaptable platform capable of handling multiple applications. By reducing the need for multiple setups, the system helps streamline operations and improve overall manufacturing efficiency. Designed for high throughput and low particle generation, the SEMI-compliant standardized platform offers a low cost of ownership while enabling seamless integration into existing manufacturing lines. Advanced wafer mapping capabilities ensure precise substrate handling throughout complex production processes, and customizable configurations allow the platform to adapt to specific operational requirements. Mindox Techno’s standard and customized EFEM (Equipment Front End Module) solutions are engineered to optimize substrate handling and process flow, helping manufacturers improve throughput and reduce operational complexity. The modular platform supports flexible configurations tailored to various production environments while complying with cleanroom ISO standards. It provides reliable wafer handling for substrates ranging from 100 mm to 300 mm, as well as panel handling capabilities from 300 x 300 mm to 600 x 600 mm. Integrated software solutions support GEM300 and the latest factory automation standards while maintaining cost-efficient implementation options. The company also offers advanced Vacuum Transfer Modules (VTM), which play a critical role in semiconductor manufacturing and scientific applications that require controlled vacuum environments. These systems enable secure and contamination-free material Driving Smarter and More Sustainable Manufacturing From concept to execution, Mindox Techno focuses on building systems that work faster, smarter, and cleaner. The company continues to invest in advanced automation, intelligent process control, and sustainable engineering solutions that help semiconductor manufacturers meet the growing demands of the global electronics industry. Mindox Techno is a global supplier of custom-engineered semiconductor manufacturing solutions serving both front-end and back-end semiconductor processes. The company provides integrated automation platforms, advanced process equipment, AI-driven predictive control technologies, and scalable manufacturing systems designed to improve productivity, precision, and sustainability across semiconductor operations worldwide.

The only tool on the market that allows users to prototype and enter mid-volume production in one step. With our flagship mask-less thermal lithography tool users can expect high resolution and throughput without the added cost in time and capital that traditional step and scan sys tems provide. The ANU-1 will allow users to innovate at unprecedented speeds putting your cleanroom or fab in front of the competition.

about: Advanced Coating Solution for Semiconductor Manufacturing Founded in 1999 and headquartered in Singapore, NTI Nanofilm is a global leader in nanotechnology solutions, specialising in advanced coatings, thin-film equipment, nanofabrication, and hydrogen fuel cell innovations. Leveraging proprietary technologies, the company enhances product performance, durability, and sustainability across industries, including electronics, automotive, medical, and industrial applications. With a strong international footprint, NTI Nanofilm operates offices and facilities in Singapore, Vietnam, China, Japan, India, and Germany, serving customers worldwide with cutting-edge materials science and precision engineering solutions. Listed on the Singapore Exchange since 2020, NTI Nanofilm is committed to driving innovation and sustainability in high-performance coatings and advanced materials. NTI Nanofilm’s FCVA batch coating equipment supports semiconductor backend packaging parts such as cavity bars, lead frames, precision tooling and ESD coating applications, delivering low friction, wear resistance and process stability.... NTI Nanofilm’s FCVA Batch System integrates proprietary FCVA thin-film coating technology with a flexible multi-source configuration, including an FCVA source, an ion-beam source, a magnetron-sputtering source, and pulsed DC bias. The system delivers dense, uniform and high-quality coatings for semiconductor backend packaging and precision manufacturing applications. Its patented double-bend electromagnetic filtration system removes macro particles, enabling smooth, clean ta-C coatings with strong wear resistance, anti-sticking performance, corrosion protection, and low friction. Dedicated coating recipes support cavity bars, lead frames, precision tooling, ESD coating applications and other complex parts. Drum-based planetary motion supports uniform coating on 3D objects and different substrate materials, while coating temperature below 100 °C expands suitability for heat-sensitive and dimension-critical components. The fully automated system supports efficient production, consistent coating quality and a coating range up to 1,300 Ø x 900 H mm. NTI Nanofilm’s FCVA LoadLock Mold Coater applies ultra-smooth ta-C/DLC coatings on wafer chucks, helping reduce particle generation, improve wear resistance, support stable release and maintain clean contact surfaces in semiconductor manufacturing.... NTI Nanofilm’s FCVA Load Lock Mold Coater is designed for wafer chucks, precision molds and critical semiconductor components that require ultra-smooth ta-C coatings with ultra-low particles, clean contact surfaces, wear resistance and stable release performance. Its separated load lock and process chambers reduce vacuum cycle time while helping limit contamination. A key USP is NTI Nanofilm’s proprietary X-Bend filtration technology, which removes macro particles during FCVA deposition to enable cleaner, smoother and more particle-controlled coatings for semiconductor manufacturing. The system supports FCVA, magnetron sputtering and ion beam options for flexible coating development and production needs. A self-rotating, angle-tunable, and biasable substrate holder improves coating uniformity on complex parts, while room-temperature coating without added heat expands suitability for heat sensitive and dimension critical components. With a 12 inch coating range, the system supports larger molds and broader semiconductor production requirements. MiCC® uses patented FCVA technology to deposit ultra-thin chromium nitride ceramic coatings for cavity bars and precision molds, reducing sticking, supporting smooth release and improving wear resistance, tool life and productivity.... MiCC® is NTI Nanofilm’s nanocrystalline chromium nitride ceramic coating developed for semiconductor backend packaging tools. Using patented FCVA technology, MiCC® forms a dense protective layer with low surface energy, low friction and smooth release performance to help reduce material sticking on critical tooling surfaces. With high hardness and strong surface durability, MiCC® helps protect cavity bars, precision molds and backend tooling from deformation, scratches and wear caused by repeated production and cleaning cycles. This supports longer tool lifespan, reduced cleaning frequency, fewer defects and improved productivity. MiCC® is suitable for semiconductor packaging components where anti-sticking performance, wear resistance, surface cleanliness and stable release are required. Thermal Stability Coating F-TAC NTI Nanofilm’s F-TAC coating protects the inner contact surfaces of lead frame carriers during clamping, high temperature baking and thermal handling, supporting stable processing and easy release while reducing sticking, tearing and lead frame warpage.... NTI Nanofilm’s F-TAC coating is engineered for lead frame carriers used in high-temperature semiconductor backend processes such as baking and thermal handling. During production, carriers clamp and hold thin lead frames in position. Conventional PTFE, silicone and selected hard coatings may soften, degrade or create higher friction under heat, causing sticking during release, lead frame tearing, warpage, frequent cleaning and downtime. F-TAC protects the carrier’s inner contact surfaces with an ultra-low-friction and heat-resistant coating. It supports stable clamping during high-temperature processing and helps lead frames release cleanly after processing, reducing adhesion-related damage and process interruption. With heat resistance above 265 °C, low friction below 0.1, contact angle above 110 ° and longer coating lifespan than traditional coatings, F-TAC helps reduce cleaning cycles, improve uptime, lower scrap risk and support more stable semiconductor packaging productivity. Wear Resistance Coating TAC-ON® NTI Nanofilm’s TAC-ON® ta-C coating protects wafer lapping carriers, wire and wedge bonding tools, and precision tooling with high hardness, low friction and smooth surfaces to reduce wear and particle adhesion, supporting longer tool life.... NTI Nanofilm’s TAC-ON® coating is an FCVA based ta-C coating solution designed for semiconductor backend tools and precision components that require high hardness, low friction and ultra-smooth surface performance. It is suitable for wafer lapping carriers, wire bonding capillaries, wedge bonding tools, precision tooling and other critical contact components. In semiconductor backend processes, repeated contact, sliding and abrasive interaction can cause tool wear, particle adhesion, surface damage and unstable process performance. TAC-ON® helps protect functional surfaces by forming a dense and smooth carbon-based coating that reduces friction and wear while maintaining surface cleanliness. With a hardness of around 40 GPa, a friction coefficient around 0.1 and strong wear resistance, TAC-ON® supports longer tool life, fewer replacements, reduced particle-related issues and more stable production yield. Its low-temperature FCVA process also expands suitability for precision and dimension-critical components. NTI Nanofilm’s ESD coating provides FCVA-based anti-static protection for wafer contact components such as chucks, end effectors and metrology/testing fixtures, helping dissipate static charge during wafer transfer, holding and inspection.... NTI Nanofilm’s ESD coating is an FCVA-based anti-static discharge coating for semiconductor wafer contact components that require controlled charge dissipation, clean surfaces and reliable handling. It is suitable for wafer chucks, end effectors, metrology and testing fixtures, carrier parts and other components that contact wafers during transfer, holding and inspection. Static charge on tooling surfaces can attract particles and increase the risk of ESD-related defects. ASD coating provides a controlled conductive surface to help dissipate charge gradually while reducing static-induced particle adhesion on critical contact areas. Applied at room temperature, ASD coating is suitable for ceramics, metals, elastomers and temperature-sensitive components. With tunable surface resistivity from 10^5 to 10^9 Ω/sq, it can be adjusted to different ESD protection needs while supporting cleaner wafer handling, lower contamination risk and more stable process performance.

about: Nanosurf is a company that thrives on challenges at the frontier of what is physically achievable. By concentrating our collective efforts on the obstacles that stand in the way of advancements in nanotechnology, we enable researchers to push the boundaries in their respective fields of science. We integrate cutting-edge scanning probe technology into the value chain of industrial customers by crafting custom machines that seamlessly blend into their manufacturing processes. Our bespoke solutions not only meet the unique needs of each client but also enhance efficiency and precision in their production lines. Established in 1997, Nanosurf defined ease of use in scanning probe microscopy by miniaturizing the size of a scanning probe microscope to fit a coffee table. Since then, the Swiss-based company has matured into one of the leading innovators in atomic force microscopy. Nanosurf provides continually evolving instrument platforms for academic researchers and industry applications in life science and materials science, as well as large-scale customized industrial solutions for use in production lines with very demanding accuracy specifications. Nanosurf will continue to focus development efforts on new measurement modes and technologies that make atomic force microscopes an easier, faster, and more reliable tool. It is also our mission to bring the technique to an ever-increasing range of new application areas by making it as accessible and intuitive to new users as more common technologies such as optical microscopy. Together, we tackle the challenge.

We deliver exceptional quality that exceeds expectations, building lasting partnerships and growing together with our customers. At NANOSYS, we specialize in developing and manufacturing high-precision test pins and test sockets using our proprietary technology. With a commitment to innovation and customization, we provide cutting-edge testing solutions tailored to the diverse and evolving needs of the semiconductor industries. Our products are engineered to deliver exceptional reliability and enable a stable testing environment, empowering our customers to achieve unparalleled accuracy and efficiency in the final test. - Test socket for Semiconductor IC Package - Test fixture for camera module - Proprietary Technology: Innovative designs that push the boundaries of testing capabilities. - Tailored Solutions: Custom-manufactured products to meet the specific needs of our customers.

about: Welcome to visit us at booth T9201 Founded in 2020, Nantong Weiteng Semiconductor is a high-tech enterprise integrating the R&D, production and sales of high-precision dicing blades for wafer-level processing. The company delivers full-process precision dicing solutions to clients, enabling improved dicing quality and reduced production costs. It has become an accredited supplier of high-precision dicing blades, dicing tapes and customized dicing solutions for numerous leading enterprises at home and abroad. In 2023, Nantong Weiteng launched its special semiconductor materials project with a total investment of nearly tens of millions of RMB. The project covers newly-built workshops and auxiliary buildings spanning 34,000 square meters, boasting an annual output capacity of over one million dicing blades, ranking among the top in China. The firm holds 31 patented technologies and has won multiple awards at national, provincial and municipal scientific and technological competitions as well as entrepreneurship contests. Its completed R&D project for ultra-thin wafer dicing blades achieves an ultra-thin blade thickness below 9 micrometers via proprietary craftsmanship, with product performance reaching world-leading standards. Process Upgrade! Weiteng Semiconductor’s High-end Ultra-thin Wafer Dicing Blades Achieve High-quality Mass Production and Commercial Application Recently, Nantong Weiteng Semiconductor has completed technological iteration. Its self-developed ultra-thin wafer dicing blades have seen comprehensive performance upgrades, which optimize the dicing process for ultra-thin wafers and ultra-narrow dicing streets. Fully compliant with the high precision and high yield requirements of advanced packaging, the products fill the gap in high-precision cutting consumables. Conventional dicing blades are prone to chipping, micro-cracks, rapid wear and precision deviation, failing to meet the stringent production standards for 5G, AI, automotive and power chips, and hindering quality improvement in packaging mass production. Targeting industry pain points, Weiteng Semiconductor has optimized material formulas and ultra-precision forming processes to launch high-precision and highly stable ultra-thin wafer dicing blades. The products enable stable cutting of ultra-narrow dicing streets as narrow as 28μm, with blade uniformity and concentricity reaching advanced industry standards. They effectively eliminate chipping, delamination and micro-cracks during dicing, greatly boosting chip dicing yield. The upgraded formulas of diamond grains and bonding agents also deliver notably enhanced wear resistance and service life, making the blades suitable for mass production of 12-inch wafers. Compatible with silicon wafers, silicon carbide and other semiconductor materials, the products support chip mass production for consumer electronics, new energy vehicles, industrial control, AI and other sectors. They effectively address the industry challenges of insufficient precision and poor stability in ultra-precision dicing, and provide strong support for efficiency and quality improvement of advanced packaging processes. Going forward, Nantong Weiteng Semiconductor will continue to focus on the R&D of high-precision semiconductor consumables, iterate processes and optimize products to fuel the refined and high-end development of the advanced packaging industry. Full Production Capacity! Weiteng Semiconductor’s High-end Ultra-thin Wafer Dicing Blades Put into Mass Production to Drive Advanced Packaging Industry Upgrading The intelligent production lines for ultra-thin wafer dicing blades at Nantong Weiteng Semiconductor Technology Co., Ltd. have reached full-capacity operation, fully releasing the production capacity of high-end precision dicing blades. The company’s annual output is expected to exceed 1 million pieces. It can steadily supply high-precision and ultra-thin wafer cutting consumables in bulk, fully meeting the rapidly growing market demand of domestic advanced packaging industry, and helping downstream chip production improve quality, boost efficiency and cut costs. Driven by the rapid development of end industries including 5G, new energy vehicles, artificial intelligence and the Internet of Things, the global advanced semiconductor packaging market keeps expanding. Market demand for ultra-thin chips and miniature semiconductor devices is on a steady rise. The industry has raised higher requirements for the quality, production capacity and delivery efficiency of high-precision ultra-thin wafer dicing blades, urging upstream precision consumable manufacturers to accelerate technological iteration and capacity expansion. Leveraging independently developed core technologies and intelligent manufacturing systems, the company has comprehensively upgraded its production lines for ultra-thin wafer dicing blades. The entire process, from precision proportioning of raw materials, ultra-precision forming and high-temperature curing to precision inspection, is fully automated. The production lines can mass-produce high-end dicing blades dedicated to ultra-thin wafers with an ultra-narrow dicing street of 28μm. The products have passed rigorous tests on thickness uniformity, cutting flatness and wear resistance. They are well suited for high-end scenarios such as 12-inch wafer mass production, precision cutting of ultra-thin chips and cutting of special silicon carbide materials, effectively reducing chipping, cracking and material loss during wafer dicing, and helping downstream customers raise product yield and lower production costs. Compared with traditional production modes, the new intelligent lines greatly enhance product consistency and delivery efficiency. They support standardized bulk supply and flexible production of customized products, enabling quick responses to personalized cutting demands from diverse customers, processes and application scenarios. Thanks to reliable product performance and high-quality delivery services, the company’s ultra-thin wafer dicing blades are now adopted by numerous semiconductor packaging and chip manufacturers, and widely used in consumer electronics, new energy, industrial control, automotive electronics and other fields, earning an increasingly solid market reputation. Going forward, Nantong Weiteng Semiconductor Technology Co., Ltd. will further expand production capacity, optimize manufacturing processes and elevate quality control standards. The company will keep refining its high-end ultra-thin wafer dicing blades, and support downstream semiconductor enterprises to expand production and improve efficiency with stable output, premium products and professional technical services, so as to facilitate the large-scale and high-quality development of domestic advanced packaging industry. Process Iteration & Upgrade! Weiteng Semiconductor’s Ultra-thin Wafer Dicing Blades Set a New Benchmark for Precision Cutting Nantong Weiteng Semiconductor Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on high-precision wafer dicing blades. As a high-tech enterprise specializing in the R&D, production and sales of precision semiconductor consumables, it boasts solid technological expertise and continuous innovation investment. Holding 31 core patents, the company consistently delivers high-quality cutting consumables for the packaging sector and has earned wide industry recognition for its technical strength. As a core precision consumable in semiconductor packaging, ultra-thin wafer dicing blades directly determine the yield and quality of chip dicing, serving as an indispensable supporting component for the advanced packaging industry. Micro precision cutting features stringent accuracy requirements and high R&D barriers, imposing rigorous standards on material, craftsmanship and stability of consumables. It is also a core priority for the optimization and upgrading of current advanced packaging processes. Drawing on years of industry experience and technological accumulation, Weiteng Semiconductor keeps refining the core manufacturing processes of ultra-thin wafer dicing blades. Committed to developing high-end consumables with finer precision and superior performance, the company has broken through the bottlenecks of traditional production techniques. With self-developed new material formulas and ultra-precision processing technologies, it has achieved an ultra-thin blade thickness below 9 micrometers, effectively tackling common industry challenges including edge chipping in ultra-thin cutting, poor stability in high-precision machining and low compatibility with special wafers. Backed by 31 independent patents, the company has built a complete technological system covering R&D, forming, testing and mass production, keeping its product overall performance at the advanced industry level. Thanks to sustained innovation and technological iteration, the company’s ultra-thin wafer dicing blades are well adapted to mass production of various ultra-thin wafers and ultra-narrow dicing streets. They are widely applied in high-end fields such as advanced packaging, power semiconductors and special-purpose chips, effectively improving efficiency, quality and cost control of packaging processes. The products and services have gained extensive recognition across the market. In the future, Nantong Weiteng Semiconductor Technology Co., Ltd. will further increase investment in R&D and innovation. Focusing on the segmented track of precision semiconductor consumables, it will continuously make breakthroughs in core technologies, optimize product performance and expand product portfolio. Driven by ongoing process innovation, the company will advance industrial upgrading and fuel the high-quality and refined development of the global advanced semiconductor packaging industry. about: 新元鋒精密股份有限公司（New YF Precision Co.）專注於薄膜與表面處理技術，是一家深耕台灣半導體產業的專業設備代理與技術服務商。我們提供半導體製程相關設備、材料與技術解決方案，協助客戶在高度競爭的產業中持續提升製程良率與技術水平。 公司擁有一支經驗豐富、反應快速的團隊，能針對不同產業需求，量身打造客製化的設備改機與製程升級方案，深受業界肯定。我們的技術服務涵蓋晶圓製程、光電模組、先進封裝等應用領域，並持續拓展至化合物半導體與先進顯示產業。 新元鋒精密成功開發 ALD應用於TEM 樣品處理技術，獲12吋晶圓廠及第三方實驗室廣泛採用，市占率超過九成，顯示出我們在高階樣品製備技術上的領先地位。同時，我們於 Mini LED 背光模組及Micro LED領域也取得重大成果，產品獲國際大廠採用並成功打入全球供應 在技術布局方面，公司積極投入氮化鎵（GaN）、砷化鎵（GaAs）、碳化矽（SiC）等化合物半導體，以及雷射半導體應用市場，並持續拓展至 Micro LED、Micro OLED、生醫材料等前瞻應用領域，展現跨產業整合與創新能力。 為協助客戶提升材料表面處理效能，我們引進英國 Henniker Plasma 電漿表面處理設備，其涵蓋真空電漿與大氣電漿技術，能有效執行材料表面清潔、改質、活化與鍍膜等多元製程，提升產品品質與產能表現。量機型月產能可達4吋7萬片，已獲 LED 國際大廠採用。 近期，我們與德國Sentech Instruments GmbH合作，導入原子層蝕刻（ALE）與即時厚度監測技術，專攻2D材料整合、奈米片電路與GaN HEMT製程。此技術可實現低損傷、表面平滑與高精度蝕刻，提升異質材料整合良率與電性表現，強化先進製程的商用化進程。 新元鋒精密秉持「誠信、專業、創新」的經營理念，致力於協助客戶優化製程、強化競爭力。我們不僅是一家設備代理商，更是客戶可靠的技術合作夥伴。未來，持續專注於提供一流的半導體製程設備與技術，亦引進其他先進應用科技，積極擴展更多樣性的產品線和技術服務，秉持著讓客戶信任與安心的最大宗旨，獲取最大利益，共創雙贏！

about: Ohmplus Technology focuses on high-efficiency RF and phased-array measurement technologies, delivering integrated solutions that span from R&D validation to volume production testing. The company helps electronics and semiconductor industries shorten test time and reduce overall test cost in increasingly high-frequency and complex system environments. Ohmplus’ product portfolio centers on high-throughput measurement and modular system design, covering OTA wireless testing, RF FEM group testing, and phased-array antenna development kits. Its solutions serve RF IC, RF FEM, AiP, antenna and module manufacturers, as well as customers in communications, satellite, and system integration industries. The OHM Fast OTA wireless measurement series provides comprehensive OTA testing capabilities for antennas and AiP modules, including radiation pattern characterization, beamforming performance evaluation, and 5G NR OTA testing. The system supports multi-band scanning and automated measurement control, making it suitable for per-unit functional testing in mass production of phased-array communication and radar products, as well as antenna tuning, beamforming calibration, and system-level OTA performance evaluation during the R&D stage. The OHM Fast GT-S series is a multi-site ATE group testing solution designed for RF FEM devices. Combined with Ohmplus’ self-developed phase distribution and RF switching modules, the system supports 4-site or 8-site parallel testing and integrates measurement functions such as S-parameters, output power, EVM, mask, and Wi-Fi/Bluetooth testing. Leveraging a PXI-based architecture and group-testing technology, GT-S enables high test throughput with reduced instrument configuration, making it well suited for final test (FT) of packaged RF FEM devices. In addition, Ohmplus provides phased-array antenna development kits and carbon-fiber composite CATR solutions, supplying key components to the low-Earth orbit satellite, B5G communications, defense, and RF semiconductor test supply chains. These products support next-generation high-frequency system development and measurement requirements, enabling customers to advance R&D and production in a more stable and controlled manner. OHMPLUS to Showcase Advanced RF Testing Solutions at SEMICON Taiwan 2026 will once again bring together leading innovators and technology companies from the global semiconductor industry. During this year’s exhibition, will present its latest RF testing and smart measurement solutions designed for next-generation semiconductor and wireless communication applications. At the exhibition, OHMPLUS will showcase a range of advanced technologies, including OTA phased-array testing systems, RF front-end module testing solutions, sub-mmWave antennas, and automated measurement platforms. Featured products such as the GT-S Middle Electronic Box (MEB) will demonstrate high-efficiency multi-site testing capabilities that help customers improve testing throughput, flexibility, and system integration. As semiconductor technologies continue to evolve toward higher frequencies, greater integration, and faster validation requirements, OHMPLUS remains committed to delivering reliable and scalable RF measurement solutions for R&D laboratories, production testing, and advanced wireless applications. Through participation in SEMICON Taiwan 2026, OHMPLUS looks forward to connecting with global industry professionals, partners, and customers to explore future trends in semiconductor manufacturing, AI-driven applications, and high-frequency communication technologies. OHMPLUS GT-S Middle Electronic Box (MEB) is a highly integrated signal expansion module specifically designed for RF front-end module testing. With minimal instrument configuration, it enables synchronized multi-site testing, significantly improving testing efficiency and flexibility.... The MEB provides comprehensive RF, digital, and power interfaces, allowing different test configurations based on the connected instruments. Built-in active components support a frequency range from 500 MHz to 14 GHz. Supports up to +16 dBm maximum continuous input power and delivers up to 16 dB maximum output gain. Provides synchronized testing capability for up to 8 ports, effectively increasing production throughput. Under S-parameter test mode, each port can perform Return Loss and Insertion Loss measurements. When integrated with a Vector Signal Analyzer/Generator (VSA/VSG), the system can also perform modulation signal analysis and measurement.

Welcome to OMEGA, our Booth Number:  P5221/ TaiNEX 2 歐美嘉集團由丁文中執行長於1995年創立於台北，經過二十多年的戮力經營，我們已經成長為在科學研究及專業醫療兩個領域的領先專業代理商。因應代理業務的特性，公司下轄科學儀器事業部、半導體事業部、醫療事業部、血液成分事業部及新產品事業部等業務單位，並擁有獨立的服務部為各事業部提供各類設備及儀器的保養維修服務。 集團旗下的醫療事業部主要代理Abbott CV的心臟血管塗藥支架及氣球導管，為Abbott CV在台灣的重要夥伴，長久以來我們已為無數心血管疾病患者的治療帶來巨大的貢獻。 血液成分事業部主要代理Terumo BCT的血液成分分離與採集及製藥等級的細胞複製產品，是台灣分離術血小板採集、幹細胞及單核細胞採集及複製細胞治療所需的細胞領域的最大供應商。 歐美加科技股份有限公司負責集團科學儀器及半導體事業部的業務。科學儀器事業部於超高真空產品、超低溫產品及各種量測儀器設備具有將近三十年的經驗, 已經成為台灣各大學、研究單位及業界研發單位的忠實夥伴，今年也開始代理量子訊息控制儀器，為台灣研究量子電腦的各研究單位提供方便使用的儀器。 科學儀器事業部代理經銷眾多科學研究行業的領導品牌，包括: Scienta Omicron, DCA Instruments, Kurt J. Lesker, OCI Vacuum Microengineering, UHV Design, Lake Shore Cryotronics, Attocube, Cryomech, Quorum Technologies, Linkam Scientific, Quantum Machines, Delft Circuits, Angstrom Engineering. 為能更專業的服務業界的客戶，我們成立半導體事業部，專注於先進封裝、材料分析與高階檢測應用。半導體事業部除擁有經驗豐富的業務工程師外，並配置專職的應用工程師及服務工程師，致力於為客戶提供最專業、即時且完整的技術支援與售後服務。 隨著半導體產業朝向高速運算（HPC）、人工智慧（AI）、資料中心及高速傳輸架構快速發展，先進封裝技術如 COWOS（Chip on Wafer on Substrate）與 CPO（Co-Packaged Optics）已成為市場核心趨勢。我們亦積極投入相關檢測與製程設備的推廣，協助客戶因應高密度互連、異質整合、光電整合封裝及高頻高速訊號傳輸所帶來的品質挑戰。 在 COWOS 先進封裝製程中，針對微凸塊（Micro Bump）、TSV、Hybrid Bonding、Underfill、翹曲（Warpage）、空洞（Void）及層間缺陷等關鍵品質問題，我們提供完整的非破壞性檢測解決方案；而在 CPO 光電共封裝領域，則針對光學元件與半導體晶片整合過程中的封裝精度、熱管理、材料可靠性及電性穩定性，提供高精度檢測與材料分析設備，協助客戶提升良率與可靠度。 此外，在先進封裝製程中，表面活化、去膠、除污及封裝前處理亦是影響良率的重要環節。我們代理 Astro 的 Microwave Plasma Processing 設備，專門應用於 Advanced Chip Packaging 領域，可廣泛應用於晶圓級封裝（WLP）、扇出型封裝（FOWLP）、COWOS、CPO、Hybrid Bonding 及高階基板封裝製程中。透過高效率且均勻的微波電漿技術，有效提升表面潔淨度、材料附著力及製程穩定性，進一步提升封裝可靠性與產品良率。 半導體事業部經銷代理 Nordson 的檢測產品，包括 AMI 非破壞性檢測機台、各種 Bond Tester、X 光檢測機、清潔樣品用電漿機等。我們也獨家代理 Neocera Magma，應用 SQUID 技術進行非破壞性檢測元件電路靜態缺陷（static defect）的高階檢測設備。 此外，我們亦獨家代理 DCA Instruments，提供應用於分子束磊晶（MBE）及物理氣相沉積（PVD）技術的氧化物薄膜沉積系統；同時經銷 Kurt J. Lesker 的物理氣相薄膜沉積系統（PVD）及原子層薄膜沉積系統（ALD）；Lake Shore Cryotronics 的無液氦超低溫（4K）四點探針晶片量測平台及霍爾效應量測系統。 我們相信，透過完整的產品線、專業的技術團隊，以及對 COWOS 與 CPO 等先進封裝技術趨勢的深入理解，能夠成為客戶在半導體製程、檢測與材料分析領域中最值得信賴的合作夥伴。為確保我們高品質的服務，公司投入大量的資源取得優良運銷規範 (Good Delivery Practice) 認證，確保我們的員工及協力廠商都遵守優良運銷規範準則，將我們高品質的產品依據最高標準送到我們客戶的手上。 我們在台北、新竹、台中及高雄都設有分公司，有了這些據點，我們熱忱且專業的員工可以最快的速度為客戶提供最在地及高品質的服務。 Nordson SONOSCAN / C-SAM 超音波掃描顯微鏡 Nordson's C-SAM acoustic microscopes are recognized as the benchmark for accuracy.... Nordson DAGE 4000Plus 是市場是更先進的焊接强度測試儀。 4000Plus 焊接强度測試儀確立了粘合測試領域的行業標準，代表著同類中的更佳産品，可以提供無與倫比的數據精確性和可重複性，令您對測試結果充滿信心。 4000Plus 多用途焊接强度測試儀可以執行高達 500 公斤的剪切力測試、高達 100 公斤的張力測試和高達 50 公斤的推力測試，涵蓋包括新的熱拔球測試和微材料測試在內的所有測試應用。 此系統還包括一個攝像頭輔助自動化系統，非常適合晶圓相互連接、引綫框架、混合微電路或汽車電子元件封裝的張力和剪切測試等應用。 4000Plus 提供各種針對粘合測試和微材料測試的光學解决方案，使成像系統可用于故障模式分析、校準和測試結果實時記錄： - 用于高級分析的圖像采集系統設置速度快，而且緊靠測試頭，幫助實現更快速的測試。 - 孔徑成像系統提供高放大率成像，非常適合精確的工具校準，而且完美適合超窄間距設 Quadra NT™ 是諾信 DAGE 更新一代的 X 射線管，擁有分辨到産品 100nm 細節處的功能，可以確保圖像明亮、清晰和穩定。 行業領先的 Aspire FP 探測器可以以 30 fps 捕獲 6.7 MP 的圖像。 在兩個 4K UHD 顯示器上顯示如水晶般的清晰圖像。傳統的 HD 顯示屏缺少 6.7 MP 圖像所需的分辨率。 - 减少宕機時間 : Quadra NT X-射綫管無需進行日常維修或更換燈絲。 - 可重複使用爲標準: 因爲燈絲從未更換，因此可以確保檢測圖像清晰可見且可以重複檢驗。 - 無油設計: QuadraNT 采用無油離子泵真空設計，無需換油。 總部設立於新加坡。專注於為晶圓製造和晶片封裝產業提供先進的2.45Ghz微波等離子清洗機和等離子去膠機。... 這是一款通用型的落地式微波等離子清洗機，適合用規模化生產應用。支援各種substrate, leadframe或者晶圓封裝前的清洗應用，一般應用於wire bonding, molding, underfill，soldering等工藝之前；也可以用於晶片堆疊前/晶圓表面活化。 全自動微波等離子清洗機。適應達150mm以上寬度Carrier；適合應用於大面積基板、PCB板或IGBT模組的等離子清洗工藝。 Neocera Magma – Magnetic Microscope/磁性顯微鏡 A powerful tool that can localize faults in a semiconductor device non-destructively. 一種功能強大的工具，可以非破壞性地定位半導體元器件/封裝中的電性故障... Today’s semiconductor chips/packaging are extremely complex and are not just multi-stack but also multi-die, making the Failure Analysis (FA) very complex and time-consuming. The Magma enables the user to shorten this process dramatically. Using a very-sensitive magnetic sensor known as a Superconducting Quantum Interference Device (SQUID). This sensor functions almost like an MRI for a microchip. The tool can find “Shorts”; “Opens”; “Resistive Opens”; and “Leakages” of current, all non-destructively. Shortening the FA time and hence the Time to Market for the customer. The tool also has a second magnetic sensor, a GMR that offers a higher resolution. To date, the Magma has successfully imaged through a High Bandwidth Memory device of 20 stacks at a total depth of 1.5 millimeters. 今天的半導體元件/封裝極其複雜，不僅是多層而且是多晶片堆疊，這使得故障分析 (FA) 非常複雜而且耗時。 Magma磁性顯微鏡的功能，可以協助FA使用者大大地縮短這個過程。 使用稱為超導量子干涉 (SQUID) 的非常敏感的磁傳感器。 該傳感器的功能幾乎類似於微芯片的核磁共振成像儀。 Magma磁性顯微鏡可以使用非破壞性方式，找到諸如: 短路、斷開、電阻斷開和電流的漏電等異常，縮短 FA 時間，從而縮短客戶產品的上市時間。 Magma磁性顯微鏡還有第二個磁傳感器GMR可提供更高的分辨率。 迄今為止，Magma 已成功通過總深度為 1.5 毫米的 20 層高帶寬存儲器設備的FA成像。 Lake Shore Cryotronics/免液氦低溫探針台 Lake Shore’s cryogenic probe stations provide precisely controlled environments for non-destructive measurement of the electrical properties of materials and early-stage electronic devices.... Probe stations are versatile and flexible Typical applications include sampling I-V and C-V curves over a wide range of temperatures, measuring microwave and electro-optical responses, characterizing magneto-transport properties in variable magnetic fields, Hall effect measurements to understand carrier mobility, and a variety of other material studies. Lake Shore Cryotronics offers a variety of cryogenic probe stations providing the environment of 1.6 K to 675 K temperature, -2.5 T to 2.5 T magnetic field with the stages for up to 2” wafers and 4” wafers optionally. CRX-4K Cryogen Free Closed Cycle Probe Station Designed for versatility and high performance, the CRX-4K is our premium cryogen-free closed cycle refrigerant probe station. Using a self-contained closed cycle refrigerator (CCR), the station cools down to cryogenic temperatures unassisted, eliminating the need for monitoring by the researcher. The CRX 4K provides Lake Shore’s best low-temperature cryogen-free performance, with configurations enabling sample temperatures as low as 4.5 K. The 2-stage CCR allows the sample to be maintained at elevated temperature during cooldown, reducing the potential for condensation, a critical requirement for measuring organic materials. The CRX 4K is designed to accommodate wafers as large as 4” in diameter, with 2” diameter probable regions. CRX-6.5K Cryogen Free Closed Cycle Probe Station The CRX-6.5K provides a low-cost, general-purpose solution for those looking for the convenience of cryogen-free operation and the dependable measurement performance of a Lake Shore product. Using a self-contained closed cycle refrigerator (CCR), the station cools down to cryogenic temperatures unassisted, eliminating the need for monitoring by the researcher. The 2-stage CCR allows the sample to be maintained at elevated temperature during cooldown, reducing the potential for condensation, a critical requirement for measuring organic materials. The CRX-6.5K operates over a temperature range of 8 K to 350 K with the option to extend to a higher range of 20 K to 675 K. This model accommodates full and partial wafers up to 2” in diameter. The CRX-VF is a cryogen-free, closed-cycle refrigerator probe station enhanced with a ±2.5 T vertical field superconducting magnet. It performs C-V, I-V, microwave, and electro-optical probing, plus out-of-plane vertical field superconducting magnetic measurements. Researchers can use the CRX-VF for performing Hall effect measurements and testing magneto-transport parameters. It is designed to enable true 90° wafer probing on wafers up to 2” in diameter. The sample is maintained at elevated temperature during cooldown, reducing the potential for condensation, a critical requirement for measuring organic materials. about: Welcome to OmniMeasure, Booth Number：I3204 歐美科技股份有限公司致力於推動量測技術的創新，專注於提供全球領先的矽通孔(TSV)與玻璃通孔(TGV)解決方案。 歐美科技以光學創新技術實現了非破壞性且高速的量測方式，為合作夥伴帶來無可比擬的價值。TSV全晶圓深度均勻性量測技術、關鍵尺寸量測及薄膜性質分析工具，能有效協助用戶掌握製程品質，而最新推出的TGV 3D可視化檢測系統，能準確識別通孔形貌、關鍵尺寸以及孔壁波紋與粗糙度，更可量測雷射改質線。 我們的使命是提供客戶量產用的整合量測技術，專注於先進製程控制的智慧化與非破壞性量測。 OmniMeasure Technology Inc. is dedicated to advancing measurement technologies, focusing on providing world-leading Through Silicon Via (TSV) and Through Glass Via (TGV) solutions. Our optical innovations enable non-destructive and high-throughput measurements, providing unparalleled value to our partners. Our tools for full-wafer TSV depth uniformity metrology, critical dimension measurement, and film properties analysis empower users to effectively manage process quality. In addition, our newly launched TGV 3D Viewer reveals detailed via geometry, critical dimensions, via wall waviness/roughness, and laser modification profiles. Our mission is to deliver Integrated Metrology for Production, with the focus on Smart and Non-Destructive Metrology for Advanced Process Control. High-Speed TSV Metrology System... ViaMaster is an automated metrology system specifically developed by OmniMeasure for semiconductor advanced packaging and 3D IC. It measures Through Silicon Vias  (TSVs) with aspect ratios (AR) of up to 30 or higher. Utilizing non-destructive optical technology, ViaMaster delivers high-resolution, fast, and reliable measurement solutions to help customers precisely control critical dimensions during manufacturing, thereby improving product yield and process stability. TSV Structure Measurement and Process Challenges TSV technology is at the core of 3D IC packaging. Creating vertical vias through silicon wafers and metallizing them enables interlayer connections that enhance integration and reduce product size. However, as fabrication technologies advance, TSV structures become smaller and more complex, presenting several challenges: Precise Control of Via Depth and Diameter Measurement Challenges of High Aspect Ratio (HAR) Structures These challenges call for high-precision metrology tools during manufacturing to enable real-time monitoring and adjustment of process parameters, ensuring the quality and reliability of TSV structures. Non-destructive High-Speed Metrology System ViaMaster offers the following advantages: High-Speed Automated Measurements High Precision and High Resolution Integrated Multi-Parameter Measurement Applicable to Critical Process Stages With ViaMaster, customers can detect deviations in real time during the manufacturing process, make necessary adjustments, and ensure the precision and reliability of TSV structures—ultimately improving product yield and reducing production costs.

about: Sincerely invite you to SEMICON® Taiwan 2026 Founded in 2004, ONANO is the first professional optoelectronic glass thinning manufacturing service company in Taiwan. In addition, since its establishment, ONANO has focused on the research, development and manufacturing services of photoelectric thinning glass. In the past year, it has been developing TGV (glass core) corresponding services for customer groups. To obtain holes with high aspect ratios, highly selective etching processes are needed. Depending on the choice of glass, in some cases etching with acids is sufficient. But in many cases, the results of acidic etching do not meet the requirements, as the etching is very fast. This leads to processes with low selectivity, not allowing to achieve high aspect ratios and leading to higher taper angles. ONANO offers an optimized etching process based on acid and alkaline media, that etching process allows to maintain a very high selectivity and to keep process times short. ONANO offers etching solutions for panel formats. TGV can be manufactured on panel formats 300 x 300 mm, 510 x 515 mm, and 620 x 750mm. No matter in terms of process technology or production capacity, ONANO is in the leading position in the industry; the yield and quality of glass etching are highly recognized by customers. ■ Surface processing services (chemical etching, mechanical grinding...etc.) ■ Glass substrate solutions (Thinning/Polishing/Via Etching) Now that the semiconductor industry is booming, ONANO actively transform towards the direction of industrial development. ONANO began to invest in the development of semiconductor substrate-related technologies in 2019, and applied low-temperature co-fired ceramics (LTCC) to achieve a feasible solution for heterogeneous integration. In the past year, it has been developing AlN substrate process, and ONANO can produce green sheet and ceramic >170W/mk now.

about: Oriole is a photonic networking company developing disruptive technologies for AI/ML and high-performance computing (HPC) transforming data centre networking. PRISM (Photonic Routing Infrastructure for Scalable Models), is the world’s first pure photonic network for AI. Built from the ground up for distributed AI workloads, PRISM is a full-stack architecture which replaces traditional electronic switching with a deterministic optical fabric, high-performance communication at scale. PRISM removes the bottlenecks of electrical packet switching, enabling higher GPU utilisation by eliminating contention and idle time while maintaining consistent performance as clusters grow. Its passive photonic routing core requires no power or cooling, reducing network energy overhead and infrastructure complexity, The architecture is designed to enable near-peak AI-cluster utilisation, compared with the 30–50% utilisation commonly achieved in conventional packet-switched environments. Oriole recently deployed PRISM in the UK ARIA Scaling Inference Lab (the UK’s novel AI hardware test bed) in collaboration with AMD, demonstrating how next-generation network fabrics can overcome performance, and energy constraints in modern AI infrastructure. This marks the company’s first commercial deployment achieved within three years of founding. Acknowledged in the UK government’s £1. Oriole has also delivered innovation projects with Innovate UK, resulting in an alpha photonic integrated circuit enabling ultra-fast, Develop relationships with companies operating in ASIC manufacturing, testing and back-end processing to support the development and commercial scaling of Oriole’s next-generation photonic networking hardware Building connections with photonics and high-speed design companies to explore technology partnerships, and supply-chain collaboration for future PRISM deployment

By leveraging Oxford Instruments’ 200 mm GaN plasma atomic layer etch (ALE) technology, ROHM is implementing a proven process into its own high-volume manufacturing environment and scaling to 200 mm wafer size. This strategic move marks a major step in ROHM’s ambition to establish a fully integrated, end-to-end GaN production capability within the ROHM Group. ROHM has already been supplying its EcoGaN™ series, which leverages these advantages to deliver high-efficiency, compact power solutions. The initiative will enable ROHM to strengthen supply capacity and meet rapidly growing demand for high-efficiency power devices across applications including electric vehicles (EVs), AI servers, and industrial power systems. Oxford Instruments’ industry-leading ALE technology with EtchpointTM, an exclusive collaboration with LayTec for real-time optical in-situ monitoring, allow GaN device manufacturers to control residual post-ALE layer thicknesses to an accuracy of +/-0.5 nm. These world-first integrated technologies are critical for ROHM to successfully bring the advanced process technology into its own fabs, delivering the state-of-the-art processing required to successfully replicate and scale advanced GaN device architectures. “What started out as a GaN R&D collaboration between ROHM and Oxford Instruments is expanding into the preparation for volume production ramp, and ROHM’s decision to bring GaN manufacturing in-house represents an important milestone for the power electronics industry,” said Matt Kelly, President, Oxford Instruments Advanced Technologies. “Our advanced etch solutions are specifically designed to enable ultra-low damage etching, atomic-scale precision, high uniformity, and repeatability, for high-volume 200 mm production environments. Oxford Instruments (OXIG), a leading provider of advanced plasma processing solutions for the compound semiconductor industry, announces the key role it is playing to support the industry’s first fully automated 6-inch indium phosphide (InP) wafer fabrication capability for photonic devices, led by Coherent Corp. Oxford Instruments’ cutting-edge plasma processing equipment is central to Coherent’s groundbreaking achievement of ramping up 6-inch InP fabs in Sherman, Texas, and Järfälla, Sweden. These fabs will play a pivotal role in driving advancements in AI datacentre, telecommunications, and sensing applications. Coherent’s transition to 6-inch wafers is set to deliver significant benefits, including a substantial increase in capacity, lower die cost and more than four times the number of devices per wafer. Oxford Instruments has supplied fully automated, high-throughput 6-inch InP processing equipment, enabling Coherent to achieve these remarkable productivity gains. This advanced equipment is designed to support the transition from 800G to 1.6T products, a key requirement to meet the growing demands of AI interconnects and optical communications. “We have been the leading supplier of InP plasma etch equipment to the datacom market, and Coherent, for many years. Our technology, with the quality, throughput and reliability that we have developed alongside excellent service, is ideally positioned to support the current device demand inflection we are seeing with the release of generative AI applications. We are delighted to be partnering with Coherent during this exciting period of market expansion and look forward to continuing to develop and release innovative and valuable plasma processing solutions.” Matt Kelly, Managing Director, Oxford Instruments Plasma Technology. about: With nearly 50 years of experience in lasers, optics, and industry, Oxford Lasers is a global leader in high-precision laser micromachining. Originally spun out from Oxford University’s Physics Department, the company began by manufacturing short-pulse lasers and transitioned over 35 years ago into a laser integrator, supplying laser tools and subcontract services. Oxford Lasers specialises in high-quality micromachining technologies capable of drilling, milling, cutting, welding, and patterning a wide variety of materials. Their expertise includes nano-, pico-, and femtosecond pulsed lasers, combined with advanced motion control systems, enabling consistent machining of demanding features. The company is particularly known for drilling guide plates for Advanced Wafer Level Test, supplying leading probe card companies. Operating 24/7, their facility has drilled over 100 million holes for next-generation wafer testing. With support from Innovate UK, Oxford Lasers is developing new technologies such as GHz pulse drilling and selective laser etching to create glass interposers for heterogeneous chiplet integration in advanced packaging. This innovation is poised to transform packaging in power, photonics, quantum, and micro-display applications. • Collaborate with probe card suppliers or institutions seeking the latest guide plates and solutions for next-generation market challenges • Partner with companies or institutions exploring advanced packaging using glass interposers

Photarix is developing next-generation compound semiconductor light sources for quantum-secure communication. Photarix is a UK quantum hardware spinout from Lancaster University developing compact, electrically driven single-photon sources for quantum-secure communications. The company’s semiconductor-based technology is designed to operate at telecom wavelengths and at, with a route towards chip-scale integration and scalable manufacturing. The device architecture is based on III-V compound semiconductor processes related to those used in established optoelectronic technologies such as VCSELs, providing a practical foundation for future manufacturing and integration. Photarix is addressing one of the key barriers to practical quantum communication: the need for quantum light-source hardware that is compact, reliable and easier to integrate into existing fibre and telecom infrastructure. With Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) as a first market, longer-term opportunities include secure optical links, satellite-enabled quantum communications, and wider quantum network applications. Photarix is currently focusing on device optimisation, system-level validation and engagement with industrial and research partners to support future deployment and manufacturing. The company has a vision to turn single-photon generation from a specialist laboratory capability into a practical telecom hardware component for real-world quantum communication systems. about: PIE Co., Ltd. is a leader in industrial intelligence, delivering AI-vision and data-driven smart-factory solutions. Founded in 2018 and listed on the KOSDAQ market in February 2025. IE is headquartered in Dongtan, Korea, with an AI R&D campus in Pangyo and subsidiaries in the United States, Hungary, and China. As the PIE Group—together with AHHA Labs and PIE Robotics—the company delivers a full-stack, turn-key inspection platform that unifies vision (AI-based optical, holotomography, X-ray CT, and ultrasonic inspection), data (analytics and predictive maintenance), and robotics (Physical AI and autonomous logistics). Its equipment lineup—including the GAVI, GAVIH, piXion, PASAM, PTH, and BVH systems—serves glass-core substrates, advanced packaging, and PCBs for customers across the semiconductor, display, battery, and automotive industries. PIE's mission is to be your partner for smart-factory transformation. GAVIH   —   Transmission Holotomography (HT) GAVIH is a transmission holotomography system that reconstructs a transparent sample’s internal refractive index in 3D at 161 nm, non-destructively detecting micro-cracks, voids, and laser modification in glass substrates and waveguides.... GAVIH is a transmission holotomography system—a precision phase-imaging technology that reconstructs, from the phase of transmitted light, a sample’s internal refractive-index distribution in 3D. It targets optically transparent samples such as glass substrates and waveguides (AR/VR, PICs) for non-destructive analysis of internal structure and defects. It delivers 161 nm lateral resolution and acquires multi-angle phase information without rotating the sample, building the refractive-index map quickly. Without cutting or surface prep, it resolves internal structure, layer boundaries, and micro-defects, and visualizes micro-cracks, laser-induced modification, and voids quantitatively and qualitatively. It also measures process variation, material uniformity, and induced stress. Typical inspections include TGV surface and surrounding micro-cracks, TGV inner-wall roughness, TGV modification, post-singulation glass-edge micro-cracks, and glass CPO inspection. GAVI   —   Glass Substrate / TGV AOI GAVI is a high-resolution AOI system for through-glass-via (TGV) holes on glass-core substrates. In a single scan it evaluates hole diameter, roundness, and position while screening the glass surface for defects, using AI-based classification.... GAVI is a high-resolution automated optical inspection (AOI) system developed for through-glass-via (TGV) holes on glass-core substrates. In a single scan it captures multiple hole cross-sections and evaluates key hole characteristics—diameter, roundness, and position—while simultaneously screening the glass surface for defects such as cracks, foreign material, and residues. Rule-based logic combined with an in-house AI platform automatically classifies defect types and adapts the inspection to each customer’s product and process. By consolidating dimensional measurement, position mapping, and surface inspection into one high-throughput pass, GAVI provides the accuracy and repeatability that high-volume glass-substrate production requires, while remaining flexible enough to support evolving substrate designs.

about: ProSpectral is an innovation led photonics company developing next generation snapshot spectral imagers for materials identification using computer vision. The company’s technology uses off-the-shelf image sensors which are modified with ProSpectral’s intelligently designed nanostructured filters. These thin layers of material (100s nanometres) can be coated and patterned using standard semiconductor industry processes; thin film deposition, lithography, and etching. Prospectral designs “blueprints” for the patterning of these layers which allows them to interact with / scatter light before it is collected at the sensor beneath. The blueprints act as highly specialised optical filters and enable the camera to extract the information from the incident light that is necessary for materials fingerprinting. While the design process can be used to produce a generalised spectral imaging camera, its greatest benefit is the flexibility to be tuned to only collect the “right” light for particular use cases, allowing targeted, application specific cameras that reduce noise and improve data accuracy. Prospectral’s novel imaging sensor technology enables the use of less complex and much cheaper cameras, improves manufacturability, form factor, data quality and robustness. • Partners expertise in upscaling in-lab nanofabrication processes to pilot lines • Image sensor manufacturers, particularly those manufacturing visible and short-wave infrared image sensors ProSpectral是一家以創新為主導的光子學公司，致力開發利用電腦視覺進行材料識別的新一代快照光譜成像儀（snapshot spectral imager）。 ProSpectral的技術使用現成的圖像感測器，並透過該公司以智慧設計方式產生的奈米結構濾鏡進行修改。這些厚度為100奈米的材料薄層，可使用標準半導體工業製程進行鍍膜與圖案化、薄膜沉積、光刻，以及蝕刻。 Prospectral為材料薄層的圖案設計「藍圖」，在下方感測器開始蒐集資訊前，讓薄層先和光進行相互作用／散射。這些藍圖充當高度專業化的光學濾鏡，讓相機能從入射光中，提取材料辨識所需的資訊。 前述設計製程雖可用於生產通用光譜成像相機，但其最大的好處是可以靈活調整，僅蒐集特定用例的「正確」光線，讓鎖定目標的特定應用相機減少雜訊，進而提高資料準確性。 Prospectral的新影像感測器技術，可使用複雜度較低且價格較低廉的相機，進而提升可製造性、規格、資料品質和耐用性。 • 影像感測器製造商，尤其是製造可見光和短波紅外線影像感測器的製造商

about: Explore our latest innovations in semiconductor packaging! QUICK Semiconductor—a wholly owned subsidiary of QUICK Intelligent (SSE: 603203)—is dedicated to the innovation and manufacturing of semiconductor packaging equipment. Driven by the evolving demands of AI-era semiconductor packaging, QUICK Semiconductor has developed a portfolio of advanced equipment, including: Advanced Packaging TCB (Thermo-Compression Bonder) Micro-Nano Silver/Copper Sintering Equipment These solutions are widely applied in HBM, CoWoS, CPO, Optical Modules, and High-Bandwidth Semiconductors (SiC). Thermo-Compression Bonder (TCB) Designed for AI chips (HBM, CoWoS, CPO), our TCB bonder features precision alignment, thermal & force control, and fluxless plasma bonding—solving fine-pitch and warpage issues.... , a line of advanced packaging Thermal Compression Bonding (TCB) equipment designed specifically for core AI chip processes. It is ideal for cutting-edge applications including HBM stacking, CoWoS packaging, and CPO (Co-Packaged Optics). The system has overcome key technical hurdles—including high-precision alignment, accurate temperature control, precise force control, and fluxless plasma bonding. It addresses critical industry challenges such as fine-pitch bump interconnects, large-die warp control, and damage-free handling of ultra-thin dies. Supporting eutectic bonding with an UPH of up to 21K, our High-Speed Eutectic Die Bonder matches next-gen automotive and consumer chip packaging needs, achieving mass delivery to top-tier semiconductor makers.... As packaging technologies for automotive and consumer electronics signal-processing chips continue to evolve, the High-Speed Eutectic Die Bonder developed by QUICK stays at the forefront of global industry trends, perfectly matching next-generation packaging requirements. Supporting eutectic bonding processes, the equipment achieves an impressive UPH (Units Per Hour) of up to 21K, delivering world-class performance. It has been successfully deployed and mass-shipped to multiple leading global semiconductor manufacturers. Pre-Sintering Thermo-Compression Die Bonder Solving non-tackiness issues before sintering, our Thermo-Compression Die Bonder uses heat and force for precise AMB mounting. Compatible with silver paste/film, its anti-oxidation design handles SiC dies, DTS, Clips & NTC.... Prior to sintering, dried silver paste and silver film both lack surface tackiness, presenting a technical challenge when mounting SiC dies directly onto AMB substrates. To bridge this gap, heat and pressure are applied simultaneously during mounting—a specialized process known as thermo-compression pre-bonding. Engineerd for this precise requirement, Quick Semiconductor’s Pre-Sintering Thermo-Compression Die Bonder is fully compatible with both silver paste and silver film processes. Built with an anti-oxidation design in the bonding zone to minimize product oxidation risks, this versatile system handles multi-material placement seamlessly, including SiC dies, DTS, Clips, and NTC components. Multi-Functional Die Bonder (IGBT) Designed for IGBT power modules, the Multi-Functional Die Bonder features 6 nozzles with ±25μm accuracy and >6K UPH. Supporting 330*660mm carriers & preform cutting, it handles solder paste, preform & die sorting.... Featuring a 6-nozzle module design, the system delivers placement accuracy of ±25μm with a throughput exceeding , and supports large-format carrier sizes up to . It seamlessly accommodates multiple feeding methods, including Wafer (up to 12-inch), Tray (4-inch), and Tape/SMT feeder. Integrated with automatic preform solder cutting and placement, as well as automated nozzle and ejector pin changing, the equipment enables multi-wafer and multi-die bonding. It provides a highly versatile, all-in-one solution for solder paste bonding, perform solder bonding, die sorting, and substrate layout/mounting. Designed for COB & BOX optical packaging, this Die Bonder offers ±1.5μm/±3μm accuracy with epoxy dipping/dispensing. Its dual-station parallel design and 10-2000g force control maximize UPH in a compact footprint.... is specifically engineered for optical COB and BOX packaging applications. It comprehensively supports precise multi-material placement across both TX and RX functional assemblies. The equipment achieves placement accuracies of ±1.5μm for glass dies and ±3μm for production dies, utilizing epoxy dipping and dispensing bonding processes. Built with an independent dual-station parallel architecture, it enables simultaneous dipping and bonding to eliminate waiting times and maximize UPH. Featuring wide-range precise force control (10–2000g), seamless switching between 6×6" and 4×8" blue tape, and a compact footprint design, it provides an exceptionally flexible, space-efficient packaging solution. Optical Module Eutectic Die Bonder Empowering 400G/800G/1.6T optical modules (COC/COS/Flip Chip), this Eutectic Bonder features dual eutectic stages, 3 bond heads in parallel, ±1.5μm accuracy, and automated rail handling for maximum throughput.... Dedicated to high-speed optical module packaging, QUICK’s Optical Module Eutectic Die Bonder supports COC, COS, and Flip Chip applications tailored for 400G, 800G, and 1.6T optical transceivers. Delivering high placement precision of ±3μm, the machine utilizes advanced eutectic bonding technology. It features a dual eutectic stage architecture—with each stage integrating 8 buffer stations—enabling sequential mounting of up to 8 distinct materials for superior flexibility. Driven by a 3-bond-head collaborative system running loading, eutectic bonding, and unloading in parallel, paired with a rail-based automated handling system and an integrated screw-tightening assembly module, it guarantees ultra-high throughput and streamlined production workflows.

about: Quobly. Quantum is already on-chip. Quobly is a quantum computing company developing silicon-based quantum computers using proven semiconductor manufacturing processes. The company has strategic partnerships within the semiconductor industry (STMicroelectronics, Air Liquide, Soitec and Orano) to accelerate the industrialization of its silicon quantum chips in advanced semiconductor manufacturing environments. In June 2026, Quobly raised a €115 million Series A led by Bpifrance, STMicroelectronics and SEALSQ, with participation from leading industrial and deeptech investors, to accelerate the industrialization of its quantum processors and bring its first commercial computers to market under its Alloy product line. The company’s first quantum computer will be deployed through cloud environments in 2026 for early adopters in high-performance computing and research. With 100+ collaborators, Quobly is headquartered in Grenoble, France, with offices in Singapore and Canada.

about: A global leader with innovative technologies As a manufacturer of reflow soldering systems with convection or condensation and drying and coating systems, Rehm Thermal Systems has been producing energy-efficient manufacturing equipment for the electronics and photovoltaics industry since 1990. We also offer our customers tailor-made applications related to the soldering, coating and hardening of modules. From our German headquarters in Blaubeuren, we coordinate the activities of our 26 locations in 24 countries worldwide. The company also set up an additional manufacturing facility in China in 2008. Our production facilities are state-of-the-art and are safeguarded by strict quality assurance guidelines in accordance with German standards. This enables us to serve the international markets quickly and to offer outstanding on-site service. In addition to Rehm Thermal Systems, the Rehm Group includes the subsidiaries Rehm BlechTec, which specialises in processing stainless steel, aluminium and steel plate, and H+R Personaldienste GmbH. We are therefore a one-stop shop for all the services you need, from planning and design to the finished equipment. Energy-efficient system facilitates low-maintenance manufacturing... With the VisionXP+VAC. we offer innovative solutions for reflow soldering. In just one process, a vacuum module enables convection soldering processes to be carried out with a vacuum. This reliably removes pores, gas occlusions and voids immediately after the soldering process whilst the solder is still in its optimal molten state. Complex processing of the assembly via an external vacuum system is no longer necessary and the workpieces are moved straight into the vacuum process from the peak zones. Top performance with or without vacuum... The Condenso series of vapor-phase soldering systems can be customized to suit different production environment, perfectly meeting all application requirements. From compact designs to high-throughput in-line configurations, we offer high-performance vapor phase reflow systems. Leveraging a patented gas injection principle, these systems enable simultaneous control of both reflow temperature and pressure (vacuum), resulting in more precise and broader reflow profiles. They are particularly well-suited for automotive electronics, consumer electronics, semiconductors, aerospace, medical electronics, as well as various 5G, IGBT, and new energy vehicle products. Vacuum contact soldering – perfect for power electronics... The Nexus vacuum contact soldering system is suitable for vacuum and flux-free soldering processes at temperatures up to 450°C. The system can utilize a variety of process gases, chemical activators, and formic acid, and supports both lead-free and leaded soldering. The Nexus is primarily used in the manufacturing of advanced packaging and power electronics products. Optional vacuum features help minimize oxidation of components and joints and effectively reduce voids in the joints.
