about: Rigaku Semiconductor X-ray Metrology From Lab to Fab Founded in 1951 in Tokyo, Japan, Rigaku is an analytical and industrial instrumentation leader. With numerous innovations, the Rigaku group of companies is now a global authority in several fields, including X-ray diffraction (XRD), thin-film analysis (XRF, XRD, and XRR), X-ray fluorescence spectrometry (TXRF, EDXRF, and WDXRF), small-angle X-ray scattering (SAXS), protein and small molecule X-ray crystallography, Raman spectroscopy, X-ray optics, semiconductor metrology (TXRF, XRF, XRD, and XRR), X-ray Topography Imaging, X-ray sources, computed tomography, non-destructive testing, and thermal analysis. While X-ray and related technologies are the foundation of Rigaku’s business, its true strength lies in its commitment to working with customers. By fostering partnerships and driving innovation, Rigaku powers new perspectives and tailor-made solutions to meet the diverse needs of industry, academia, and government. With a global presence and over 2,000 employees worldwide, Rigaku values collaboration between users and employees to ensure alignment with customer needs and market trends. Its products and services drive innovation in fields as diverse as semiconductor chip design, drug discovery, and nanotechnology research. We value our customers, value our people, and value our technology. The company’s mission is to contribute to the enhancement of humanity through scientific and technological development. Rigaku to Showcase Advanced X-ray Metrology and Inspection Solutions at SEMICON Taiwan 2026 – X-ray Technologies for Advanced Logic, HBM and Advanced Packaging in the AI Era – Rigaku to Showcase Advanced X-ray Metrology and Inspection Solutions at SEMICON Taiwan 2026 – X-ray Technologies for Advanced Logic, HBM and Advanced Packaging in the AI Era – Hsinchu, Taiwan – The Rigaku Group will exhibit at “SEMICON Taiwan 2026,” taking place September 2 to 4, 2026, at TaiNEX 1 and 2 in Taipei. SEMICON Taiwan is a leading international exhibition for the semiconductor industry. Taiwan is home to one of the world’s leading semiconductor ecosystems and plays a central role in the manufacturing of advanced logic, high-bandwidth memory (HBM) and advanced packaging technologies. Rigaku continues to strengthen its presence in the region, following the opening of the Rigaku Technology Center Taiwan (RTC-TW) in 2025. In response to the growing complexity of semiconductor manufacturing for advanced logic, HBM and advanced packaging, Rigaku will showcase advanced X-ray metrology and inspection solutions at SEMICON Taiwan 2026. Covering applications from R&D through high-volume manufacturing, these solutions support process control, materials characterization and non-destructive analysis for increasingly complex semiconductor devices and packages. Visitors can also meet with Rigaku specialists at the booth to discuss specific metrology, process control and analysis needs. Advanced X-ray inspection technology for 2.5D/3D packaging, designed to inspect hidden structures that are difficult to evaluate using conventional optical inspection alone. Featuring 3D laminography and automated defect identification, the system supports high-resolution, sub-micron defect detection of micro-bumps and through-silicon vias (TSVs) in CoWoS1, HBM and hybrid bonding. It is currently available for customer evaluation. New X-ray analyzer for panel-level packaging (PLP)2 process control, available for customer evaluation. The system measures material composition and thin-film thickness across large substrates, supporting process control as advanced packaging shifts toward larger panel formats. The series features the flagship XTRAIA MF-3400, Rigaku’s fourth-generation multifunctional X-ray metrology plaƞorm for high-throughput thin-film analysis, alongside the XTRAIA XD-3300 for high-precision measurement of advanced structures on ultra-small wafer pads. The series supports applications in advanced packaging, HBM, hybrid bonding and BEOL process control. It combines X-ray and optical technologies for fast, non-destructive characterization of complex multilayer structures. *1 CoWoS (Chip-on-Wafer-on-Substrate): An advanced packaging technology that integrates multiple chips in a single package. *2 Panel-level packaging (PLP): A packaging method using large, rectangular substrates instead of round wafers, enabling more chips per production run. Rigaku will also highlight its strategic alliance with Onto Innovation, which combines X-ray and optical technologies to advance hybrid metrology solutions for semiconductor manufacturing. As part of Rigaku’s 75th anniversary celebration, the booth will feature Dr. Rixsee, an official brand mascot created by employees to commemorate the milestone. Visitors will also receive a complimentary Rigaku 75th Anniversary Journal, while supplies last. Dates: September 2 (Wed) to 4 (Fri), 2026 SEMICON Taiwan Official Website Since its establishment in 1951, the engineering professionals of the Rigaku group have been dedicated to benefiting society with leading-edge technologies, notably including its core fields of X-ray and thermal analysis. With a market presence in 136 countries and regions and some 2,000 employees from 9 global operations, Rigaku is a solution partner in industry and research analysis institutes. Our overseas sales ratio has reached approximately 70% while sustaining an exceptionally high market share in Japan. Together with our customers, we continue to develop and grow. Device Architectures Rigaku's CD-SAXS (Critical Dimension Small Angle X-ray Scattering) platform provides non-destructive nanoscale characterization using both GI-SAXS and T-SAXS technologies.... Measuring the Invisible: CD-SAXS for Advanced Device Architectures As device dimensions continue to shrink, traditional measurement techniques face growing limitations. Rigaku's CD-SAXS (Critical Dimension Small Angle X-ray Scattering) platform provides non-destructive nanoscale characterization using both GI-SAXS and T-SAXS technologies. Unlike destructive cross-sectional analysis, CD-SAXS enables rapid and repeatable characterization of buried and high-aspect-ratio structures while preserving the wafer. As semiconductor manufacturers continue pushing the limits of device scaling, non-destructive nanoscale metrology has become an increasingly important tool for process development, optimization, and manufacturing control. Accelerating Materials Innovation: XTRAIA XD-3300 The Rigaku XTRAIA XD-3300 combines advanced X-ray diffraction (XRD) and X-ray reflectivity (XRR) capabilities within an inline manufacturing platform.... Accelerating Materials Innovation: XTRAIA XD-3300 Materials engineering continues to play a critical role in enabling semiconductor performance. RIYE Electric Unveils Comprehensive Power Quality Solutions at SEMICON Taiwan: Ensuring Zero Downtime for Semiconductor Manufacturing , a global leader in power quality and voltage regulation solutions, is proud to announce its participation in the upcoming , the premier event for the global semiconductor manufacturing supply chain. about: Innovating Microwave Tools for Plasma Processing S-TEAM, founded in 1990 by scientists from the Slovak University of Technology, develops high-power microwave systems for plasma generation in semiconductor processes such as CVD and plasma etching. Other industrial application includes heating, drying, curing and vulcanization. Our HOMER autotuners enable fast, automatic impedance matching under dynamic plasma loads at ISM bands (900 MHz, 2.45 GHz, 5.8 GHz), supporting continuous and pulsed operation with peak powers up to 100 kW. Systems are available for WR975, WR340, WR430, WR284, and WR159 waveguides. We offer HOMER Analyzers, bidirectional power meters, directional coupler detectors, and custom microwave components. Integration via analog/digital I/O and Ethernet is supported. All R&D, manufacturing and calibrations are in-house, with proven reliability in harsh plasma environments. We serve global OEMs, fabs, and R&D labs across the EU, US, Japan, Korea, China, Taiwan and beyond. HOMER Autotuner ISM 2450 MHz, WR340 Waveguide Automatic tuning module for high-power microwave plasma systems. The HOMER-Series STHT 2.45 GHz Autotuner integrates the HOMER Analyzer (automatic impedance and power measurement system) and HOMER Mototuner (a three-stub motorized tuner) in one compact unit. Based on the WR340 (R26) waveguide, the system works under the full-power operating conditions of magnetron-based microwave generators. The Analyzer part measures both the magnitude and phase of reflection coefficient as well as the incident, reflected and absorbed power, and frequency. The Mototuner consists of three stepping-motor-driven tuning stubs spaced in mutual distances of nominally one quarter of guide wavelength. The Tuner uses data measured by Analyzer for fast automatic impedance matching of time-varying loads in all industrial applications, including plasma. The system is designed for CW, high-ripple (Rectified) and Pulsed sampling modes. Also available is matching for non-zero reflection coefficient magnitude (defined mismatch tuning). The peak working power is set at the manufacture time as specified in the customer’s order. Used autonomously without an external controller. about: Your Partner for High Precision Solutions SmarAct Group develops high-performance solutions for precision positioning, automation, and metrology for semiconductor manufacturing, silicon photonics, and advanced research. Headquartered in Germany with offices in the US and China, SmarAct delivers solutions ranging from precision components to fully integrated automation systems. As semiconductor devices shrink, 3D integration advances, and electronic and photonic technologies converge, manufacturing demands ever greater precision, stability, and throughput. At SEMICON Taiwan, SmarAct showcases solutions for lithography and alignment, wafer-level metrology and inspection, photonic device testing, automated nanoprobing and failure analysis, as well as advanced packaging and heterogeneous integration. By combining precision motion, intelligent automation, and application expertise, SmarAct helps customers overcome today's manufacturing challenges and prepare for the next generation of semiconductor and photonic technologies. Visit SmarAct's booth and meet our experts to discuss your next application. SmarAct Presents Interferometer-Based Wafer Positioning at SEMICON Taiwan High-precision wafer stages combine advanced motion technologies with direct interferometric feedback for demanding semiconductor processes. will present its latest solutions for semiconductor manufacturing, positioning, metrology, and automation at booth S8237. A key focus will be SmarAct’s customizable wafer stages, which combine high-performance motion technologies with advanced metrology for precise, closed-loop wafer positioning. Designed for wafers up to 300 mm, SmarAct wafer stages can be configured with two to six degrees of freedom and combine piezo-based and electromagnetic drive technologies according to the application. For advanced position feedback, the stages can incorporate the optical encoders. Direct measurement on the wafer or chuck surface enables picometer-level feedback and closed-loop control, combining high-performance motion with interferometric metrology. This combination reflects SmarAct’s broader approach to semiconductor manufacturing. Rather than focusing solely on individual positioning components, the SmarAct Group combines expertise in motion, metrology, and automation to develop solutions tailored to specific processes and system architectures. In-house engineering and production provide flexibility to address requirements ranging from individual motion and measurement tasks to complex automated systems. Visitors to SEMICON Taiwan can experience several technologies behind these solutions. A demonstrator illustrates precise motion in six degrees of freedom using a hybrid kinematic design. It provides a tangible example of how different axis arrangements and kinematic concepts can be applied to complex positioning tasks, including wafer positioning. demonstrates SmarAct’s metrology expertise and the possibilities of direct position feedback and closed-loop control. SmarAct’s nanoprobing platform extends the showcase into automated semiconductor characterization, combining closed-loop positioning of probes and samples with automated probing workflows. Together, the demonstrators provide an insight into how SmarAct brings motion, metrology, and automation together to address increasingly complex requirements in semiconductor manufacturing and research. Meet SmarAct at SEMICON Taiwan, booth S8237, and discuss your next positioning, metrology, or automation challenge with our experts. SmarAct's wafer stages provide customizable high-precision positioning for wafers up to 300 mm. Combining piezo and electromagnetic drive technologies, they offer 2 to 6 degrees of freedom for demanding semiconductor processes.... SmarAct's wafer stages provide high-performance positioning for semiconductor manufacturing, inspection, metrology, and research. Configurable for wafers up to 300 mm and 2 to 6 degrees of freedom, they combine piezo-based and/or electromagnetic drive technologies to meet application-specific requirements for fine positioning, travel range, and dynamics. Optional ® optical encoders add high-resolution position feedback and closed-loop control. Wafer chucks, granite bases, single- or double-sided wafer access, and configurations for HV and UHV environments are available. With in-house engineering and extensive customization, wafer stages can be tailored to specific processes and system architectures. SmarAct provides customizable solutions for mask-to-wafer, chip-to-wafer, and wafer-to-wafer alignment. Motion, metrology, and automation technologies can be combined to meet specific semiconductor process requirements.... High-precision alignment is essential throughout semiconductor manufacturing, from lithography and wafer testing to advanced assembly and integration processes. SmarAct develops customizable motion and metrology solutions for mask-to-wafer, chip-to-wafer, and wafer-to-wafer alignment. Depending on the application, different positioning technologies can be combined to control lateral, rotational, vertical, and angular motion. Solutions can incorporate wafer handling, force sensing, metrology, microscopy, and automation according to the process requirements. SmarAct’s modular approach and in-house engineering support both application-specific subsystems and more complex automated equipment. Wafer-Level Testing of Photonic Chips SmarAct provides modular hardware and software for wafer-level PIC testing, combining fast fiber-to-PIC alignment, wafer positioning, electrical probing, and automated processes for optical and electro-optical characterization.... SmarAct provides modular motion, alignment, and control technologies for optical and electro-optical testing of photonic integrated circuits at wafer level. High-resolution piezo scanning, multi-axis fiber positioning, wafer motion, and automated alignment algorithms can be combined according to the test process. SmarAct solutions support and can be extended with electrical probing, measurement equipment, and application-specific automation. Modular hardware and software allow machine builders and system integrators to create customized test equipment for R&D, device characterization, validation, and scalable photonics production testing. SMARPROBE combines closed-loop positioning of probes and samples with automated probing workflows for advanced semiconductor characterization. Up to eight probes enable repeatable electrical measurements inside electron microscopes.... SmarAct provides electrical probing solutions ranging from configurable positioning systems to the fully integrated . Designed for advanced semiconductor characterization, PROBE combines closed-loop positioning of probes and samples with active position holding, low thermal drift, automated probe landing, CAD navigation, and predefined probing workflows. Up to eight probes can be positioned for electrical characterization, while the system can be integrated into existing electron microscopes. Its encoded motion system with 1 nm resolution supports repeatable and highly automated nanoprobing workflows while minimizing electron-beam exposure. SmarAct Metrology is developing a phase-shifting Fizeau interferometer for wafer metrology, capturing the full surface topology of wafers up to 300 mm within 1 ms with nanometer-scale resolution in a single shot.... is expanding into wafer metrology with a new phase-shifting interferometer currently in development. Based on a Fizeau configuration, the system is designed to capture the full surface topology of wafers up to 300 mm within just 1 ms with nanometer-scale resolution. Unlike point-by-point measurement approaches, the entire surface is captured in a single shot, opening new possibilities for fast, imaging-based wafer characterization. In addition to surface profilometry, the technology enables the rapid dynamic detection of height changes, targeting applications such as leak testing of semiconductor packages.

about: One laser. 28 lines. Welcome to booth T9404. Solinide Photonics AB is a Chalmers University spinoff based in Gothenburg, Sweden. We develop silicon nitride optical microcombs that replace racks of discrete lasers in co-packaged optics for AI datacentre interconnects. One pump laser, one chip, 28 usable lines above 0 dBm. Add 69% optical conversion efficiency and 100 mW total output power, and the result is more bandwidth per fibre at lower power per bit, with fewer components to qualify and fewer failure points to manage. SunSun Tech. aims to help customers overcome mass production obstacles and achieve the commercialization of silicon photonics CPO by providing precision alignment technology equipment and patented resins. 光陽光電搶攻AI矽光子設備商機--160通道FAU奈米貼合平台布局1.6T、3.2T、6.4T CPO市場 AI伺服器越來越快，資料傳輸也必須同步升級。當大量GPU同時運算，如果晶片之間傳輸速度跟不上，就像高速公路車道不足，再強的算力也會塞車。因此，如何用更快、更省電的方式傳送大量資料，正成為AI資料中心的重要戰場，也讓矽光子（Silicon Photonics）與共同封裝光學（CPO）受到市場高度關注。 光陽光電自2021年起投入矽光子、CPO先進封裝及高速光通訊設備研發，目前已完成1.6Tbps、3.2Tbps及6.4Tbps FAU製造與檢測設備交貨。公司定位不只是銷售精密設備，而是提供從光學元件貼合、耦光、檢測到智慧工廠的整體解決方案。 在SEMICON Taiwan 2026，光陽推出新一代「160通道FAU智慧奈米精度貼合機」及自動耦光對位平台，鎖定高通道數、高密度CPO與矽光子量產需求。設備整合雙六軸高精度定位、CCD自動視覺、AI智慧演算法、3D姿態補償及即時光功率回授，定位能力達±50nm等級。 矽光子真正重要的不只是零件有沒有放準，而是「光有沒有順利傳進晶片」。光纖、Lens、Prism或PIC只要出現微小位置或角度誤差，就可能增加光損、影響效能與良率。光陽設備透過實際量測光功率與Insertion Loss，自動尋找光最強、損耗最低的位置，讓設備從機械精度進一步走向光學性能最佳化。 另一個量產痛點是UV膠固化。光學元件對準後以膠固定，但UV固化產生的微小收縮，可能讓原本對好的位置偏移。對單模光纖與矽光子而言，微小偏移就可能增加光損。光陽因此導入AI補償、UV固化漂移修正及AI-AOI量測檢測，在固化過程持續修正誤差，提高量產一致性與良率。 光陽不只布局單一貼合設備，更整合Material、CCD Mounter、AI Engine、A-A Coupling、Femto Laser Marking、CIM Communication、SEMI E187、Process Technology與Automation等九大核心模組，並串接AOI、MES及SECS/GEM，讓客戶由單機設備延伸至自動化產線與智慧工廠。 對投資人而言，光陽瞄準的不是單一設備市場，而是CPO量產後衍生的貼合、耦光、檢測、AI製程控制與整線需求。隨客戶由試產走向大量生產，設備價值有機會由單機銷售，延伸至製程技術、軟體、Automation及Total Solution。 光陽目前卡位CPO從研發走向量產最困難的製程：把光對準、降低光損、避免固化後位置偏移，以及讓每一顆產品穩定複製。160通道FAU、±50nm定位、自動耦光與AI補償，核心目標都是讓矽光子從「做得出來」進一步走向「穩定大量生產」，也成為觀察光陽能否受惠AI高速光互連市場成長的重要指標。 CPO智能高精密貼合設備--160通道FAU奈米貼合平台布局CPO/SiPH市場 隨著AI及高速資料中心快速發展，高速光通訊需求持續攀升。光陽光電自2020年推動轉型，聚焦CPO／矽光子先進封裝與光電整合，已完成1.6Tbps~6.4Tbps矽光子設備出貨，並於2026 Semicon Taiwan推出支援160通道的陣列光纖(FAU)智慧高精密貼合設備。設備整合三維光路、主／被動對位及AI補償，對位精度達±50 nm，可降低耦合光損與UV固化漂移。未來將整合Automation與製程資料庫，提供從主動耦光到智慧工廠的一站式方案，加速CPO／矽光子由研發邁向量產，拓展全球市場。... about: Welocome to SUSS MicroTec's booth No. N 0162 The SUSS MicroTec Group is a leading supplier of equipment and process solutions for microstructuring applications with more than sixty years of engineering experience. Our portfolio covers a comprehensive range of products and solutions for backend lithography, wafer bonding and photomask processing, complemented by micro-optical components. The production of memory chips, cameras for mobile phones or tire pressure sensors – the equipment solutions of SUSS MicroTec are applied within a wide variety of manufacturing processes for applications of daily or industrial use. Customers in the semiconductor industry and related markets like Advanced Packaging, MEMS and LED appreciate our comprehensive experience in wafer processing. This makes us a valuable partner for high-volume production as well as for research and development. ACS300 Gen2 - Production Spin Cluster for Wafer Level Packaging ACS300 Gen3 - Powerful Solution for Advanced Packaging Applications ACS200 Gen2 - Combining Expertise with Innovation ACS200 Gen2 TE - Fully Automated Platform for Maximum Throughput... Production Spin Coat / Develop Cluster for Wafer Level Packaging The ACS300 Gen2 is a modular cluster system designed to meet manufacturers' needs for clean, reliable, high-throughput and modular photolithography processing for 200 and 300mm wafers. Both wafer sizes can be processed parallel or sequential without any mechanical changeover. SUSS MicroTec ACS300 Gen2 systems can be equipped with process modules for HMDS vapor priming, spin coating, spray coating, aqueous or solvent based developing, baking and cooling. It masters thin and thick resist applications as well as photosensitive polymers like polyimide, PBO and Cyclotene (BCB). SUSS MicroTec ACS300 Gen2 addresses all requirements for sophisticated resist processing and the 3D-Integration and Wafer Level Packaging technology in particular. Powerful Solution for Advanced Packaging Applications The modular system of ACS300 Gen3 is specifically designed for demanding high-volume production environments. It provides sophisticated coating, developing and baking functionalities that can be easily adapted to various processes. Maximum process control effectively supports the wide field of use. This, together with the smallest footprint on the market for a system with eight spinner modules, all qualities positively affecting cost-of-ownership, make the tool indispensable for any challenging advanced packaging application such as wafer-level chip-scale packaging, fan-out wafer-level packaging, copper pillar flip-chip packaging and 3D packaging. Combining Expertise with Innovation The SUSS ACS200 Gen3 platform is the successful result of a perfect mix of innovative and production proven components. With the capability of up to 4 wet process modules and a maximum of 19 plates it perfectly suits the needs of high volume manufacturing (HVM). The configuration flexibility of modules and technologies covers not only the requirements of the Advanced Packaging, MEMS and LED market it also bridges the gap between R&D and HVM. The enhanced version of the platform, ACS200 Gen3 TE, increases flexibility even further with up to 6 spinner and spray modules and an integrated inkjet module. ACS200 Gen3 TE Coater & Developer Fully automated platform for maximum throughput The SUSS ACS200 Gen3 TE platform takes the very successful and well-known ACS200 Gen3 platform to a new level. It increases throughput and makes operation and maintenance more comfortable. The SUSS ACS200 Gen3 TE offers unmatched configuration flexibility of modules and technologies, thus covering the requirements of Advanced Packaging, MEMS, LED, and other markets and serving R&D as well as HVM. Photomask Processing and Cleaning Systems Rely on next‑generation lithography with our advanced photomask solutions, combining particle‑free cleanliness and tight process control to protect pattern fidelity and yield across EUV and DUV layers.... is a fully automated photomask cleaning platform designed to meet the increasingly demanding contamination control requirements of advanced semiconductor manufacturing. As photomasks become more complex and feature sizes continue to shrink, even the smallest particles or residues can significantly impact lithography performance and wafer yield. The MaskTrack Pro Series addresses these challenges by providing high-throughput, precision cleaning solutions for a wide range of mask types used in semiconductor fabrication and related industries. A key characteristic of the MaskTrack Pro Series is its , which allows customers to configure the system according to specific production requirements. This flexibility enables fabs and mask shops to optimize the cleaning process for different photomask technologies, process nodes, and contamination types. The platform can be adapted for varying throughput demands while maintaining consistent cleaning performance and process reliability. The system is specifically engineered for the cleaning of high-value photomasks and reticles , which represent critical assets in semiconductor manufacturing. Because photomasks directly determine the pattern transferred onto wafers, their cleanliness is essential for defect-free lithography. The MaskTrack Pro platform is designed to remove particles, organic contaminants, chemical residues, and other unwanted materials that may accumulate during mask fabrication, storage, transportation, or exposure processes. One of the most important advantages of the MaskTrack Pro Series is its emphasis on gentle yet highly effective cleaning . Modern photomasks often incorporate delicate structures and advanced materials that can be damaged by aggressive cleaning methods. SUSS has developed process technologies that maximize contaminant removal while minimizing the risk of mask damage. This balance is critical for extending mask lifetime, reducing replacement costs, and ensuring stable imaging performance throughout repeated usage cycles. The platform supports advanced wet cleaning processes that are optimized for a variety of photomask applications. Through carefully controlled chemical treatment, rinsing, and drying steps, the system can achieve excellent cleanliness levels while preserving the integrity of the mask surface. Process consistency and repeatability are particularly important because manufacturing environments require predictable performance across large volumes of masks. Automated process control helps eliminate variability that may arise from manual handling or less sophisticated cleaning systems. Automation is another major feature of the MaskTrack Pro Series. The system incorporates automated material handling and process sequencing to reduce operator intervention and minimize contamination risks. By limiting human contact with photomasks, the platform helps maintain a clean manufacturing environment while also improving productivity. Automated operation contributes to higher throughput and supports integration into modern semiconductor production facilities that prioritize efficiency and traceability. The MaskTrack Pro platform is also designed with high productivity and factory integration in mind. Semiconductor fabs rely on equipment that can operate continuously and seamlessly within automated manufacturing workflows. The system can be incorporated into existing production lines, supporting efficient mask management and reducing process bottlenecks. High equipment availability and reliable operation are essential for maximizing production output and minimizing downtime. Another significant aspect of the system is its ability to address the evolving requirements of advanced lithography nodes. As semiconductor devices move toward increasingly smaller geometries, process windows become tighter and defect tolerances become more stringent. A single contaminant particle that might have been acceptable in previous generations can now lead to catastrophic yield loss. The MaskTrack Pro Series is designed to help manufacturers meet these stricter cleanliness standards through advanced cleaning performance and contamination control capabilities. The solution also supports the industry's ongoing focus on yield improvement and cost reduction . Since photomasks are expensive and critical production tools, protecting their quality directly impacts manufacturing economics. Effective cleaning reduces defect-related wafer losses, improves production consistency, and helps maximize the usable life of masks. These benefits can translate into significant cost savings across the semiconductor manufacturing process. represents a comprehensive photomask cleaning solution focused on contamination removal, process reliability, automation, and production efficiency. Its modular design, advanced cleaning capabilities, gentle treatment of sensitive mask structures, and compatibility with high-volume manufacturing make it well suited for modern semiconductor fabrication. By helping manufacturers maintain photomask cleanliness and integrity, the system contributes directly to improved lithography performance, enhanced wafer yield, and lower overall manufacturing costs. about: Welcome to Visit Swagelok Taiwan at Booth R7524! Swagelok is a global leader in industrial fluid system solutions. Founded in 1947, the company revolutionized the industry with its breakthrough tube fitting design. Driven by a customer-first philosophy and an uncompromising commitment to quality, we are dedicated to providing safe, reliable, and highly efficient liquid and gas delivery solutions across various industries. As the authorized sales and service center in Taiwan, Swagelok Taiwan provides localized technical support, application expertise, and fluid system solutions for the semiconductor and high-tech industries. From high-purity applications to AI liquid cooling infrastructure, we work closely with customers to improve system reliability, operational safety, and performance. 迎戰AI、先進製程與能源轉型交織的三重挑戰  Swagelok以關鍵流體系統解決方案強化台灣產業韌性 、先進製程與潔淨能源需求同步成長，推動台灣產業面臨結構性升級挑戰 資料中心液冷穩定、半導體製程化學流體輸送，以及氫能等潔淨能源應用的關鍵基礎，而其品質與可靠度將影響整體效能表現 結合高品質流體系統與在地技術服務，協助企業強化營運穩定與產業競爭力 隨著AI應用需求持續攀升，台灣產業正迎來一波由算力驅動的結構性變化。AI模型規模快速擴大，不僅加速半導體先進製程推進，也進一步推高資料中心對高效散熱與系統精準度的要求。同時，在淨零與能源轉型趨勢下，潔淨能源的重要性持續提升，讓能源系統的運作環境變得更加複雜。全球流體系統領導品牌世偉洛克（Swagelok）於今（6）日分享，台灣產業正面臨AI、半導體與永續交織的全新局勢，企業所需的已不是單一技術升級，而是如何在高度複雜且容錯空間極小的環境中，確保系統的穩定運作。 在高度整合的產業體系中，這三股力量已不再是各自發展的平行曲線，不僅彼此牽動，更相互放大影響，同步提高系統複雜度與營運挑戰。AI應用快速擴展，使算力密度與單位機櫃功耗持續攀升，傳統氣冷技術逐步逼近極限，液冷因此成為高效能運算環境中不可或缺的技術選項。 而算力需求的提升，同步推動半導體先進製程加速發展；根據全球晶圓廠預測報告（World Fab Forecast） ，2026年全球晶圓廠設備支出預計突破1,300億美元（約新台幣4.1兆元），顯示先進製程持續帶動半導體投資動能，產業布局亦逐漸轉向全球化發展。另一方面，如何在追求高效能運算的同時落實全球減碳承諾，也成為台灣產業的核心課題，這也使能源系統在安全性、穩定度與長期維運上的管理挑戰備受重視。 about: We are always welcome to see our unique technology ！ 長智貿易創立於2013年，位於台灣台中。在台灣半導體的科技園區，剛好介於南北之間。無論地點與發展契機都具有先天優勢。公司成立由幾位在半導體業界工作多年的夥伴，對於代理或技術引進等目的而投資成立。我司核心價值以開發，創造，整合以及提升價值為目標，專注開發出適合半導體科技產業環境所需要的資源設備或方案，以提供(更佳的解決方案)與(優化的系統整合)來協助我們的重要客戶。 經過多年的經驗累積與自我提升，目前已經整合出多套系統解決方案，包含電力穩定系統，半導體CIP配套方案，綠能ESG相關認證產品與服務方案。 我司於穩定成長之餘，於2023成立長智科技品牌並搬遷到台中水湳經貿園區新址，目標開發本地化/客製化的本土品牌，積極打入台灣藍海市場並且透過不同國家的合作夥伴，已經成功外銷至韓國與半導體大國。 未來展望於 2025年計劃於東南亞市場投入開發並增加在地優勢，期望提升我司的台灣價值並持續與客戶一起成長。 長智科技化身「良率土地公」　期待和你在SEMICON Taiwan 2026 展位 (S8152) 見 （台中訊）半導體廠最怕什麼？電壓驟降、設備異常、良率突然下滑。長智科技這次參加 SEMICON Taiwan 2026，直接把「守護良率」這件事具象化，化身業界的「良率土地公」，在展位 展覽時間為 2026 年 9 月 2 日至 4 日，地點在台北南港展覽館。長智科技將現場展示壓降保護器、智慧手臂監測系統，以及多項半導體製程防護方案，訴求「提前想到、提前做到」，幫客戶把可能影響良率的風險降到最低。 公司表示，這次不以硬梆梆的技術規格轟炸為主，而是希望用更貼近現場工程師的語言，讓大家一眼就知道：「這間公司是來幫忙顧良率的。」歡迎半導體同業、設備商與採購先進，直接到 S8152 聊聊目前工廠最頭痛的電力與設備問題。 長智科技成立於 2013 年，總部位於台中，長期專注半導體設備代理與系統整合，服務範圍涵蓋電力穩定、設備健康監測與綠色解決方案。 時間：2026 年 9 月 2–4 日 地點：台北南港展覽館 展位：S8152 t-Parus 將於 SEMICON Taiwan 2026（攤位 S8152）攜手全球知名自動化設備品牌 ASYS 聯合展出，共同展示半導體設備自動化與電力品質保護的最新解決方案。 本次展出重點包括 t-Parus 通過 SEMI F47 驗證之 VSP（Voltage Sag Protector）電壓暫降防護系統，以及累積超過 1,000 套成功安裝實績的半導體設備保護應用成果。 透過結合 ASYS 在智慧製造與自動化設備領域的技術優勢，以及 t-Parus 在電力品質管理與設備保護領域的專業能力，雙方將共同展示提升半導體製造可靠度與生產效率的整合方案。 隨著先進製程對設備穩定性要求日益提高，瞬間壓降（Voltage Sag）已成為影響設備稼動率與生產品質的重要因素。t-Parus VSP 通過 SEMI F47 驗證，能有效提升設備面對瞬間壓降 事件時的持續運作能力，降低非計畫性停機風險，為晶圓廠與設備製造商提供更完善的電力品質保護方案。 歡迎業界先進於 2026 年 9 月 2 日至 4 日蒞臨 SEMICON Taiwan 2026 攤位 S8152，深入了解半導體設備自動化與電力品質保護技術的最新發展。 VSP (voltage sag protector ) 瞬間壓降保護器 根據統計：在過去十年間 一座半導體廠發生瞬間壓降的次數遠比發生停電的次數還要高上數10倍(甚至100倍以上)，雖然壓降持續時間往往只有數十毫秒至數秒，但仍足以造成曝光機、蝕刻機、真空系統及關鍵製程設備跳脫，進而導致產品報廢、設備重啟及數小時以上的生產損失。因此，對於半導體製造業而言，瞬間壓降所造成的經濟損失往往高於罕見的停電事件，而這也是SEMI F47標準持續受到全球晶圓廠重視的重要原因。

(Taiwan-ATM) was established in 2017 and is Taiwan's first professional supplier dedicated to the production and development of aerogels. The company is headquartered in the Tainan Science Park. Under the leadership of the Chairman, Taiwan-ATM continuously develops various aerogel application products and has established patent portfolios in the United States, China, Japan, and Taiwan. Taiwan-ATM actively collaborates with customers to create value, with the goal of becoming the largest and most professional aerogel manufacturer and fireproof insulation expert in the Asia-Pacific region. In recent years, Taiwan-ATM has continuously advanced its cooperation with domestic and international companies, focusing on the application of aerogels in fireproofing, high-temperature insulation, low dielectric, and lightweight solutions across fields such as electronics, semiconductors, optoelectronics, electric vehicles, ICT, and aerospace. The company offers innovative products, including aerogel powder, granules, insulation blankets, thermal insulation boards, lithium battery separators, and fireproof coatings. All these products are made in Taiwan, boasting superior performance, with data certified by third-party testing organizations. In the future, Taiwan-ATM will continue to work with domestic and international distributors to provide customers with the latest, fastest, and most comprehensive fireproof insulation and energy-saving solutions.

about: TANAKA貴金屬集團創立於1885年（明治18年），以日本東京為起點，至今已有超過一百四十年的歷史。作為全球領先的貴金屬專業企業，TANAKA長期深耕於金、白金、鈀、銀等貴金屬材料的精煉、加工、應用開發與循環再利用，並在全球半導體、電子、汽車、能源及醫療等高科技產業中扮演關鍵材料供應者的角色。 自創立以來，TANAKA從貨幣與貴金屬交易起家，逐步發展至工業應用領域，並隨著日本工業化與全球科技產業的演進，持續拓展技術版圖。早在20世紀初，即成功將白金應用於工業用途，如催化劑、電極材料及實驗器具，奠定在工業貴金屬領域的基礎。 進入半導體與電子產業快速發展的時代後，TANAKA積極投入先進材料研發，並成為全球最早投入鍵合線（Bonding Wire）與封裝用貴金屬材料開發的企業之一。1960年代起，開始量產半導體用金線與鍵合線，奠定其在半導體封裝材料領域的重要地位，並持續擴展至銅線、銀線及高可靠性封裝材料。 目前，TANAKA的產品與技術廣泛應用於半導體封裝、功率元件、車用電子、通訊設備及高可靠性電子元件製造，並提供包括鍵合線、電鍍材料、催化劑材料及先進接點材料等完整解決方案。同時，公司亦積極發展貴金屬回收與再生技術，推動資源循環與永續經營理念，建立「都市礦山」的回收體系。 在全球布局方面，TANAKA已於亞洲、歐洲與美洲設立多個據點，並透過全球研發與製造網絡，提供一致性的品質與技術支援。公司亦為倫敦貴金屬市場（LBMA、LPPM）認證會員，具備國際級精煉與檢測能力，確保貴金屬品質與可信度符合全球標準。 展望未來，TANAKA將持續以「貴金屬創造價值」為核心理念，結合材料科學與先進製造技術，推動半導體與高科技產業的創新發展，並以永續、循環與高可靠性的解決方案，貢獻全球產業進步。

about: TDK was established in 1935 as a venture business born out of academic research. The goal: to develop the world’s first commercialization of the magnetic material “ferrite.” Ferrite had been invented at the Tokyo Institute of Technology, but its possibilities were as yet unknown. TDK was driven by a belief in its potential and a desire to create something unprecedented that would change the world. This dream has been realized and as the electronics industry continues to grow in size and influence, TDK will continue to be an important agent of change. Throughout the eight decades since the company’s founding, and bolstered by our strong foundation in magnetics technology derived from ferrite, TDK has been steadfastly pursuing the development of products that have true value. Keeping alive the venture spirit that defined our beginnings, we have taken up the challenge of exploring new technologies while maintaining a strong dedication to craftsmanship as embodied in the Japanese Monozukuri concept— a dedication to quality and a new era of electronic craftsmanship. This enabled us to create an ongoing succession of innovative and valuable products.

about: Join us in driving this Diamond technological revolution. TDMC is dedicated to becoming a global leader in "New Diamond Material" solutions. We specialize in semiconductor and packaging applications, placing diamond materials at the core of our innovation. Leveraging diamond’s exceptional properties—including an ultra-high thermal conductivity of 2200 W/m·K, low Coefficient of Thermal Expansion (CTE), superior electrical insulation, and extreme hardness—we provide the ultimate material solution for the thermal management challenges of next-generation high-power electronic components. To meet the diverse demands of various market applications, we offer a wide range of diamond material forms, including Single-Crystal Diamond Plates, Polycrystalline Diamond Plates, and Diamond Powders (Single-Crystal/Polycrystalline). Beyond material supply, our team brings over 20 years of integration experience in the electronics industry. We provide clients with customized, one-stop OEM services and tailored fabrication, including Precision Cutting, Grinding, Polishing, Drilling, Surface Modification, and Metallization. We are committed to being a steadfast pillar in the global semiconductor thermal management field, assisting our customers in overcoming heat dissipation barriers to achieve peak performance. We welcome any inquiries or collaborative ideas regarding diamond material applications. Let us work together to drive the technological revolution powered by "New Diamond Materials."

about: 添御股份有限公司自2014年創立以來，堅持以提供專業半導體電子材料為專業營運範圍。在　林文新先生帶領下取得國際知名品牌德國WACKER矽膠產品 及其他國際知名品牌的代理經銷權，提供半導體電子業專用電子材料行銷。秉持著科技專業經營的營運策略，在半導體晶片、半導體AI先進封裝產業、LED光電產業、車用電子產業、電子組件產業、電腦產業、資訊家電業、通訊產品、軟硬電路板電子產品、工程塑膠碳纖維複合材料產品、精密陶瓷產品、新能源科技產品等多項專業領域均獲得高度成長及業界客戶的肯定。 而隨著經濟脈動及科技急速進步，全球的資源不停的創新與求變，更先進精密的電子產品日新月異，添御以講求服務，強調品質，注重速度，堅定以誠心、創新、企圖心的核心價值為經營方針。期許添御為電子產業界付出專業技術的力量，與客戶共創雙贏。 Teen Yu Focuses on CoWoS, AI, and Silicon Photonics to Expand Its Advanced Packaging Materials Portfolio The 2026 SEMICON Taiwan Semiconductor Show is just around the corner! Teen Yu is all set to make a splash from September 2 to 4 at Booth H23 in Hall 1 of the Taipei Nangang Exhibition Center. Riding the wave of AI and HPC, Teen Yu will focus on advanced processes, CoWos packaging materials, and silicon photonics technology, offering a full supply chain solution from wafer manufacturing to packaging and testing.。 Teen Yu continues to deepen its presence and strengthen its market share in advanced materials, while developing adhesives and high thermal conductivity materials needed for advanced packaging processes. This helps semiconductor and packaging companies improve process yield and stability, showcasing a forward-looking approach in advanced processes and emerging technologies. Positive E-Beam Resist PMMA (Polymethylacrylate) is a polymeric material well-suited for many imaging and non-imaging micro-electronic applications. PMMA is commonly used for direct write e-beam processes such as T-gate fabrication. PMMA is also used for temporary wafer bonding processes such as wafer thinning, where it's used as a protective layer and the temporary adhesive. PMMA resists are PMMA polymers of specific molecular weights that are dissolved in a solvent, such as anisole (a safer solvent) and then filtered. Exposure, direct write e-beam or X-ray typically, causes a chain scission of the polymer, resulting in a solubility differential between the exposed and unexposed regions of the resist film, leading to very high resolution patterning. about: TherMap Solutions is a spin-out from the University of Bristol that designs and manufactures advanced laser-based thermal characterisation instrumentation. These tools enable accurate and reliable measurements of critical thermal properties, which are increasingly important as power density in semiconductor devices rises. Effective thermal management depends on optimising interfaces and bonding layers (e.g., die attach) for efficient heat extraction. Conventional techniques struggle to characterise the thermal properties of complex multilayer structures. TherMap’s commercially available instruments overcome this challenge by providing accurate in-situ measurements across a variety of materials— from epitaxial thin films to die attach layers— facilitating faster R&D feedback and improved quality control. The technology helps semiconductor companies manufacturing high-power devices accelerate thermal design optimisation and ensure consistent thermal performance and production reliability. TherMap has collaborated with leading academic and industry partners, including the University of Oxford, IMM-CNR (Italy), Soitec (France), and QFI (USA). • Collaborative R&D projects to validate the existing characterisation technology, focusing on thermal challenges in die bonding or advanced packaging for GaN/ SiC-based power/RF devices or AI/HPC chips • Joint development and integration of in-line thermal characterisation tools for quality control of critical interfaces (die/module attach) in both power/RF and advanced AI/ HPC chip packaging • Partnership for developing and validating a combined laser-based thermal-ultrasonic metrology system for thermal and structural analysis, including defect detection (e.g., voids, delamination) • Collaborations with manufacturers facing thermal challenges in high-power devices (SiC/GaN, AI/HPC) to co-develop efficient cooling solutions

Co., Ltd.）創立於1932年，是日本歷史悠久且具代表性的專業鑽石工具製造企業之一。創業九十餘年來，公司始終專注於鑽石與CBN（立方氮化硼）超硬工具的研發、生產與銷售，致力於為全球製造業提供高精度、高效率及高可靠性的加工解決方案。總部位於日本東京都目黑區，在日本及海外設有多個生產、研發及銷售據點，產品廣泛應用於半導體、電子元件、汽車零組件、精密機械、醫療器材、光學元件及建築工程等產業。 自成立以來，東京鑽石工具製作所始終秉持技術創新精神，將鑽石材料卓越的硬度、耐磨耗性及加工性能發揮至極致，透過「切割、研削、研磨、鑽孔」等核心技術，協助客戶提升產品品質、生產效率與製程穩定性。如今，公司已發展成為日本超精密加工領域的重要品牌，並持續向全球市場提供高附加價值的技術服務。 東京鑽石工具製作所的歷史幾乎與日本現代精密工業的發展同步。自1932年創業以來，公司不斷因應產業升級與技術革新需求，持續投入研發資源，累積豐富的超硬材料加工經驗。從早期機械加工產業，到近代電子、資訊通訊及半導體產業快速崛起，公司皆站在技術發展最前線，提供關鍵加工工具與製程支援。 多年來，公司憑藉精湛技術與穩定品質，在日本市場建立良好聲譽，並逐步拓展亞洲及全球市場。除了日本本土銷售網絡外，亦於泰國、新加坡等地建立海外據點，提供更即時的技術支援與客戶服務，滿足國際客戶日益增長的需求。 上述產品可廣泛應用於矽晶圓、化合物半導體、陶瓷、玻璃、藍寶石、超硬合金、碳化矽（SiC）、氮化鎵（GaN）、石英及高硬脆材料等加工領域。 除了標準產品之外，公司更重視客戶個別需求，透過客製化設計與共同開發模式，針對不同材料、設備與加工條件，提供最佳化工具方案，協助客戶解決實際生產問題，提升良率與降低成本。 隨著人工智慧、5G、高效能運算及電動車市場快速成長，半導體產業對於超精密加工技術的要求日益嚴苛。東京鑽石工具製作所在半導體領域長期累積深厚經驗，其工具廣泛應用於晶圓切割、晶圓研磨、封裝基板加工及先進材料製程。 尤其面對第三代半導體材料如SiC與GaN加工難度高、工具磨耗大等挑戰，公司持續開發高性能鑽石工具與創新製程技術，以滿足先進半導體製造對精度、效率及表面品質的要求，成為眾多半導體及電子產業客戶的重要合作夥伴。 技術力是東京鑽石工具製作所最核心的競爭優勢。公司設有技術研究機構及研發團隊，持續投入新材料、新製程及新工具開發，並與客戶共同研究加工課題。透過材料分析、加工測試及實際生產驗證，不斷提升產品性能與使用壽命。 多年來，公司累積大量超硬材料加工知識與應用數據，能夠根據客戶需求提供完整技術諮詢服務，從工具選型、加工條件優化到量產導入，提供一站式解決方案，協助客戶縮短開發時間並提升市場競爭力。 東京鑽石工具製作所認為企業成長應與環境永續並行。公司經營理念強調「為自然循環作出貢獻」，在追求技術進步與商業成長的同時，也持續推動環境保護、能源節約及資源有效利用。 透過提升工具壽命、改善加工效率及降低材料浪費等方式，公司幫助客戶減少製造過程中的能源消耗與環境負荷，實踐綠色製造理念。此外，公司亦積極履行企業社會責任，致力於建立安全、健康、值得信賴的工作環境，促進企業與社會共同發展。 面對數位化、智能製造、人工智慧及新能源產業快速發展的新時代，東京鑽石工具製作所持續強化全球布局，深化研發能力，並積極開拓半導體、電子元件、新能源車、醫療及高端精密製造等成長市場。 未來，公司將持續以「超越客戶期待的解決方案供應商」為目標，結合九十餘年的技術積累與創新精神，提供更高效率、更高精度及更具永續價值的加工工具與技術服務，攜手全球客戶共同推動先進製造產業發展。 “VEGA” Porous Vitrified Bond Wheel for Wafers Fini Higher surface roughness realized by intermediate processing and final processing of SiC and GaN wafers ■Spontaneous blade generation... Longer wheel life in "rough machining" prior to surface grinding of SiC wafers [Issues in rough machining of SiC wafers] The production of compound semiconductor wafers, which are used as substrates for power devices, is expected to grow steadily in the trend toward power saving in a low-carbon society. The key to this growth is the processing cost of wafers, which requires a longer wheel life due to the large amount of allowance in the rough machining prior to surface grinding. [Solution with porous vitrified bond wheel] Our porous vitrified bond wheel "VEGA" has both a larger pore diameter and a higher porosity than conventional wheels, maximizing the biting performance to work materials. It is particularly suitable for surface grinding of SiC wafers and can grind 6" SiC wafers without dressing. The excellent wear resistance increases the number of wafers that can be machined per wheel and contributes to the reduction of wafer machining costs. The runout accuracy of the diamond layer to the shank is excellent due to our original processing technology.... The runout accuracy of the diamond layer to the shank is excellent due to our original processing technology. In addition to silicon wafers, we also provide wheels with various specifications for compound semiconductor wafers such as SiC (silicon carbide) and LT (lithium tantalate), which are becoming larger nowadays, and for quartz wafers. Outer diameter : Up to φ4 ( Groove bottom diameter Min φ2 ) ■Deflection accuracy : ≥  5 um @Min ■Groove angle tolerance: Tolerance ≥ 0.5 degrees (one side angle) ■Number of grooves : Up to 5 grooves Diamond wheels for edge grinding semicon wafers This wheel is used for edge grinding (beveling) semiconductor wafers.... Diamond wheels for edge grinding (beveling) semiconductor wafers This wheel is used for edge grinding (beveling) semiconductor wafers. We offer "ME" bond for wheels for chamfering silicon wafers with excellent sharpness and high maintenance of groove shape. The finished surface roughness is excellent, and the amount of polishing after chamfering is reduced, leading to lower total processing costs by reducing the post-process time and consumables. For wheels for chamfering SiC and sapphire wafers, we offer bond wheels with excellent sharpness and grinding durability. about: TopoLogic developns Ultra-high capacity cache-memory TopoLogc develops a cache memory technology with 4x higher capacity compared to conventional technologies in the same chip area. TopoLogic's TL-RAM is MRAM based, allowing for smaller cell size while allowing L3 cache equivalent / GPU cache equivalent operating speeds by implementing topological antiferromagnets into the memory cells. The low current requirement and high speed switching capability allows for an energy efficient high density memory block architecture, which can be directly embedded into logic processors, in a similar way to embedded MRAM. TopoLogic also develops TL-SENSING, which can detect heat signatures with 100x response speed compared to conventional heat sensors. This allows for early detection of thermal runaway in rechargeable batteries, significantly increasing safety of battery systems. It can also be used in other applications where quick response times are needed. New cache technology, increasing cache capacity by over 4x, while offering similar operation speeds and latency with conventional SRAM. TL-RAM realizes L3 / GPU cache compatible write speeds with extremely small cell size... New cache memory technology, increasing capacity by over 4x compared to SRAM based cache, while offering similar operation speeds and latency. Based on MRAM, and incorporating topological antiferromagnets, TL-RAM realizes L3 cache GPU cache compatible speeds with extremely small cell size. TL-RAM incorporates a 2 transistor SOT-MRAM design which is structured to be compatible with conventional MRAM manufacturing equipment and production lines with embedded MRAM capability. TL-RAM utilizes Mn3Sn a non-collinear antiferromagnet, which is directly incorporated into the memory cell. Mn3Sn is known for extremely high spin switching, and in addition to the antiferromagnetic properties, improves write current requirements. This sensor can detect minor heat fluctuations in components, to allow detection of battery failures earlier than other sensors available on the market, allowing effective cooling measures before thermal runaway... about: Welcome! Discuss your AMC monitoring goal with us. Founded in 2013, Tricorntech is a global leader in ultra-sensitive, real-time Airborne Molecular Contamination (AMC) monitoring. Our innovative MiTAP systems combine compact, lightweight design with high precision—enabling continuous, on-site detection that empowers semiconductor manufacturers to effectively manage cleanroom environments and maximize production yields. As Taiwan's premier manufacturer with robust in-house R&D capabilities, we deliver fully customized, cost-effective hardware and software solutions tailored to diverse industry needs. Whether enhancing industrial yield, ensuring raw material quality, or assisting governments with environmental safety, we are committed to driving value through customer-centric innovation. tsmc | Micron | EPA | SCAQMD | Thermo Fisher To empower global industries with world-class micro gas detection technologies, defining the future of real-time air quality monitoring. Predict Precisely, Prevent Instantly! Tricorntech Premieres "AI Early Warning Solution" at SEMICON Taiwan 2026 to Safeguard Wafer Yield [Taipei, September 1st] As advanced semiconductor processes demand increasingly stringent control of microenvironments, proactively managing Airborne Molecular Contamination (AMC) has become critical to maintaining stable fab operations and protecting wafer yield. Tricorntech, a leading provider of real-time AMC monitoring solutions, will showcase its AI Early Warning Solution for semiconductor fab contamination management at SEMICON Taiwan 2026. The solution introduces Physics-Constrained AI and integrates Tricorntech’s highly sensitive, on-site AMC/VOC monitoring instruments, enabling a shift from reactive contamination monitoring to proactive environmental risk prediction and early warning. “Tricorntech has been deeply involved in AMC monitoring for many years, and we understand that every environmental abnormality can represent significant operational risk and cost for our customers,” said Tirah Wu, Director at Tricorntech. “By combining our technical expertise with our understanding of real-world customer applications, we aim to address the challenges fabs face today. The AI Early Warning Solution we are presenting at SEMICON Taiwan 2026 represents not only an important advancement in monitoring applications, but also our commitment to improving process stability and facility operational efficiency.” AI Early Warning Solution: Overcoming the Limitations of Conventional Monitoring to Safeguard Wafer Yield Traditional fab monitoring systems often face four major limitations: reactive alarms after an event has occurred, lack of spatial visualization, heavy reliance on manual interpretation, and difficulty understanding complex airflow patterns. These limitations can create potential risks to wafer yield and contribute to unexpected downtime. In addition, the semiconductor industry places a high priority on protecting confidential process information, making it difficult to share sensitive data externally. This creates additional challenges when developing predictive systems that traditionally depend on large amounts of historical operating data. To address these challenges, Tricorntech introduces Physics-Constrained AI, combining Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) with extensive fab facility experience to overcome limitations caused by insufficient data. The AI Early Warning Solution can perform high-precision simulations without requiring customers to expose sensitive core process parameters. By constraining AI calculations with physical laws, the approach also helps prevent AI hallucinations, while automated high-efficiency computation replaces complex and time-consuming manual simulations. Through Predictive Early Warnings, the system can identify contamination concentration trends in advance and trigger alerts before contaminants spread to process-critical areas. Combined with 3D Spatial Visualization and dynamic heatmaps, facility engineers can intuitively track the direction of abnormal gas dispersion within a three-dimensional cleanroom environment, trace potential sources, identify affected areas, and significantly improve response speed and decision-making accuracy. Facilitating rapid defense system integration and seamless execution for clients, Tricorntech delivers a structured four-stage implementation framework—spanning sensor network deployment, digital twin creation, physics-constrained AI integration, and environmental risk prediction—to comprehensively empower smart facility management. Through its AI Early Warning Solution, Tricorntech aims to establish a comprehensive cleanroom protection network for semiconductor fabs—helping reduce chemical risks and downtime while driving the industry toward a new era of high-resilience smart manufacturing. Tricorntech Analyzer and System Portfolio: Maximizing Fab Stability Through On-Site Analysis In addition to its AI Early Warning Solution, Tricorntech will showcase its portfolio of physical AMC/VOC monitoring instruments and integrated systems at SEMICON Taiwan 2026. Designed to meet the stringent requirements of advanced semiconductor manufacturing, the portfolio includes highly sensitive online analyzers for continuous monitoring, portable analyzers, and comprehensive system integration solutions. Key products and systems on display include: — Designed for precision monitoring of FOUP micro-environments. Specialized in individual analysis of Volatile Organic Compounds (VOCs). Designed for real-time monitoring of acidic and basic gases. Multi-Point Sampling System — A fixed monitoring cabinet designed for 24/7 in-line continuous monitoring, supporting up to 64 sampling channels per system. Its highly scalable architecture enables the integration of multiple analyzers based on customer requirements, together with customized interfaces and fully automated analysis to meet stringent fab AMC management requirements. AMC/VOC Mobile Monitoring Cart — Designed for flexible in-fab monitoring and off-line troubleshooting. The cart integrates a UPS and computer system, providing facility engineers with a mobile platform for routine inspection, troubleshooting, and precise identification of contamination and leakage hotspots. Tricorntech’s analyzers and integrated systems combine high sensitivity, high accuracy, and powerful on-site analytical capabilities. When integrated with the AI Early Warning Solution, these technologies enable frontline engineers to detect changing contamination conditions and respond to abnormalities before contaminants spread, maximizing overall facility operational efficiency. about: Understanding your needs and providing optimized solutions with highly reliable instruments and equipment makes us your best test & measurement partner. VASTi TECHNOLOGIES is your professional partner, leveraging market experience and product applications to provide global clients and manufacturers with diverse measurement equipment and solutions. Since our company's inception, our team's goal has been to become a leader in select application areas. To meet the demand for optimal solutions, we meticulously understand your needs and offer highly reliable and high-quality products. VASTi Technologies: High-Speed Digitizers Are Becoming Increasingly Important in Advanced Optics and Photonics Applications As photonics technologies continue to advance across industries such as autonomous transportation,aerospace, semiconductor manufacturing, medical imaging, and optical communications, engineers are increasingly challenged to capture and analyze rapidly changing optical signals. High-speed digitizers arebecoming an increasingly important tool for acquiring and analyzing detector outputs with high fidelity and repeatability. Unlike conventional oscilloscopes, dedicated digitizers provide sustained high-speed acquisition, deep onboard memory, deterministic triggering, multi-channel synchronization, and flexible software integration. These capabilities allow engineers to characterize laser pulses, analyze receiver performance,evaluate optical modulation quality, and capture complex transient events that are critical to system development and validation. The GaGe series of high-speed digitizers from Vitrek, exclusively distributed by VASTi Technologies,supports a broad range of optical and photonics applications through high sampling rates, flexible PCIe architectures, and extensive software support for automated test environments. From university research laboratories to commercial product development and manufacturing, these high-performance digitizers help engineers acquire the waveform data needed to accelerate design, improve measurement confidence, and validate increasingly sophisticated optical systems. “As optical technologies continue expanding into new commercial and industrial markets, selecting the right data acquisition architecture is becoming just as important as selecting the optical components themselves,” said Dr. Andrew Dawson, Engineer at Vitrek. “We are looking for acquisition platforms that can keep pace with the performance demands of next-generation photonics systems.” VASTi Technologies is a professional distributor of high-end instrumentation, serving as Vitrek LLC's agent in Asia, covering Taiwan, Japan, the Philippines, Vietnam, Thailand, and other regions, offering professional instrumentation sales and services. We cordially invite you to visit our booth at SEMICON Taiwan 2026. Location : 4th Floor, TaiNEX 2, Taipei, Taiwan VASTi Technologies: Growing Importance of Wafer Stress Characterization for Advanced Semiconductor Manufacturing non-contact wafer metrology systems help manufacturers optimize thin-film processes, improve process control, and increase production yield. The growing importance of wafer stress measurement in semiconductor manufacturing as advanced packaging, heterogeneous integration, silicon carbide (SiC), gallium nitride (GaN), MEMS, and photonics applications continue to drive demand for tighter process control, improved manufacturing consistency, and higher device reliability. As semiconductor manufacturing processes become increasingly complex, engineers are placing greater emphasis on monitoring wafer stress to optimize thin-film deposition, validate process changes, detect equipment drift, and improve production yield. Full-wafer stress characterization provides valuable insight into process stability, enabling manufacturers to identify subtle variations before they impact downstream operations. Vitrek’s Proforma™ family of non-contact wafer metrology systems, exclusively distributed by VASTi Technologies, provides high-precision measurement of wafer stress, bow, warp, curvature, thickness, and total thickness variation (TTV). By capturing comprehensive full-wafer measurement data, Proforma systems help engineers visualize stress distribution, evaluate process changes, and support statistical process control (SPC) initiatives throughout semiconductor manufacturing. “Wafer stress has become much more than a laboratory measurement—it is now an important indicator of manufacturing performance,” said Ken Ameika, VP Global Sales at Vitrek. “Understanding how stress changes throughout fabrication enables engineers to optimize processes, improve repeatability, and support higher manufacturing yields.” VASTi Technologies is a professional distributor of high-end instrumentation, serving as Vitrek LLC's agent in Asia, covering Taiwan, Japan, the Philippines, Vietnam, Thailand, and other regions, offering professional instrumentation sales and services. about: Wave Photonics is advancing photonic integrated circuit (PIC) design technology to accelerate the mass production and adoption of integrated photonics. The company brings together the expertise of Dr. James Lee and Dr. Matthew Anderson—developed through research at Toshiba’s Quantum Information Group and Cambridge University—and Mateusz Kubica’s decade-long experience in statistical modelling and optimisation. At the core of Wave Photonics’ patent-pending innovation is a design platform that integrates fabrication process characterisation, modelling, photonic simulation, and inverse design to develop process design kits (PDKs) across various materials and wavelengths. This flexibility enables applications in Co-Packaged Optics (CPO), transceivers, and quantum technologies. Wave Photonics’ PDKs demonstrate lower loss and reduced sensitivity to process variations compared to conventional designs. These have been validated and are undergoing testing in a high-volume commercial fab. The company has also developed the world’s most expansive PDK focused on quantum applications, showcasing the scalability and speed of its approach. Compatibility with leading electronic design automation tools is ensured through partnerships with Cadence, Siemens, and Luceda Photonics. With growing demand for energy-efficient chips, Wave Photonics is actively seeking foundry and design partners for datacom, CPO, and quantum applications. • Joint development with organisations working on CPO and transceivers • Collaborations with researchers developing new integrated photonics technologies • Partnerships with organisations developing new integrated photonic processes and platforms • Expertise in photonics for quantum applications, including trapped ions and quantum key distribution (QKD)

about: We sincerely invite you to visit our booth P5712. Weisun Industrial Co., Ltd. provides solutions for mid to high-end process drying equipment, offering customized services. Our main products include Industry 4.0 Automated Drying Equipment, Dust-Free Oxygen-Free Drying Equipment, Specialized Drying Equipment, Customized Conveyor Drying Equipment, General Drying Equipment, and Multi-functional Software System.  These products are widely used in industries such as IC semiconductors, ABF substrates, PCB circuit boards, Micro LED, TFT, MLCC, DRAM, LCD, PLED, SMT, and composite materials. As a technological leader in industrial drying equipment based on advanced light and heat technology, we are committed to helping our customers achieve high operational efficiency and high yield rates in intelligent lights-out factory , enhancing both production efficiency and environmental safety. From precise temperature control to dust-free and oxygen-free environments and customized requirements, our products meet the most stringent demands of our customers. "Intelligence, Green Energy, Sustainability" is the brand vision of WEISUN. We aim to achieve our sustainable goals through organizational activities, green products, green processes, green partnerships, and green living. WEISUN is Showcasing Curing Oven for 8” & 12” Wafer at SEMICON Taiwan 2026 WEISUN Industrial will exhibit at SEMICON Taiwan 2026 from September 2 to 4, at Booth P5712 in the Taipei Nangang Exhibition Center, presenting its vacuum curing oven for semiconductor advanced packaging — showing how thermal process equipment can maintain full-area temperature uniformity and chamber cleanliness under high-temperature conditions. As advanced packaging moves toward thinner substrates, more redistribution layers and larger panel sizes, the control requirements for curing and annealing are no longer simply a matter of “reaching the set temperature.” Temperature variation between positions on a wafer or carrier, residual moisture and solvents inside the chamber, and the risk of particles and oxidation during processing all show up directly in back-end yield — which makes the stability of thermal process equipment a key evaluation point at the process planning stage. The vacuum curing oven on display uses a multi-zone precision temperature control design, with multi-point thermocouples and independently controlled heating zones that hold every measurement point stable during the soak stage. A human-machine interface simultaneously displays multi-point real-time temperatures, vacuum pressure, chamber pressure, nitrogen flow rate and oxygen concentration, so process parameters can be recorded and traced from start to finish. The chamber uses a high-polish surface finish and can operate in an ISO Class 4 cleanroom environment. Vacuum processing is combined with a precisely engineered flow field, so nitrogen passes over the carrier trays in a stable, directed flow that continuously removes the moisture and residual solvents generated during the process. The oven is also equipped with a nitrogen heating and recovery unit that routes exhausted nitrogen into a heat and solvent recovery system for reuse. Compared with single-pass exhaust, this reduces nitrogen consumption by up to 50%, helping to lower line operating costs and carbon emissions. Through the vacuum curing oven, WEISUN aims to move thermal processing beyond reliance on equipment set points and operator experience, toward process conditions that are measurable, traceable and consistent in quality — helping semiconductor and advanced packaging customers strengthen process control and maintain stable production quality. Visitors are welcome to stop by Booth P5712 during the show to see the vacuum curing oven’s temperature control performance and its applications in advanced packaging processes. about: Welcome to Withsystem Co., Ltd., Semiconductor Division! Since its establishment in 2002, With System Co., Ltd. has steadily grown as an independent inspection solution provider in IT fields such as display and mobile. In 2023, the company expanded into the semiconductor sector by establishing a semiconductor probe and test socket manufacturing facility under its newly launched Semiconductor Business Division. The Semiconductor Business Division is responsible for producing key components essential for semiconductor testing. By fully internalizing all core processes—ultra-precision machining, spring production, surface treatment, and assembly—it is dedicated to earning customer trust and becoming a top-tier player in the industry. The division is committed to delivering a wide range of solutions for the manufacturing of semiconductor probes and test sockets used in the testing of various semiconductor product groups. Withsystem offers customized designs tailored to each customer’s requirements, and supports small-lot, high-mix production. We have a monthly production capacity exceeding 2 million pins, and are capable of manufacturing fine-pitch probes as small as 0.11mm in diameter. Our fully in-house production system covers all stages—from design and development, surface treatment, precision machining, and assembly, to inspection and customer-specific analysis—ensuring both quality and responsiveness. Withsystem has the capability to machine aluminum metal and various types of engineering plastics, and proudly offers high-precision hole drilling technology down to 0.1mm. We support a wide range of semiconductor package types—including BGA, QFP, QFN, and LGA—depending on application needs. Our products are currently used by world-class semiconductor test houses, and we continue to actively promote our solutions to these and other global customers.

about: Yaskawa Electric is one of the world's leading manufacturers in the field of motion control technology, industrial automation, and robotics. We are always committed to using innovation to optimize the productivity and efficiency of machines and industrial systems. Our products and solutions are used in a wide range of industries, including machine and tool manufacturing, automotive, packaging, woodworking, elevators, air conditioning systems, textiles, and semiconductors. At this year's SEMICON, we will be showcasing the excellent performance of our new semiconductor robotic arm, which provides high accuracy and ultra-low vibration optimization for the first time. We hope you will come and visit us! Digital data solutions by the Σ-X series will transport you to the next step in production with the high precision collection and analysis of data.... [Data-Driven Digital Solutions Starting from Servo Systems] Data collection can begin immediately without modifying machine or equipment designs. By analyzing data such as vibration, external disturbances, and torque commands, trends can be predicted to effectively prevent unexpected downtime and failures. [Industry-Leading Motion Control Performance] By implementing the Σ-X series, equipment performance and production efficiency can be significantly improved. The intelligent servo system also helps shorten development lead time. By combining the advanced safety module (ASM-X) with the Σ-X servo system and using functional safety motors, safety levels of SIL3 and PLe (CAT3) can be achieved. (forGantryApplications Built-in Gantry Application Function&Torque/Force Assistance Function) The FT70 SERVOPACK supports functions optimized for gantry driving and torque/force assistance to provide an optimal solution for problems with gantry mechanisms.... This servo pack is equipped with optimal functions for gantry drive systems and supports torque/thrust assist features. It includes four built-in functions specifically designed to address issues unique to gantry mechanisms, helping to prevent mechanical damage and improve cycle times. Additionally, with torque/thrust assist functionality, it enables the coordination of multiple servo packs to realize high-thrust (torque) systems. The FT40 SERVOPACK realizes high-speed/high-precision pressure control by inputting feedback signals from pressure sensors to pressure references (torque control commands) from controllers.... By receiving pressure commands (torque control commands) from the controller and inputting feedback signals from the load cell, this product executes torque control. When the detected pressure value exceeds the effective pressure control threshold, the pressure control function is triggered to achieve high-speed, high-precision pressure control. It is widely applied in semiconductor equipment including bonders and inspection systems. Function Demonstration: Automatic Teaching Point Generation by Detecting the Fixture Center Pin with a Sensor Fixture.... By utilizing a sensor together with a 300 mm wafer fixture for calibration, the system automatically determines and generates the teaching point coordinates for the FOUP, Stage, and Fork positions based on the feedback data from the five-axis motors. Operational data from Yaskawa products running on the production line is collected through a PC to monitor the motion information of each axis and evaluate the operating status of online equipment.... By converting motor current values into torque values,the system continuously monitors the operational status of each robot axis. Long-term comparison of torque trends enables the detection of abnormalities and mechanical degradation within the drive mechanism, providing early warnings and maintenance recommendations to help prevent unexpected downtime.

Yuan Jing Precision Co., Ltd. (YJP) is a Taiwan-based engineering and manufacturing partner specializing in customized bearing and precision motion solutions for semiconductor equipment. YJP supports applications requiring high positioning accuracy, rigidity, compact design, load performance, cleanroom and vacuum compatibility, corrosion resistance, low-lubrication concepts, and stable long-term operation. Our capabilities include application-based bearing design, selection and optimization, cross-roller bearings, ultra-thin bearings, large-diameter bearings, precision-machined rollers, surface-coating options, and integration with the customer’s mechanical system. YJP’s bearing solutions are strengthened by in-house OEM precision machining and grinding capabilities, enabling us to manufacture bearing rings, housings, mating structures, and other critical mechanical components. Depending on part geometry, material, and process requirements, YJP can achieve geometric tolerances down to 0.002 mm and machine components up to Ø2,500 mm. Quality control is supported by disciplined inspection procedures and ZEISS CMM measurement. From bearing engineering to high-precision component manufacturing and system integration, YJP helps semiconductor equipment manufacturers develop reliable solutions where standard catalog products are insufficient.
